description: AlertD provides an AI-native platform for AWS Cloud operations, helping DevOps and SRE teams manage cost, security, compliance, and performance. Operating via read-only access within an organization's VPC, its agents auto-discover infrastructure and generate ready-to-apply remediation runbooks.

name: AlpineAI
description: Experience the cutting-edge capabilities of SwissGPT, a state-of-the-art AI platform developed in Switzerland. Harnessing the remarkable power of Large Language Models (LLM), SwissGPT seamlessly integrates with your enterprise data, revolutionizing the way you leverage AI in organizations and beyond.

name: Ampleforth
description: Ampleforth is the name of a character in George Orwell's 1984 who is responsible for translating poetry into Newspeak, a language designed to limit freedom of thought. When tasked to replace the word “God” in a Kipling poem, Ampleforth refuses, not out of righteousness or subversiveness, but rather, a simple love for language and respect for the truth. To Ampleforth, no other word makes sense in context and therefore no other word should replace it.

name: Aristotle
description: We've known for millennia that 1-on-1 tutoring works better than anything else. Better than flashcards, better than colorful mobile games, better than one-to-many lectures. But scaling world-class one-on-one tutoring has never been possible—until now. We're building the world's first agentic AI tutor: a human-like personal tutor, built in software.

name: Artyc
description: Artyc is modernizing cold-chain logistics. Having developed the first on-demand cold chain platform, Artyc supports life sciences and clinical research customers with self-cooling packaging, real-time data and analytics, and business intelligence that saves customers time and money, in addition to providing peace of mind that they’ll never lose product to poor refrigeration.

name: Atticus
description:
At any given time, 16 million Americans are experiencing a crisis that requires urgent help from our legal system or government. The right assistance could transform their lives. But today, most never get it.

Atticus makes it easy for any person in crisis to get the life-changing aid they deserve. In just three years, we’ve become the leading platform connecting people with disabilities to government benefits. We also help victims of accidents, misconduct, and violence get compensation from insurance. So far, we’ve gotten thousands of people access to over $2B in life-changing aid, and we’re just getting started.

Atticus has raised $28 million from top VC firms like Forerunner (Jet, Glossier, Warby Parker) and True Ventures (Peloton, Fitbit, Ring). We're growing fast, and we're always on the lookout for great, mission-driven people to join our team.

name: Audos
description: Audos helps everyday entrepreneurs build small AI companies by providing tools to author AI agents and create businesses around personal interests and experiences.

name: Automattic
description: Automattic is a software company that develops web publishing, eCommerce, messaging, blogging, and content management products. Its portfolio includes WordPress.com, WooCommerce, Tumblr, Jetpack, WordPress VIP, Beeper, Day One, Pocket Casts, Akismet, Gravatar, Longreads, and Newspack. The company also contributes to open-source projects and tools across the WordPress ecosystem.

name: Avidbots
description: Avidbots' vision is to bring robots to everyday life to expand human potential. Avidbots' first product is NEO - the world's smartest autonomous scrubbing robot. NEO is trusted by some of the best-managed airports, retail malls, hospitals, colleges, industrial sites, museums, and warehouses in 7 countries and counting.

name: B-Stock Solutions
description: B-Stock Solutions helps companies increase revenue and reduce costs associated with the liquidation of excess inventory. The company was founded in 2009 by the team who built the private marketplace business at eBay for brand name companies like Sam's Club, HP, Motorola, and Dell.

name: Baffle, Inc.
description: Baffle secures data in the cloud and when shared across the entire analytics pipeline with no impact on the user experience. Proven in large-scale environments, only the Baffle Data Protection Service de-identifies sensitive information with zero application changes so companies can responsibly move more data, faster, to the cloud for privacy-preserving analytics in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML).

name: Basecamp Research
description: Basecamp Research is a biotechnology company that uses artificial intelligence and biological data to develop therapeutics. Its EDEN AI model analyzes evolutionary data to support antibiotic design, antigen immunogenicity prediction, gene insertion, gene editing, and peptide design. The company develops AI-designed therapeutic programs and advances them through preclinical development.

name: Bible Chat
description: Bible Chat is an AI-powered Christian app designed to help users explore the Bible through AI-guided conversations, personalized prayers, and Bible study tools. Its AI is trained exclusively on Scripture and guided by pastors and theologians to provide biblically grounded responses. The platform also offers Bible lessons, devotionals, journaling, and spiritual resources to support users in their daily faith journey.

name: Bigscreen
description:
Founded by Darshan Shankar in 2014, Bigscreen is a venture-backed startup creating an immersive virtual reality platform that aims to revolutionize the way people work, play, hang out, and collaborate.

Use cases of Bigscreen include both entertainment and productivity. Users love using Bigscreen as a "VR movie theater" to watch movies and TV shows. It's also used to play video games, browse the web, and hang out with friends. It can also be used for productivity as a tool for remote teams to collaborate together in virtual offices.

Since the beta launch in March 2016, Bigscreen has become one of the most popular and highest rated VR apps on the Oculus Store and has an incredible 93% positive rating on Steam. Power users spend 20-30 hours per week in Bigscreen, making it one of the most widely used "killer apps" in the industry.

Bigscreen is now the most popular non-gaming VR application in the world.

Bigscreen is a fully distributed remote company with employees based around the world in the US and UK.

name: Bluesky
description: Developer of a social platform intended to provide and drive the adoption of technologies for open and decentralized public conversation. The company's platform specializes in building a social internet and focusing on rebuilding the social website by connecting disconnected silos, enabling clients to get control of the social experience.

name: Bolo
description: At Bolo AI, we are pioneering the future of knowledge management in heavy industries, starting with Oil & Gas. Our groundbreaking platform combines domain-specific models with cutting-edge AI technology to redefine how millions of heavy industry professionals access and create vital knowledge. Our products, Bolo AI Answer and Bolo AI Writer, streamline access to critical information and documentation processes, setting new standards in productivity, safety, and efficiency.

name: Bumo
description: Bumo is an on-demand child care booking platform that connects parents with trusted, vetted child care facilities and programs—such as daycare centers, preschools, and seasonal camps—whenever they need it. Bumo is particularly useful for families needing backup care when regular arrangements fall through, or for those who require only occasional or part-time child care. The platform’s rigorous vetting process and transparent parent reviews ensure peace of mind for users.

name: Carbo Culture
description: Plants draw down CO2 from the atmosphere via photosynthesis and solar power at unbeatable efficiency. We take waste biomass and transform it using our patented reactors, permanently storing the carbon in an inert, solid form called biochar. Our unique process produces high-quality biochar for agricultural and construction applications, generates renewable energy, and creates some of the most tangible carbon credits on the market.

name: Channel Robotics
description: Channel Robotics is a medical technology company that develops handheld, artificial intelligence-enabled robotic platforms to bring advanced surgical dexterity to existing endoscopes.

name: ChatSee
description: ChatSee develops AI agent observability and reliability software for enterprise customers.

name: ConcentrateAi
description: LLM Infra

name: Conntour
description: Conntour enables organizations to query thousands of security cameras using natural language. Users can search past footage (“Find a man with tattoos on his left arm”), configure real-time alerts (“Notify me if someone climbs over the wall”), and extract data (“How many pickup trucks entered yesterday?”). Unlike traditional video analytics limited to pre-defined parameters (like a weapon, bag, or license plate), Conntour supports unlimited, highly specific scenarios described in plain language. This enables a single human to monitor thousands of cameras. Conntour is backed by top-tier investors including General Catalyst and Y Combinator, selected for the first-ever Palantir fellowship, and advised by Bob Flores, former CTO at the CIA.

name: Conversion
description: The Modern B2B Marketing Automation Platform.

name: Daydream
description: Daydream focuses on providing personalized shopping results through Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Computer Vision.

name: Deep Genomics
description: Deep Genomics recruits from among the top 1% of recent graduates and seasoned experts at the intersection of Genomics, Drug Development, and AI.

name: Digg
description:
Digg Inc. operates a website that enables its users to find, read, and share the most interesting and talked about stories on the internet. It is an editorially driven front page, aiming to select stories related to science, politics, and viral internet issues.

It also enables users to find stories on their iOS or Android devices through its mobile apps and delivers stories via daily emails.

Digg Inc. was founded in 2004 and is based in San Francisco, California. Currently, it operates as a subsidiary of News.me, Inc.

name: Endel
description: Endel is a cross-platform audio ecosystem. It creates personalized, sound-based, adaptive environments that help people focus and relax. They’re a small team of artists, developers, and scientists who have worked together on lots of digital projects, including the award-winning kids’ app series, BUBL. Endel is a 2018 Techstars Music Accelerator company.

name: Enveda
description: Enveda discovers medicines by studying the chemistry of nature and translating natural compounds into potential therapeutic candidates. The company combines computational methods, analytical chemistry, biology, and machine learning to identify molecules, understand their biological activity, and support drug discovery. Its platform examines complex natural mixtures to determine molecular structures and their effects on biological systems. Enveda also develops a pipeline of drug candidates targeting areas of human health and provides research capabilities focused on discovering and developing medicines derived from natural sources.

name: Exnaton
description: Exnaton is the software for the transition to renewable energy.

name: Fairing
description:
EnquireLabs uses survey data to deliver consumer truth across personalization, conversion optimization, and customer experience, as well as attribution. Because the insights also append customer data, responses are still linked to the shopper and their transactions. For compatibility across all verticals, the company has released its flagship Question Stream product as well as a Software Development Kit (SDK) beta program. EnquireLabs has launched its SDK beta program to expand into new verticals, which was previously available only to Shopify brands. 

The company was established in 2020 and is headquartered in New York.

name: Fauna Bio
description: Fauna Bio is developing new ways to treat human diseases, such as heart disease and neurodegenerative disease, by adopting mechanisms animals have developed for traits such as hibernation and deep-diving. Founded by three scientists who have intimate knowledge of the best science and resources from the field of non-model organisms, Fauna Bio leverages data from hundreds of species in order to help develop pre-clinical and early clinical testing for new therapeutics targeting human diseases.

name: Feroot Security
description:
All-in-One Client-Side Risk Management Platform  
Feroot is the first way to manage and automate everything you need to protect your data assets on the client-side of your web applications and websites – from credit card data to login credentials, ePHI, and more.

name: Flick.art
description: Flick is an AI-powered platform reimagining the future of filmmaking. It offers creators an open canvas where words, images, and moving pictures can grow and connect freely. Instead of working through prompts or rigid tools, filmmakers engage in a dialogue with an “AI Director,” allowing stories, characters, and worlds to unfold organically. By weaving together multiple advanced models, Flick enables a process that feels intuitive, narrative-driven, and collaborative.

name: Flux
description: Flux is a code-first engineering intelligence platform that helps engineering leaders make better decisions with ground-truth visibility into the work actually happening across today’s complex, AI-accelerated codebases. Instead of relying on tickets, Flux reveals the work teams are doing, surfaces risk and technical debt, and connects engineering activity to business outcomes. With this visibility, leaders can distinguish innovation from maintenance, spot emerging issues before they become incidents, and understand collaboration patterns to build healthier, higher-performing teams across their engineering organization.

name: Fractyl Laboratories
description: Fractyl Health develops innovative medical device solutions for the treatment of chronic diseases. The growing product pipeline leverages our minimally invasive procedural therapy, Revita DMR (Duodenal Mucosal Resurfacing), which is designed to rejuvenate the lining of the duodenum and improve patient health. They envision a world with better solutions to chronic diseases through the use of less invasive, device-based therapies that will lessen the burden on patients, physicians, and payers. Fractyl Health aims to bring curative therapies to the large populations of patients with metabolic disease.

name: Gather
description: We're building the platform that closes the gap between businesses and their customers. Every business has gaps. Gaps in understanding who their ideal customer really is. Gaps between what they think customers want and what customers actually need. Gaps between a problem surfacing and the team acting on it. Gather exists to close those gaps, continuously and in real time. We believe the true role of AI is not to generate more data, more dashboards, or more reports. It's to monitor the gaps between a business and its customers, understand those gaps through first-party and third-party data, and close them in real time, without human input beyond company priorities. That's what Gather does. It's a "mind the gap" platform for marketing and CX teams. You set the priorities. Gather watches for the gaps: shifts in brand perception, messaging that isn't landing, pricing that's leaving revenue on the table, customers who are about to churn. Then it acts, designing and running the research, surfacing the insight, and delivering the content and recommendations your team needs to close the gap before it widens.

name: Gradle Inc.
description:
Gradle Inc. is the company behind the leading software solution for improving developer productivity and happiness called Develocity (formerly Gradle Enterprise - https://gradle.com/develocity) and the popular open-source Gradle Build Tool (https://gradle.org), which is downloaded over 30 million times a month.

Gradle is also pioneering the emerging practice of Developer Productivity Engineering (DPE). Elite development teams from companies like Airbnb, LinkedIn, Microsoft, Nasdaq, and Netflix practice DPE to deliver quality software more rapidly at scale. They achieve this by leveraging Develocity’s innovative build and test performance acceleration technologies and analytics to proactively improve the reliability of the developer toolchain and make failure troubleshooting more efficient.

name: Gridware
description: Gridware offers a grid-intelligence platform that equips utilities with real-time visibility into the physical, electrical, and environmental conditions of their overhead infrastructure. Its core product, GridScope, is a small, solar-powered sensor mounted on utility poles that continuously monitors mechanical vibrations, electrical activity, and ambient stressors even during outages. On-device analytics identify hazards, localize faults, and classify their severity, allowing line crews to respond efficiently and safely. Through its Active Grid Response system, Gridware helps utilities detect issues before they escalate, supporting timely maintenance and more stable grid operations.

name: GT Biosciences
description: Developer of a cell and tissue-specific delivery platform designed to enhance the precision and safety of genetic medicine delivery. The company's platform offers proprietary spatial biology data, AI-powered screening of delivery vehicles, and in vivo targeting capabilities, enabling researchers and biopharmaceutical developers to improve effectiveness and safety in therapeutic delivery.

name: Handshake
description: Handshake is a career network designed for students and recent graduates to find job opportunities. It has a community of over 10 million users from 1,400 educational institutions, including colleges and boot camps. The platform connects these individuals with more than 750,000 employers, covering various sectors. It aims to facilitate access to career resources for both students and employers.

name: Hatch
description: Hatch is a sleep-wellness company dedicated to helping people sleep better. Its innovative products and services have supported millions of individuals in achieving quality rest. Focused on making sleep easier for everyone, Hatch offers all-in-one solutions designed to support healthy sleep routines for all ages — from infants to adults.

name: Hi Marley
description: Marley is the insurance industry’s premier intelligent conversation platform. Hi Marley is a conversation platform that simply and easily connects people with their insurance companies. Marley combines intelligent messaging and human touch to make the experience as easy and efficient as possible. It was founded in 2017 and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts.

name: Hitch
description: Hitch is solving intercity transportation by offering an affordable, personal, and safe ride-sharing service to consumers.

name: Hopper
description: Hopper.dev refers to a Java-like, C-syntax programming language and environment for microcontrollers, focusing on small devices (RP2040, 6502) with an integrated toolchain (compiler, debugger) running on Windows, blurring lines between IDE and target device via USB, allowing self-hosting (IDE written in Hopper) for easier embedded development.

name: Howie
description: Howie, an email-based scheduling assistant, uses Artificial Intelligence to automate the scheduling and rescheduling of your meetings.

name: HyCom Core
description: Developer of a data transfer platform designed to empower data center providers and improve the connectivity between AI clusters. The company offers design and provides engineering services and comprehensive planning support, enabling data center operators to enhance their data transfer capabilities and optimize operations.

name: ICEYE
description:
We are a fast-growing international new space company with employees from over 45 countries united by the same values and vision.

ICEYE delivers unmatched persistent monitoring capabilities for any location on Earth. Owning the world’s largest Synthetic-Aperture Radar (SAR) satellite constellation, we enable objective, data-driven decisions for customers in sectors such as insurance, natural catastrophe response and recovery, security, maritime monitoring, and finance. Our data can be collected day or night, and even through cloud cover.

We constantly search for new talent to push the technology limits and keep making impossible possible. See our open positions and join us on this journey!

name: Intension
description: The choice is yours.

name: Intergrid
description: Easiest way to electrify and optimize industrial energy use.

name: Item Co
description: We’re building a new foundation for businesses—one that empowers any company to run like a FORTUNE 500, no matter the size or team.

name: JusticeText
description: JusticeText is a software platform that makes it easier for public defenders to process and incorporate crucial audio and video evidence in defense of their clients. It was founded in 2019 and is based in Irvine, California.

name: KEWAZO
description: KEWAZO is digitizing construction with robotics and data analytics. We integrate robotic platforms on-site to enable digital services. In scaffolding, our robotic material hoist LIFTBOT saves up to 44% of labor costs, addresses labor shortage, and improves safety. By having our robots on-site, we collect operational data and provide it to our customers in the form of a data analytics platform, enabling more proactive management of both individual projects and companies overall.

name: Kurtosys
description: Kurtosys provides an end-to-end digital experience platform (DXP) that enables firms to create, manage, publish, and optimize all their financial data, documents, websites, and content in a secure, compliant environment. As a result, it is trusted by the world’s leading investment brands to mitigate their risks and reduce their costs while providing the agility to ensure they are first to market.

name: Madison Reed
description: Madison Reed offers at-home hair color, root touch-up, gloss, hair care, and styling products. Its product range includes permanent and demi-permanent hair color, treatments, shampoos, conditioners, and accessories designed for home hair coloring.

name: mcp-use (YC S25)
description: Manufact provides open-source developer tools and infrastructure for the Model Context Protocol.

name: Mode Analytics
description:
Mode Analytics is a developer of a collaborative analytics platform used to make data-informed decisions. It hosts a central repository of work and surfaces it to analysts in real-time, allowing them to address problems without needing to first recreate work.

Mode was founded in 2013 by Derek Steer, Benn Stancil, and Josh Ferguson in San Francisco, California.

name: Molten Salt Solutions
description: Molten Salt Solutions develops isotope enrichment and materials technologies for advanced nuclear and fusion energy applications. Its core technologies include proprietary chromatography separation and mass spectrometry systems for enriching stable isotopes, particularly lithium isotopes used in nuclear energy systems. The company develops high-speed countercurrent chromatography processes for large-scale isotope separation and production. Its lithium isotope enrichment technology targets lithium-6 and lithium-7 for applications including fusion fuel breeding and molten salt reactor systems. Molten Salt Solutions also develops chlorine isotope enrichment methods for applications involving molten salt reactors. Its technology portfolio includes metal salt synthesis and purification processes designed to produce materials with controlled chemical composition for nuclear applications. The company conducts analytical and materials development work to establish specifications for fusion-grade lithium and other isotope-enriched materials. Its services and technologies support the development and supply of specialized materials for advanced fission and fusion energy systems.

name: Mozza
description: Mozza engages in developing the science to create real dairy cheese from plants. Its mission is to make cheese from plants that are indistinguishable from cheese that comes from animals. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Los Angeles, California.

name: MURJ
description: Developer of a cloud-based device management software designed to streamline the care of patients with implantable cardiac devices.

name: Nectar Social
description: Nectar Social is an AI-powered platform that helps brands manage online communities, monitor social conversations, and analyze engagement across channels such as Instagram, TikTok, and direct messaging platforms. The company combines community management, social listening, influencer tracking, and performance analytics into a single system that allows businesses to track customer interactions and connect them to sales activity. Its platform includes AI-assisted tools for responding to messages, categorizing conversations, monitoring sentiment, and identifying trends or customer feedback in real time. Nectar Social also provides workflow automation and reporting features designed to help marketing, customer experience, and social media teams coordinate activities across multiple channels. The company primarily works with consumer-focused brands in sectors such as beauty, wellness, retail, and lifestyle, supporting their efforts to manage social engagement and customer communication at scale.

name: Neosensory
description: Neosensory focuses on sending a variety of data streams to the brain via the sense of touch. With so much unused real estate on the body, the skin presents huge potential for the delivery of new information. They are currently building the world’s first hearing assistive technology that enables people to listen with their skin.

name: Nexar
description:
Nexar creates powered dash cams that enable new vision-based applications for better driving. Nexar's mission is to reduce the chance of collisions and to make the road safer for everyone. Like a school of fish or a flock of birds, we want to get every car on the road moving safely and smoothly together. 

Using a Nexar-powered dash cam, AI, and inter-vehicle networking, Nexar makes every car a smart car and is building the world’s first safe driving network.

name: NoRedInk
description: NoRedInk helps millions of students in grades 4-12 become better writers. Our writing platform allows learners to improve through engaging, adaptive exercises and a proven process for self-review and peer review — and then delivers actionable performance data to teachers and administrators. Used in more than 50% of school districts in the US, we're on a mission to unlock every writer's potential.

name: OrgOrg
description: Keep your team connected and productive with OrgOrg's customizable productivity tools. Get everyone on the same page with branded new tabs and see where work is happening with Org links discovery and analytics.

name: Parry Labs
description: Parry Labs is a solutions provider to the U.S. Department of Defense and commercial companies. Parry designs and deploys solutions ranging from mission computing, power systems, manned and unmanned system architectures, and RF solutions. Parry’s Stellar Relay products are a full system suite of high-performance mission computing, Artificial Intelligence (A.I.) processing, and cross-domain systems.

name: PayNearMe
description:
PayNearMe is a provider of web and mobile-based cash payments platform designed to facilitate online purchases and bill payments. The company's platform helps users to pay with cash for a range of goods and services from companies in e-commerce, property management, consumer finance, and transportation, enabling businesses, government agencies, and retail stores to digitize their cash collection process, reduce the headache of traditional cash and money order acceptance.

PayNearMe's technology provides a simple way for lenders to collect payments through an intuitive, consistent experience for their customers. In addition, payment reminders and mobile wallet integration drive more on-time payments.

name: Pendulum
description: Pendulum Therapeutics believes therapies developed using evidence-based microbiome science and DNA sequencing can help heal the body from within. Armed with 13 patents and 42 pending, the company introduced its flagship product Pendulum Glucose Control, a medical probiotic, in 2020 and demonstrated its efficacy in lowering blood sugar spikes and reducing A1C in a published clinical trial. Founded in 2013 by a diverse team of scientists with deep microbiology, biochemistry, computational, and clinical expertise, Pendulum has raised $111 million to date from Meritech Capital, Sequoia Capital, True Ventures, Khosla Ventures, AME Cloud Ventures, and Mayo Clinic among others. Pendulum Therapeutics is headquartered in San Francisco.

name: Petasense
description:
Founded with a vision of making industrial machines smarter, Petasense is an Industrial IoT startup based in Silicon Valley. The company offers an end-to-end solution – comprised of a patent-pending wireless vibration sensor, cloud software, and machine learning analytics – that helps with asset reliability and predictive maintenance.

Customers are able to monitor, assess, and predict the health of their critical machines in real-time. This helps them reduce unplanned downtime and lower repair costs. Petasense's clients include industry leaders like JLL, C&W Services, Silicon Valley Power, and Stanford University.

Petasense is backed by True Ventures, Felicis Ventures, and top angel investors. The company is founded by serial entrepreneurs, Abhinav Khushraj and Arun Santhebennur, who have 25 years of combined experience in building enterprise companies, with degrees from MIT and IIT.

To learn more about Petasense, visit www.petasense.com.

name: PlanYear
description: Planyear operates in the insurance industry, offering a platform that simplifies the process of health insurance for businesses. It provides a digital solution that allows businesses to manage their health insurance plans more efficiently. The platform offers features such as plan comparison, cost estimation, and enrollment management. It aims to streamline the process of choosing and managing health insurance plans for businesses, making it easier for them to provide their employees with the necessary coverage.

name: Polsia
description: Polsia thinks, builds, and markets your projects autonomously. It plans, codes, and promotes your ideas continuously — operating 24/7, adapting to data, and improving itself without human intervention.

name: PraxisPro AI
description: Developer of an AI-powered training platform designed to transform pharmaceutical sales with bespoke training that keeps professionals in the territory. The company's platform specializes in customized role-play training, interactive learning modules, performance tracking, progress monitoring, AI-driven feedback, and recommendations, enabling users to measure growth and identify strengths through advanced algorithms that analyze performance and provide personalized coaching.

name: Prellis Biologics
description: Prellis employs holographic tissue printing technology with fully human antibody discovery, in vitro human disease, and ADME/Tox models.

name: Prime Roots
description: Prime Roots creates plant-based meats and seafoods that are made with koji mycelium. Natural koji proteins are used in the company's products to help reduce carbon-intensive reliance on animals through plant-based meat alternatives, giving meat eaters and vegans access to protein-rich food.

name: Primitive
description: We're building the future of human coordination.

name: Roark
description: Roark offers real-time statistics for chat and voice engagements in AI conversations across all communication channels. Technology assists organizations in tracking consumer sentiment, measuring performance, and pinpointing areas for improvement.

name: Rocketable
description: Rocketable is a software holding company that acquires existing software products and operates them using AI agents.

name: Rork
description: Rork is an AI-powered platform that lets you build complete, cross-platform mobile apps in minutes by simply describing what you want. It uses AI and React Native to generate fully functional apps—examples include visual novel games, Airbnb-style apps, meditation timers, and more. You can export these apps, use them on your phone, and even share them via QR codes or links.

name: Sailplane
description: Sailplane is a technology company focused on Hierarchical Planning AI research. The company is backed by venture capital and develops solutions that explore advanced methods for decision-making processes. The company continues to work on advancing research and development in the field of Artificial Intelligence.

name: Sandbar
description: Developer of an interface technology company designed to bridge the gap between humans and Artificial Intelligence for more intuitive digital interactions. The company's platform offers human-computer interaction tools, privacy-focused design, and Artificial Intelligence integration, enabling users to experience telepathic-like speed, enhanced control, and a natural extension of themselves in their digital environment.

name: Sherpa
description:
We're Sherpa and we’re passionate about freedom of movement. Our mission is to help travellers move freely around the world and to shift the way the world's leading travel providers approach border crossing.

Through unmatched industry knowledge and expertise, we help our partners—from airlines to cruise lines to online travel agencies—open new ancillary revenue streams to help them reduce costs and operational risk while enhancing the customer journey and growing consumer confidence in travel.

More than simply providing a product or service, we're moving travel forward. Away from stress and confusion, and towards ease and connection. So travellers can move freely wherever life takes them. This is the future of international travel.

name: Simple Ai
description: Simple AI is a software development firm that made an AI Assistant.

name: Sofar Ocean
description: Sofar Ocean is a build-accessible ocean sensing and exploration tool for ocean enthusiasts, industry, and conservation. The company builds accessible tools for ocean enthusiasts, industry, and conservation, operating a vast sensor network that provides real-time insights. Sofar Ocean is actively expanding its network of ocean monitoring devices and enhancing its data platform to integrate more robust predictive capabilities. It is also forming partnerships to improve global ocean monitoring systems and support climate resilience initiatives.

name: Solo.io
description:
Solo.io is the leader in modern, omni-directional API management and cloud-native application networking. Our platform empowers enterprises to seamlessly secure, connect, and observe APIs and microservices across any environment—Kubernetes, virtual machines, multi-cloud, or hybrid infrastructures.

Solo.io’s suite of products—Gloo Gateway, Gloo Mesh, and Gloo AI Gateway—enables platform engineering teams to standardize and automate API management across all traffic directions: ingress, east-west, and egress. This unique approach, powered by our deep integration with Istio Ambient Mesh and Envoy Proxy, eliminates legacy bottlenecks and enables scalable, decentralized architectures with zero-trust security, built-in tenancy, and self-service capabilities for developers.

Backed by a strong open-source foundation and contributions to CNCF projects, Solo.io is trusted by global enterprises like T-Mobile, Chick-fil-A, and Capital One to deliver API resiliency, governance, and performance at scale. Our omni-directional strategy is purpose-built for platform teams navigating the complexities of AI workloads, multi-cloud networking, and modern app delivery—helping organizations innovate faster without sacrificing control.

name: Stocktwits
description:
Stocktwits is a real-time financial communications platform for the financial and investing community. 

Stocktwits created the $TICKER tag to enable and organize “streams” of information around stocks and markets across the web and social media. These streams provide new forms of insight, ideas, and information that are used by investors, analysts, media, and others as they research stocks and manage their investments.

The company was founded in 2008 by long-time investor Howard Lindzon. 

Today, more than 300,000 investors, market professionals, and public companies share information and ideas about the market and individual stocks using Stocktwits, producing streams that are viewed by an audience of over 40 million across the financial web and social media platforms.

name: Submittable
description: Sphere Literary Magazine is an international journal of student writing, edited at Fairleigh Dickinson University.

name: Superposition
description: Superposition is an AI headhunter that learns your company.

name: TenetX
description: TenetX is the real-time governance layer for AI agents. We evaluate every agent action before execution and analyze the full multi-step journey, not just isolated events. TenetX uses Action Graphs and taint propagation to identify dangerous chains, such as sensitive data or secrets reaching an external destination, and blocks them before damage occurs. Our deterministic policy engine delivers fast, explainable decisions without AI in the hot path. Every agent session includes a complete audit trail, giving security and engineering teams the visibility and control to deploy coding agents and autonomous AI safely across development and enterprise workflows. name: TermScout
description:
We reduce friction in the contracting process by providing contract transparency, which powers trust and builds healthy relationships between buyers and their vendors.

Who is TermScout?

A team of lawyers, engineers, and business people who believe that knowledge is power. We’re scouts who read terms and other contracts, providing truthful, simple, and objective reports and summaries to help you make educated decisions about what companies you want to do business with.

What Does TermScout Deliver?

We reduce friction in the contracting process by providing contract data transparency, which powers trust and builds healthy relationships between buyers and their vendors.

We provide buyers with a summary of a vendor's contract and how that vendor's contract terms compare to that vendor's major competitors. By providing this information at the beginning of a contract review, buyers can more quickly move contracts through their review processes while at the same time realizing significant cost savings.

We provide vendors with two data products: 1) an Industry Report that provides an analysis of the contracts of that vendor's top competitors and 2) a Contract TermSheet that provides a summary of that vendor's customer contract terms.

The Industry Report is used by legal teams to review their company's customer contracts in relation to their major competitors - provision by provision. The Contract TermSheet is part of our Sales Accelerator Program used by sales teams to close deals more quickly by providing our data to their customers to save time in their customer's contract review process.

description:
CloudTrucks develops a virtual trucking carrier application designed to reduce operating costs for truck drivers. The platform helps to manage and book loads from brokers and shippers, offers instant payments after load delivery, and provides access to cheap insurance options, enabling truck owners and operators to strategize their schedule and design a revenue-maximizing driving program.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

name: CodeSignal
description: CodeSignal is how the world discovers and develops the skills that will shape the future. Our skills platform empowers teams to go beyond skills gaps, with hiring and AI-powered learning solutions, and helps individuals cultivate the skills they need to level up. Wherever you are on your journey, CodeSignal’s technical hiring and learning & development solutions meet you there and get you where you need to go. Having powered millions of skills evaluations, CodeSignal is trusted by leading companies like Netflix, Capital One, Meta, and Dropbox, and is used by learners across the globe.

name: Colla Health
description: Colla Health is building a wraparound care platform for cancer centers.

name: ConverzAI
description: ConverzAI enables recruiting and staffing teams to realize their revenue potential with readily deployable Voice AI. The ConverzAI Voice AI platform automates candidate screening at scale while maintaining the human touch. The company's recruitment solutions are transforming how businesses discover, engage, and onboard talent. Leveraging advanced AI technology and automation, ConverzAI’s enterprise-grade platform enables organizations to streamline their hiring processes, enhance candidate experiences, and make data-driven recruitment decisions.

name: Crosswise
description: The Compliance Management System That Builds Itself

name: Dedrone
description: Dedrone is an automated drone security platform; an extension of physical and cyber security into the airspace that protects a vulnerability gap exploited by the advances in consumer and commercial drone technology. Its aerial intrusion detection platform provides early warning of malicious drone activities and is used to protect data centers, prisons, airports, and other critical facilities from corporate espionage, smuggling, terrorism, and hacking.

name: Delfi
description: DELFI Diagnostics is developing next-generation, blood-based tests that are convenient, accessible, and reliable, offering a new way to help detect cancer. DELFI's proprietary technology leverages advanced AI to analyze patterns of circulating cell-free DNA fragments in the blood, an approach known as fragmentomics, to help detect lung cancer with high sensitivity. FirstLook Lung, the first commercially available blood-based screening test for lung cancer in the United States, serves individuals eligible for lung cancer screening through a simple blood draw that integrates with routine blood work. With a negative predictive value of 99.8 percent, the test identifies individuals at elevated risk for lung cancer, including early-stage disease, and guides them toward follow-up with guideline-recommended low-dose CT. Through novel health system partnerships, DELFI is pioneering electronic medical record (EMR) integration that makes blood-based testing available to historically underserved populations. FirstLook Lung has not been cleared or approved by the FDA.

name: Eleos Health
description: Eleos Health provides automated health tech solutions that accelerate clinicians’ decision-making via an AI-powered Speech-to-Insights system to ensure the provision of personalized and time and cost-effective care.

name: Enable
description:
Enable is a cloud-based software platform that helps distributors, manufacturers, and retailers to calculate, plan, and accrue rebate deals precisely to drive profitable growth. The company's mission is to build an ideal business-to-business deal management solution. Its products help companies acquire, retain, and serve their customers by working collaboratively with their trading partners using joined-up plans and incentive programs.

Enable was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

name: Encoded Therapeutics
description:
Encoded Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing genetic medicines for neurological disorders and other diseases. The company uses a genomics-driven platform to design precision gene therapies that regulate gene expression in specific cell types. Its technology combines regulatory element discovery, high-throughput genomic screening, computational modeling, and vector engineering to develop cell-selective therapies. Encoded’s lead program, ETX101, is a gene therapy candidate designed to modulate the SCN1A gene for the treatment of Dravet syndrome, a severe developmental and epileptic encephalopathy.

The company also develops preclinical programs targeting other neurological disorders and explores applications in liver, metabolic, and cardiovascular diseases. Its genetic medicines product engine includes preclinical development, delivery optimization, GMP manufacturing, and clinical development capabilities. Encoded operates its own research and manufacturing infrastructure to support the development of its wholly owned therapeutic pipeline.

name: Endgame
description:
Endgame is transforming enterprise sales by turning every seller into a trusted advisor. In a world where 88% of buyers only purchase from those they trust, yet 80% of sales meetings fail due to poor preparation, we believe there's a better way.

We've created the ultimate sales team amplifier by integrating your GTM strategy with first- and third-party data sources: emails, calls, CRM, LinkedIn, news, and financial reports. The result? An intelligent, actionable source of truth for every account and person in your book of business, instantly at your fingertips.

With Endgame, your team will never walk into a meeting unprepared again. Endgame isn't just helping your sellers see around corners; we're redefining what it means to stand out in today's market.

name: Envoy
description:
Envoy transforms modern workplaces, challenging the status quo with products that make office life and work more meaningful. Envoy has redefined how offices interact with visitors and manage deliveries in over 13,000 locations around the globe while building products for a new era of workplace experience. Companies like Slack, Asana, Pinterest, and Warby Parker rely on Envoy to create an unrivaled first impression and keep their offices secure and compliant.

With more than 100,000 new sign-ins every day, Envoy Visitors empowers workplaces to create a warm welcome for guests while safeguarding their people, property, and ideas. Envoy Deliveries ensures that packages safely reach their recipients at work, without mailroom pile-ups or communication delays.

name: Epiodyne
description: Epiodyne is using quantitative pharmacological and behavioral techniques to translate their insights into novel medicines for patients.

name: Eppo
description: Eppo provides an AB experimentation and feature management platform to make testing accessible to everyone in any organization. Its platform enables companies to tie product, AI, and marketing efforts to revenue and growth. The system allows every function in an org to adopt experimentation by easily integrating with cloud services, MarTech tools, AI products, and data warehouses.

name: Eve
description: Eve optimizes your casework from intake to resolution. Seamlessly integrate an AI case assistant that optimizes your firm into an AI-native powerhouse - securely and responsibly.

name: Everlaw
description:
Everlaw is a legal technology company that provides a platform for document analysis to law firms, government, and corporations. It is a cloud-based litigation platform for corporate counsels, litigators, and government attorneys that enables teams to discover, reveal, and act on information to drive internal investigations and positively impact the outcome of the litigation.

The company combines speed, security, and ease-of-use into a comprehensive solution that unlocks the collaborative power of teams and allows them to investigate issues more thoroughly, uncover a truth more quickly, and present their findings more clearly.

It was established in 2010 and is headquartered in Oakland, California.

name: FireHydrant
description:
FireHydrant is an incident management tool that helps companies recover from IT disasters more quickly. The company offers Incident Response, Process Automation, Incident Retrospective, and Incident Analytics solutions.

It was founded in 2018 by Robert Ross and is headquartered in New York, United States.

name: Fox Robotics
description: Fox Robotics develops autonomous forklift systems designed to automate trailer loading and unloading operations in warehouses and distribution centers. Its primary product, the FoxBot ATL, is an autonomous electric forklift that uses machine learning, computer vision, LiDAR, and real-time planning technologies to identify, pick, and transport pallets within loading dock environments. The company’s systems are built on standard forklift platforms equipped with safety-certified sensors and support both autonomous and manual operation. Fox Robotics' technology is intended to handle common warehouse conditions, including damaged or double-stacked pallets, while adapting to changing layouts through live mapping and localization. The company focuses on automating pallet movement at warehouse loading docks to improve the consistency and safety of material handling workflows.

name: Genesis Therapeutics
description:
Genesis Molecular AI – headquartered in Burlingame, CA, with a fully integrated laboratory in San Diego and offices in New York – is pioneering foundation models for molecular AI to unlock a new era of drug design and development. We are using a proprietary state-of-the-art generative and predictive AI platform called GEMS (Genesis Exploration of Molecular Space) to accelerate and optimize small molecule drug discovery.

The GEMS platform integrates AI and physics into industry-leading models to generate and optimize drug molecules, including the breakthrough generative diffusion model PEARL for structure prediction. GEMS accelerates hit identification through lead optimization and candidate selection by generating promising molecules for synthesis and experimental testing, and iterating this process through cycles of AI-enabled discovery and optimization. 

We have leveraged GEMS to build an internal pipeline with multiple programs against high-value targets, including data-poor and canonically undruggable targets where GEMS is uniquely advantaged. In addition, Genesis has signed AI platform collaborations across a range of therapeutic areas including Gilead (2024) and Incyte (2025).

Genesis has raised over $300M in funding from top AI, technology, and biotech investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Rock Springs Capital, T. Rowe Price, Fidelity, Radical Ventures, NVentures (NVIDIA's VC arm), BlackRock, and Menlo Ventures. To learn more about Genesis Molecular AI or current employment opportunities, please visit our website.

name: Goodfire
description: Goodfire summarizes products and services around AI interpretability research and tools that help organizations understand, debug, and design Artificial Intelligence models beyond traditional black-box approaches. It offers methods to translate internal model reasoning into human-readable insights, intentionally shape model behavior to align with specific objectives, and conduct foundational research into how neural networks work internally. The company delivers platforms and workflows that enable developers to inspect and modify model internals, extract useful knowledge from trained systems, and improve model behaviors for specialized use cases. Goodfire focuses on bridging scientific AI understanding with practical model design and application.

name: H1
description:
H1 is an AI-powered platform that helps identify and engage the right doctors for critical workflows across Pharma, Health Plan, Health System, and technology companies. At the core of the platform is H1’s Doctor Graph—a structured representation of physician identity, expertise, relationships, and behavioral signals, creating a powerful network effect as it is continuously enriched by participants across the healthcare ecosystem. Built on one of the world’s largest and most comprehensive global datasets of healthcare professionals, H1 combines deep healthcare data with agentic AI workflows to power critical workflows across drug development, medical and commercial engagement, care navigation, and provider data and network intelligence.

Founded in 2017, the company is based in New York, United States.

name: Harness
description: Harness is a software delivery platform that provides tools for automating code integration, testing, deployment, and verification across the software development lifecycle. It offers Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery pipelines, GitOps support, and AI-driven features that assist in generating and troubleshooting workflows without manual scripting. The platform includes modules for managing feature flags, Infrastructure as Code, artifact registries, and options for automating security and cloud cost controls. Harness also supplies an open-source edition that enables teams to configure development environments and manage end-to-end delivery processes from a unified interface. Its services aim to streamline release practices, reduce manual effort, and bring coherence to complex software delivery operations.

name: Heap
description:
Heap automates away the annoying parts of analytics so that companies can focus on making smarter business decisions. The company's mission is to power business decisions with truth. It encourages companies to focus on discovering insights and taking action. With Heap, organizations can remove technical jams and obtain a single comprehensive view of the customers. The software automatically gathers, organizes, analyzes, and connects customer data, so businesses can create more valuable products and experiences. Heap serves over 6,000 companies in ecommerce, SaaS, fintech, retail, media, and beyond including Twilio, LendingClub, App Annie, Optimizely, Morningstar, Monotype, and Casper.

Heap was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

name: Higgsfield AI
description: Higgsfield provides AI-powered tools for creating and editing images and videos. Its platform includes AI video generation, image generation and editing, cinematic scene creation, camera controls, visual effects, video upscaling, lip-syncing, and character creation. It also offers tools such as Marketing Studio, Cinema Studio, Canvas, Supercomputer, and integrations with various AI models for creative workflows.

name: HomeLight
description: HomeLight is a real estate platform that helps you to purchase and sell homes. Their platform can help you find a real estate agent based on local market data. Their suite of innovative products enables agents, lenders, and their clients to upgrade to all-cash offers, buy a new home before selling their current home, or create certainty through a modern closing process.

name: HOVER
description:
We are on a mission to create a single source of truth for the physical world.

Powered by deep learning and computer vision, Hover transforms smartphone photos of any property into an accurate, interactive 3D model, giving homeowners the power to unlock the true potential of their largest economic asset. With Hover, homeowners and contractors can receive exact measurements, design their home with different products and colors, and purchase materials directly through the app.

Thousands of exterior contractors are using Hover to save time and money on every project, establish instant credibility, and close more business. Hover’s insurance industry customers use the up-to-date measurements to reduce claim adjusting costs, decrease cycle times, and improve the overall customer experience. Hover is backed by Google Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Standard Industries, and The Home Depot, and has raised more than $87 million in funding to date.

Our team of creative, passionate, and talented engineers help us solve everyday problems with cutting-edge technology.

name: Immersive Labs
description:
With unmatched industry experience and cutting-edge expertise from the brightest minds in cybersecurity, Immersive is uniquely positioned to future-proof your organization against any cyber challenge. 

It brings cyber drills, exercises, simulations, ranges, and hands-on labs into one unified SaaS platform, allowing organizations to prove and improve their cyber resilience. By simulating real-world threats, testing skills, and measuring performance, Immersive puts organizations’ readiness to the ultimate test. From sharpening technical capabilities to making high-pressure decisions, the platform allows teams to assess from every angle, pinpoint areas for growth, and improve their ability to tackle evolving threats with unwavering confidence. So organizations can be ready to tackle the cyber threats of tomorrow.

name: Kinetic Automation
description: Kinetic is ushering in the next generation of mobility by building a modern infrastructure with a holistic system of hardware, robotics, software, and AI to revolutionize all aspects of the automotive repair industry. Kinetic's precision systems, powered by machine learning and software, are designed to provide rapid, accurate, and predictable maintenance and servicing for electric and autonomous vehicles.

name: Knoetic
description:
Knoetic is an online platform built for Chief People Officers and unifies a social network and a SaaS analytics tool in the same platform. Knoetic, a startup "built with Chief People Officers, for Chief People Officers," announced an $18M Series A round of funding led by Accel. Over 100 angel investors also participated in the round, including New York Times bestselling author Adam Grant, and executives from Box, Figma, Johnson & Johnson, LinkedIn, Scale, Pinterest, Calm, Front, and more.

Knoetic is the first company to unify a social network and a SaaS analytics tool in the same platform. By embedding its exclusive social network of 1,000+ world-class Chief People Officers, CPOHQ, directly into its people analytics software, the resulting "Insight Engine" gives CPOs both quantitative and qualitative insights, enabling them to make smarter, holistic decisions about their workforce.

Chief People Officers use Knoetic to build their board decks, present data to their CEOs, solve challenges with peers, and improve their employee retention, compensation, and hiring.

The rapidly-growing startup's customer and community base includes many of the world's top technology companies, including Lyft, Squarespace, Amplitude, Snyk, Dollar Shave Club, and Zapier.

Over 1,000 other Chief People Officers use Knoetic's exclusive, referral-only community (named CPOHQ) to discuss their most pressing challenges. These include navigating the COVID delta variant, transitioning to remote work, and scaling through hypergrowth.

name: Lovable
description: Lovable is a platform that lets you build apps and websites by chatting with AI. We are a small European team of serial founders, product engineers, physicists, competitive programmers and people who just care about building a great product quickly. We're on a mission to build the last piece of software that the world will ever need.

name: Luca
description:
Pricing Strategy is one of the most powerful levers that retailers have at their disposal to create growth, yet it is underleveraged. Most retail pricing teams settle for making decisions in spreadsheets, shooting in the dark, and working backward from a cost-plus margin target, leaving a LOT of money on the table.

Our founders experienced these problems at scale when they built pricing tech at UBER that made UBER a billion dollars in profit a year. They realized that retail was lacking the same quality and sophistication of price tooling. So, they built Luca.

Luca is an AI-powered co-pilot for retail operators, which constantly identifies revenue and profit headroom, makes recommendations for price adjustments, and saves countless work hours along the way.

Luca is backed by Y Combinator, Menlo Ventures, and others.

name: Manifest o.s.
description: Manifest OS is a legal technology company that provides infrastructure and operational support for law firms through a centralized platform and AI-based tools. The company offers services such as document drafting support, client communication management, billing, collections, and administrative operations, allowing attorneys to focus more on legal work. Its platform is designed to support law firms operating under a unified brand while maintaining independent legal practices. Manifest OS works with firms handling areas such as individual and corporate immigration law and provides fixed-fee and workflow management systems intended to improve transparency for clients. The company also employs teams across engineering, operations, legal operations, and product development to support its technology and service model.

name: Matik
description:
Matik provides an online platform that generates personalized customer presentations in minutes. The platform automatically generates native Google Slides or PowerPoint presentations with customized data inputs.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

name: Menlo Ventures
description: Menlo Ventures is a multi-stage venture capital firm investing in consumer, enterprise, and life sciences technology companies. Since 1976, it has backed innovators across sectors including marketplaces, SaaS, fintech, cybersecurity, and life sciences, with portfolio highlights such as Uber, Roku, Carta, Chime, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

name: Mimic
description:
Mimic Networks is a cybersecurity company that enforces a known-good state at the kernel level, blocking unauthorized changes to enterprise systems before they execute.

The company's platform profiles a system in its authorized operational state and then evaluates every subsequent change against that baseline at Ring 0. Where detection-based tools ask whether an activity matches a known threat, Mimic asks whether the change was authorized, which does not require identifying the attack. Enforcement operates through a file system mini-filter driver on Windows and eBPF on Linux, with enforcement logic running in a WebAssembly sandbox implemented in Rust.

The platform provides four capabilities: Ransomware Defense, which blocks the unauthorized changes ransomware depends on; AI Shield, which enforces declared scope for AI agents at the kernel regardless of credential validity; Virtual Patching, which covers the interval between vulnerability disclosure and patch deployment as well as end-of-life systems; and Change Control, which evaluates the change itself rather than the request that authorized it.

Mimic Networks was founded in 2023 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California. The company has raised $77 million. Its Series A was led by GV and Menlo Ventures, with participation from Ballistic Ventures, Team8, Wing Ventures, and Shield Capital. Kevin Mandia and Ted Schlein serve on the board of directors.

name: Negotiateai Inc.
description: NegotiateAI Inc. provides a procurement platform designed to analyze, benchmark, and automate negotiations for indirect spending. The platform aims to capture savings in manufacturing procurement by streamlining processes and enhancing efficiency.

name: Neon
description: Neon offers a serverless PostgreSQL architecture that separates storage and compute resources, enhancing scalability for applications. This open-source solution provides developers with flexibility and transparency, allowing them to manage their databases without the complexities of traditional systems. By leveraging a management-free environment, Neon enables faster application development, helping teams streamline their workflows. The platform is designed to support various data-driven projects while ensuring efficient resource utilization. Overall, Neon serves as a practical choice for developers seeking a modern database solution that simplifies operations and fosters innovation.

name: Netlify
description:
Netlify is the AI-native platform where agents and developers build together. Over 15 million developers and teams use it to build, launch, and scale web applications on a single platform, from independent builders to cross-functional teams at Bolt, Figma, Mattel, and Riot Games. Whether you're writing code or working with AI, Netlify takes you from prompt to live production URL in one workflow. Leading AI coding agents like CLAUDE CODE, CODEX CLI, and GEMINI CLI run directly inside the Netlify dashboard, which is agent-agnostic by design. Underneath sits managed Postgres with isolated branches per Deploy Preview, serverless functions, edge compute, and a global CDN. Every modern web framework is supported. 

That last part matters. Most AI prototyping tools hit a wall when it's time to ship. Teams build something quickly, then hand it back to engineering to rebuild on real infrastructure before it can scale. Netlify skips that step. The app you ship on day one is the app that scales. 

Netlify's CEO and co-founder, Mathias Biilmann, coined the term agent experience (AX) in January 2025. The company's long-term strategy is built around being the best place for agents and the humans directing them to build software together. The business model reflects that bet. Netlify was first in the category to pair credit-based usage tiers with flat, unlimited seats. Developers, PMs, marketers, and internal builders can all join the same plan for free and build alongside AI agents. It's a PLG motion designed for bottom-up enterprise expansion, with consumption driving growth instead of seat counts.

name: Nourish
description: Nourish is addressing the root cause of the chronic disease crisis through AI-powered, insurance-covered virtual nutrition care. We are tackling one of the most important problems in the world — our broken healthcare system. We are building a digital health system that is patient-friendly, prioritizes lifestyle change, delivers outcomes, and lowers costs.

name: Numeric
description: Numeric is an ai accounting automation platform, built to take manual work off accountants' plates so they can focus on what’s impactful. Numeric is currently used by hundreds of private and public companies to organize their close, automate reconciliations, and leverage ai for auto-drafted flux explanations and technical accounting research.

name: oak9
description: Oak9 is a cloud-native security built into application design so you can develop fast and innovate. Oak9's Security as Code platform dynamically secures Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and deploys cloud workloads, automatically.

name: Observable
description: Use Observable to make sense of your business. Explore data visually, conduct analysis, and build stunning charts and dashboards in our collaborative data canvas.

name: Observe.AI
description: Observe.AI is transforming customer service with AI agents that speak, think, and act like your best human agents—helping enterprises automate routine customer calls and workflows, support agents in real time, and uncover powerful insights from every interaction. With Observe.AI, businesses boost automation, deliver faster, more consistent 24/7 service, and build stronger customer loyalty. Trusted by brands like SoFi, DoorDash, Uber, Accolade, Prudential, Concentrix, Cox Automotive, and Included Health, Observe.AI is redefining how businesses connect with customers—driving better experiences and lasting relationships at every touchpoint.

description: OfferFit is an AI-powered experimentation platform that automates decision-making and personalization for businesses. It enables companies to optimize customer engagement strategies by continuously testing and learning from various offers and interactions. The platform leverages machine learning to deliver tailored recommendations, improving marketing effectiveness and customer experience.

name: Openrouter
description: OpenRouter is a platform that connects AI applications with large language models and cloud hosting providers, allowing users to optimize for costs, speed, and performance. The platform supports over 180 AI models, offers a unified API, and includes functionalities like private chat and exploratory data capabilities. OpenRouter sets the new benchmark for large-scale AI inference with its global edge infrastructure, privacy-focused design, real-time accounting, and integrated billing.

name: OpenSpace
description: OpenSpace is the Visual Intelligence Platform for builders — the category-defining platform that combines reality capture, Spatial AI, and field execution workflows for the construction industry. Leading builders worldwide, including Suffolk, Comfort Systems, and Tishman Speyer, rely on OpenSpace to verify work-in-place, track progress against plan, and reduce risk across their project portfolios. By capturing jobsites with smartphones, 360° cameras, and drones, OpenSpace turns construction reality into time-stamped documentation and actionable intelligence for every stakeholder. More than 20,000 users capture over 20 million images each week across projects worldwide.

name: Ophelia
description:
Ophelia offers medication and support for quitting opioids. They are a diverse collection of hearts and minds - doctors, scientists, techies, and citizens - on a mission to offer the best of medicine without the baggage of rehab. They are driven by science, committed to privacy, and bound to the client's right to make their own choices. They believe in recommendations, not orders.

It was founded in 2019 and is based in New York, New York.

name: Orb
description: Orb provides a platform for managing pricing, billing, and revenue for AI and software products. The platform supports usage-based, subscription, token-based, and hybrid pricing models, integrating usage tracking, invoicing, and financial reporting. Orb converts raw product usage data into accurate billing and reporting, enabling teams to monitor revenue, adjust pricing structures, and manage financial workflows. The system integrates with accounting, CRM, and payment tools to coordinate monetization across existing business processes.

name: Particle Health
description: Particle is an API platform for healthcare data exchange allowing patients and consumers to share their medical information. Its platform enables a single health record, tying together previously disparate information from a patient's various doctors and yielding valuable data insights in the process by combining healthcare records from thousands of sources. The platform then standardizes the data to FHIR R4 to ensure that they are usable at scale.

name: Pinecone
description: Pinecone develops a vector database that makes it easy to connect company data with Generative AI models. It combines vector search libraries, features such as filtering, and distribution infrastructure to provide reliability at any scale.

name: Platform9
description:
Platform9 is a leader in simplifying enterprise private clouds. Our flagship product, Private Cloud Director, turns existing infrastructure into a full-featured private cloud. Enterprise IT teams can manage VMs and containers with familiar GUI tools and automated APIs in a private, secure environment.

Enterprises are selecting Platform9's Private Cloud Director to migrate away from legacy virtualization platforms because it meets all of the following enterprise requirements:

- Familiar VM management experience
- Critical enterprise virtualization features: HA, DRS, networking, scale, reliability
- Compatibility with all existing hardware environments, including 3rd party storage
- Automated migration tooling that lowers cost barrier by 10x

Platform9 was founded by a team of VMware cloud pioneers and has over 30,000 nodes in production at some of the world’s largest enterprises, including Cloudera, EBSCO, Juniper Networks, and Rackspace. Platform9 is an inclusive, globally distributed company backed by prominent investors, committed to driving private cloud innovation and efficiency.

name: Pliant Therapeutics
description: Pliant Therapeutics Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on discovering and developing novel therapies for the treatment of fibrosis and related diseases.

name: Polly
description: Polly develops a mortgage capital markets technology platform for lenders and financial institutions. It provides product and pricing engines, loan trading solutions, data analytics, and workflow automation. The platform uses AI and machine learning to support loan pricing, eligibility, risk assessment, and decision-making across the mortgage lifecycle.

name: Prime Intellect
description:
Prime Intellect is an artificial intelligence infrastructure company that develops an open platform for training, deploying, and continuously improving AI models and agents. It combines AI infrastructure, Reinforcement Learning (RL) tooling, compute orchestration, and open-source research to make frontier AI training accessible to organizations of all sizes. Its platform enables enterprises and researchers to build, evaluate, fine-tune, and deploy custom AI models while leveraging globally distributed compute resources.

The company's platform provides an integrated stack for compute, RL post-training, evaluation, inference, and agent development. Its offerings include hosted model training on thousands of Reinforcement Learning environments, evaluation tools with public leaderboards, one-click deployment for fine-tuned models, and infrastructure that continuously feeds production data back into training workflows. Prime Intellect also operates an Environment Hub containing thousands of open-source RL environments and develops Prime-RL, an open-source framework for large-scale asynchronous Reinforcement Learning.

name: Prodigal
description:
Prodigal builds AI agents for loan servicing and collections and is purpose-built for consumer finance.

With AI agents, automation, and actionable insights in one platform, Prodigal helps financial institutions collect more payments faster while staying fully compliant. Our intelligence engine (PIE) is trained on half a billion consumer finance interactions, delivering up to 27% more digital engagement, 16% more payments, and 30% more agent effectiveness.

We serve collection agencies, direct lenders, credit unions, and healthcare RCM providers with solutions including proAgent (voice AI agent), proCollect (omnichannel engagement), proInsight (analytics & QA), proNotes (automated documentation), proAssist (agent copilot), and proPay (payment portal).

name: Qualia
description: Qualia is the leading real estate digital closing platform used by over half a million real estate and mortgage professionals. Qualia's cloud-based closing rooms provide the complete infrastructure to streamline the home closing and refinance experience for real estate and mortgage businesses and their clients. The company offers a suite of products that brings together homebuyers and sellers, mortgage lenders, title & escrow agents, and real estate agents onto one secure, remote platform. Since launching in 2015, the company has been named an ALTA Elite Provider, CB Insights Fintech 250, grown to over 500 employees, and has been recognized by Forbes as a Best Startup Employer. The company is a leader in industry security and was the first technology company to join the Coalition to Stop Real Estate Wire Fraud. Qualia is headquartered in San Francisco, CA, and has offices in Austin, TX, and Superior, CO.

name: Qualio
description: Qualio is a cloud-based quality management software system designed for life science companies. Qualio empowers medical device, pharmaceutical, biotech, and contract organizations to get to market faster, boost revenue, and cut risk. Over 500 companies in 80 countries use Qualio to embed and automate GxP, FDA, and ISO compliance. Qualio unites your teams, processes, and data in a single source of truth that supports a quality culture and makes your business stronger, fitter, and more competitive.

name: Recursion Pharmaceuticals
description: Recursion is a clinical-stage biotechnology company decoding biology by integrating technological innovations across biology, chemistry, automation, data science, and engineering, with the goal of radically improving the lives of patients and industrializing drug discovery. Central to our mission is the Recursion Operating System, or Recursion OS, that combines an advanced infrastructure layer to generate what we believe is one of the world's largest and fastest-growing proprietary biological and chemical datasets and the Recursion Map, a suite of custom software, algorithms, and machine learning tools that we use to explore foundational biology unconstrained by human bias and navigate to new biological insights which may accelerate our programs. We are a biotechnology company scaling more like a technology company.

name: RelationalAI
description: RelationalAI is building a groundbreaking relational knowledge graph system for developing intelligent data apps.

name: Relyance AI
description: AI-native protection that makes every data journey visible, controlled, and compliant. From the first line of code to the final AI output, autonomously predict threats, enforce policies, and always be audit-ready, eliminating 80% of manual oversight.

name: RightHand Robotics
tags: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
description:

Their robots grasp a wide variety of items from bins and cases. Their core technology enables them to do this automatically without laborious data entry or parameter tuning, so they are inexpensive to set up and flexible to the changing needs of businesses.

The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Somerville, Massachusetts.

name: Riva Health
description: Riva Health is building the future of cardiovascular healthcare. Riva’s breakthrough cardiology technology measures and manages hypertension, all through a smartphone app and camera. The company is led by co-founders Dag Kittlaus and Tuhin Sinha and confronts the leading cause of mortality in the United States, heart disease.

name: Rivet
description: Rivet is fixing the adversarial relationship between healthcare providers and payers, arming providers with more sophistication and productivity to improve financial transparency and operational efficiency.

name: Sana
description: Sana focuses on improving how businesses create, organize, and access information across teams and departments. The company offers products that combine AI-driven search, content creation, and learning capabilities to streamline knowledge sharing within enterprises. Sana’s technology is designed to adapt to various industries, supporting workflows that require the efficient handling of large volumes of information.

name: Semgrep
description: Semgrep is a tool for static code analysis that helps improve software security and reliability. Semgrep aims to significantly enhance software security and reliability by providing top-notch security tools to both engineers and developers. Semgrep believes that the security process should facilitate swift software development rather than obstruct it.

name: ShipBob
description:
