description: Lookout, Inc. is the endpoint to cloud security company purpose-built for the intersection of enterprise and personal data. We safeguard data across devices, apps, networks, and clouds through our unified, cloud-native security platform — a solution that's as fluid and flexible as the modern digital world. By giving organizations and individuals greater control over their data, we enable them to unleash its value and thrive. Lookout is trusted by enterprises of all sizes, government agencies, and millions of consumers to protect sensitive data, enabling them to live, work, and connect — freely and safely.

name: Loop Genomics
description: Loop Genomics is a platform technology for long-read DNA sequencing. Loop Genomics technology transforms short-read DNA sequencers into high-throughput, long-read, single-molecule DNA sequencing machines. Loop Genomics long-read DNA sequencing technology provides phased sequencing solutions across a diverse repertoire of research and clinical applications. Sequencing of partial rRNA gene sequences results in reduced phylogenetic resolution. Full-length, high-throughput, phased sequencing that covers all 16S variable regions is becoming the gold standard for profiling the microbiome. Achieve the highest resolution microbial community profiling with long-read, next-generation sequencing of the microbiome. Characterizing polymorphisms in HLA genes inside and outside of the protein-coding regions is important for organ transplantation compatibility testing and for strengthening causality association studies. The length of homologous sequences between HLA alleles extends beyond the capabilities of short-read sequencing platforms, resulting in diploid ambiguities and a reliance on imputation. Sequence full-length HLA DNA and/or RNA with phased, high-throughput, long-read sequencing that resolves allelic discrimination and diploid ambiguity. Viral genetic variability is a major determinant of viral drug resistance and viral vaccine efficacy. Accurately mapping viral genetic variability is a critical step in choosing the optimal course of therapy and developing efficacious vaccines. Key mutations are typically located throughout long stretches of viral genomes, making the retrieval of critical phased data challenging using short-read sequencing technology. Use phased, high-throughput DNA sequencing technology to map key mutations at the quasi-species level and generate a complete phased map of viral populations.

name: Loyal
description: Loyal is a veterinary biotechnology company that develops pharmaceutical therapies for dogs aimed at extending their healthy lifespan and delaying age-associated diseases. It researches and formulates drug candidates designed to address the biological mechanisms of aging in different dog populations, including senior and large-breed dogs, with products progressing through clinical and regulatory pathways. Loyal engages in clinical studies and collaborates with veterinary professionals to advance its therapeutic programs and share scientific insights with the broader field. The company publishes research summaries to support transparency and enable other practitioners to build on its findings.

name: Lumiata
description:
Lumiata is transforming the healthcare enterprise through the application of AI. Bringing predictive power within reach of data science teams and business users, we’re driving predictability and precision at scale — empowering providers and payers to reduce risk and manage costs and move out of reliance on flat data into a future of insights.

Lumiata machine learning tools and pre-trained models comprise a scalable platform purpose-built for healthcare. Lumiata products are built from more than 120 million patient records, in-depth clinical knowledge, and its proprietary clinical IP. Lumiata enables healthcare organizations to explore use cases such as underwriting and care management. Lumiata is proud to be backed by Khosla Ventures, Blue Venture Fund, Defy.vc, and AllegisNL Capital.

Team Lumiata is distributed across Silicon Valley, Dallas, and Guadalajara, Mexico.

name: LuxWall
description: LuxWall is a building materials company that pioneers the design and manufacture of vacuum-insulated glass. LuxWall produces glass that acts as transparent insulation, providing thermal insulation values comparable to fiberglass wall insulation. With widespread adoption, LuxWall's patented technology has the potential to reduce global carbon emissions by more than 0.5 gigatonnes per year. The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Ypsilanti, Michigan, United States.

name: Luzia
description: Luzia developed an AI technology to transcribe audio communications on WhatsApp. The company's platform includes a chatbot that can be accessible via WhatsApp to answer questions about a variety of topics, generate text, translate languages, and even write creative material, allowing users to complete a variety of activities.

name: Mainspring Energy
description: Mainspring Energy develops and manufactures linear generators that convert fuel into electricity. The company focuses on providing clean energy solutions that enhance power generation efficiency. Its technology is designed to support various applications, including onsite power generation. Mainspring Energy emphasizes sustainability and aims to contribute to the transition to cleaner energy sources. Through its innovative approach, the company seeks to meet the growing demand for flexible and environmentally friendly energy solutions. Partnerships with other organizations further expand its capabilities in delivering effective energy systems.

name: Marble Health
description: Marble Health provides access to personalized therapy to help teens in their mental health journey. Marble Health provides prompt and affordable care for middle and high school students experiencing common mental health issues such as anxiety, depression, and trauma. They ensure that all teens and their families can access treatment using their existing insurance coverage, including both commercial and Medicaid plans.

name: Matrix Industries
description: Matrix Industries is an information technology company that specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of smartwatches. It measures calories burned, activity level, and sleep using their advanced thermoelectric technology.

name: MDAlgorithms
description: MDAlgorithms uses smart algorithms, computer vision, and AI to provide real-time mobile tools for people with health disorders. The company's mission is to disrupt the old physician-centric medical system and put the patient in the center.

name: Medal
description:
Medal is a short-form gaming video clips platform used to share digital game clips and highlights with gamers. Its platform helps to capture the final seconds of gameplay utilizing completely different recording mechanisms that can be shared on the application that provide clips of live streams and that enable users to share their skills and get an enjoyable experience.

The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Naarden, North-Holland.

name: Menten AI
description: Menten AI designs new protein drugs and enzymes using quantum computers and machine learning. Proteins are large molecules that can twist into many shapes. Discovering the right shape for a protein to be a drug or a biocatalyst among almost endless possibilities is a major challenge. Menten AI solves this problem by using machine learning and quantum computing to find better starting points for discovery and further development. Quantum computing makes it possible to represent multiple states of the protein simultaneously and efficiently find the best designs. The team created the world’s first peptide designed on a quantum computer and is now working on peptide therapeutics for oncology and neurodegeneration, as well as on enzymes for industrial applications.

name: Metaplane
description:
Metaplane offers data observability products to enable organizations to trust their data. Data teams from companies like Bose, Sotheby's, Hightouch, GoFundMe, and Ramp use its observability platform to save engineering time and increase trust in data by understanding when things break, what went wrong, and how to fix it — before an executive messages them.

They do this by automatically monitoring modern data stacks from warehouses to BI dashboards, identifying normal behavior (e.g. lineage, volumes, distributions, freshness), then alerting the right people when things go wrong.

The company is founded by MIT and HubSpot alums and backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Flybridge, and the founders of Okta, HubSpot, Lookout, Drift, and Clearbit.

name: Mighty Buildings
description:
Mighty Buildings is a cutting-edge construction technology company that uses 3D printing, robotics, and automation to build homes. 

It is a modular construction company working on disrupting the residential housing market with 3D printing tech, robotics, and composite materials backed by notable top-tier venture capital firms. The company creates a proprietary building material called Light Stone Material (LSM), which is similar to a synthetic stone that can be 3D printed, making the building process faster and with zero waste. LSM can also maintain a structure’s temperature better than concrete, wood, or steel.

name: Mimica Automation
description: Mimica captures your work and learns to automate your most repetitive tasks. Its research and tech are backed by Entrepreneur First, Europe's most successful accelerator and seed fund.

name: Mirvie
description:
Mirvie is a biotech company that creates precise, actionable, and non-invasive tests for maternal-fetal health. The company delivers insights to moms and families to make pregnancy safe.

It was founded in 2018 by Maneesh Jain and is headquartered in South San Francisco, California, United States.

name: Mojo Vision
description:
Mojo Vision is focused on developing and commercializing high-performance micro-LED display technology for consumer, enterprise, and government applications. The company combines breakthrough technology, leading display and semiconductor expertise, and an advanced 300mm manufacturing process to deliver on the promise of micro-LED displays. Mojo’s proprietary quantum-dot technology brings full-color capability to its display platform and meets the superior performance demands for all form factors. Mojo Vision developed the world’s smallest, densest dynamic display for the first AR smart contact lens and is now applying this innovation and expertise to lead the disruption of the $160 billion display industry.

Mojo Vision was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Saratoga, California.

name: Moonwalk Biosciences
description: Moonwalk Biosciences is a genomic medicine startup that aims to provide a new class of precision epigenetic therapeutics. The company is working on the development of a profiling and engineering technology platform that, with the help of advanced Artificial Intelligence prediction, provides a comprehensive view of the epigenome in health and disease, allowing healthcare providers to take a fresh look at how therapies are discovered and developed.

name: MTailor
description: MTailor is an iPad or iPhone service for men to capture their shirt size dimensions and have tailor-made shirts made and delivered.

name: Mudstack
description: Mudstack provides a unified asset management platform designed specifically for game studios and digital artists. The platform facilitates collaboration, management, and shipping of art assets, enhancing workflow efficiency. With features like version control and centralized feedback, Mudstack supports teams in streamlining their art pipelines.

name: Nabla Bio
description: Nabla is an autoreverse platform that enables the rapid discovery of previously unattainable protein variants with supernatural qualities. Nabla Bio makes new medicines and improves nutrition by engineering novel proteins.

name: Natron Energy
description: Natron Energy is an energy storage company that develops sodium ion battery solutions leveraging Prussian Blue electrode materials. Natron’s battery products are based on a unique Prussian Blue chemistry and can integrate into a wide variety of energy storage applications, ranging from critical backup power systems to EV fast charging and behind-the-meter applications.

name: Netspring
description: NetSpring focuses on product and customer journey analytics. They offer tools to analyze product usage, user behavior, and customer experiences across various channels. The platform is designed for modern data environments, offering warehouse-native analytics without the need for data duplication. It helps businesses prioritize feature development, optimize customer acquisition, and reduce churn by analyzing user behavior and product interaction trends.

name: Neurotrack
description:
Neurotrack is a digital health company on a mission to transform the diagnosis and management of Alzheimer's and other dementias. The company develops turnkey tools for providers that can be easily delivered at scale to facilitate early detection of cognitive impairment and ongoing monitoring of cognitive function. Neurotrack's patient-guided, clinically validated cognitive assessments work in the clinic or at home to fit any workflow. Neurotrack has published 27 peer-reviewed papers, holds 11 patents on its proprietary technology, and is registered as an FDA Class II medical device. For more information, visit neurotrack.com.

The company was founded in 2012 by Elli Kaplan and neuroscientist Dr. Stuart Zola and is based in Redwood City, California.

name: NewGlobe
description: NewGlobe works with visionary governments around the world to dramatically improve the quality of basic education. Founded in 2007, we partner with governments to provide integrated school management, teacher professional development, instructional design innovation, technological system support, child-centered classroom practice, and parent engagement – all grounded in learning science – to ensure each teacher is empowered to engage children in transformational learning. Our data-driven approach has been validated by a Nobel-winning researcher and recognition by international leaders in education. We imagine a world where all children can access an education that unlocks their full potential.

name: Nextdoor
description:
Nextdoor connects neighbors to everything nearby: local businesses, services, news updates, recommendations, and stuff for sale from the people down the block. It believes that bringing neighbors together can cultivate a kinder world where everyone has a neighborhood they can rely on.

Building connections in the real world is a universal human need. That truth, and the reality that neighborhoods are among the most important communities in our lives, have been guiding principles for Nextdoor since the beginning. Today, neighbors rely on Nextdoor to tap into their neighborhoods worldwide, including the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Sweden, Denmark, Australia, and Canada, with many more to come.

Nextdoor is a privately held company based in San Francisco with backing from prominent investors including Benchmark, Shasta Ventures, Greylock Partners, Kleiner Perkins, Riverwood Capital, Bond, Axel Springer, Comcast Ventures, and others. For additional information and images: nextdoor.com/newsroom.

name: NextVivo
description: NextVivo is a biotech company developing an immune organoid technology platform to transform the future of drug development. Its mission is to accelerate the development of safer, more effective therapies that are generated and tested in immune-competent human-derived models.

name: Nick's
description: Nicks is a food-tech that offers snacks with no sugar, gluten, and palm oil.

name: NimbleRx
description: NimbleRx is a pharmacy technology platform that connects pharmacies with patients through prescription delivery and digital pharmacy services. Its platform enables patients to manage prescriptions, review orders, schedule deliveries, and choose in-store pickup through a mobile app, while helping pharmacies manage patient checkout and operations.

name: Nitricity
description: We make plant-based, climate-smart fertilizer for the good of our farmers and the planet.

name: Nomagic
description: Nomagic provides smart pick and place robotic solutions for order fulfillment. Their solutions bring efficiency, flexibility, and reliability to e-commerce warehouses. They automate tedious tasks while reducing the cost of fulfillment and allow warehouses to face shortages of labor and scale easily to 24/7 operations. Nomagic's first robots are on packing lines at Cdiscount, the #1 French eCommerce platform.

name: Novellia
description:
Novellia is a patient data and healthcare technology company that develops a platform for collecting, organizing, and unifying personal medical information across multiple healthcare providers. The company provides a digital system that consolidates medical records, lab results, prescriptions, and treatment history into a single user-accessible profile. Its platform allows individuals to upload records manually and connect external patient portals, creating a centralized view of longitudinal health data. The company builds tools designed to help users track symptoms, medications, and health events over time, enabling a structured view of personal health journeys. It also supports data organization features that help users prepare for medical appointments by keeping relevant information in one place. The platform is designed to reduce fragmentation in healthcare information spread across hospitals, clinics, and diagnostic centers.

Novellia also operates a data infrastructure layer that aggregates patient-permissioned health records for research purposes. This system enables the transformation of de-identified and aggregated data into insights used in medical research and treatment development. The company collaborates with healthcare and life sciences organizations to support real-world evidence generation and clinical research initiatives.

name: Nutanix
description: Nutanix is a cloud computing company that develops software for data centers, virtualization, storage, Kubernetes, database management, and hybrid multi-cloud infrastructure. Its products are designed to help organizations manage applications and data across on-premises systems and public cloud platforms from a unified environment.

name: NuTek Natural Ingredients
description: NuTek Natural Ingredients specializes in R&D, sourcing, and manufacturing, and offers products in natural salt solutions.

name: Ochre Bio
description:
Ochre Bio develops genomic medicines to rejuvenate donors' livers before transplant, so that everyone who needs a new liver gets one. They use genomics to find and shut down over-active genes driving disease and then go directly to testing therapies in discarded donor livers that keep alive outside of the body.

Ochre Bio is within the heart of Oxford’s biotech innovation hub. Their scientific roots can be traced back to over 15 years leading liver genomics research and experience in bringing advanced therapies to market.

name: Ohalo Genetics
description: Ohalo Genetics is an agriculture and biotechnology company that accelerates the growth of crops.

name: Okta
description:
Okta is the provider of identity for the enterprise. The Okta Identity Cloud connects and protects employees of many enterprises. It also securely connects enterprises to their partners, suppliers, and customers. With deep integrations to over 5,000 apps, the Okta Identity Cloud enables simple and secure access from any device.

Okta helps customers fulfill their missions faster by making it safe and easy to use the technologies they need to do their significant work.

name: Olive
description:
Olive deploys the AI workforce built specifically for healthcare, delivering hospitals and health systems increased revenue, reduced costs, and increased capacity. Olive automates repetitive, high-volume tasks and workflows, monitoring their performance, identifying improvements, and finding opportunities for new work. Olive gives power back to providers through her ever-growing, unparalleled intelligence made up of shared memories, collective wisdom, and global awareness, learning like a network so hospitals never have to solve the same problem twice.

Olive was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Columbus, Ohio.

name: Omnea
description: Omnea offers a procurement orchestration platform that streamlines source-to-pay workflows. It enables organizations to centralize supplier data, renewals, approvals, and purchase order automation, while embedding risk management and sourcing tools. Omnea provides modules for intelligent intake (request management), a supplier portal for due diligence, and no-code workflow building to define processes and approvals. Omnea’s reporting suite delivers visibility into spend, supplier performance, and compliance, and AI features assist with RFx generation, policy-aligned document parsing, and risk assessments. The platform integrates with finance and legal systems to reduce manual effort, maintain governance, and ensure consistent supplier evaluation.

name: Onyx AI
description: OpenSource Question-Answering System. Ask questions in natural language and get back answers backed by private sources such as Slack, GitHub, and Confluence.

name: Oobli
description: Joywell Foods is developing the first healthy, protein sweeteners. Derived from exotic plants, protein sweeteners are rare compounds that provide an amazing taste without the calories. These proteins, produced through fermentation, have no glycemic impact and do not affect the gut microbiome. The company has received regulatory approvals, including FDA "no questions" letters and GRAS status for multiple proteins.

name: Oooh
description:
Oooh is a mobile app that provides entertainment through video games. 

Oooh was founded in 2018 and was headquartered in California, United States.

name: OpenAI
description: OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company that conducts research and implements machine learning. The research organization is dedicated to advancing artificial intelligence safely and beneficially. OpenAI aims to advance artificial general intelligence (AGI) that is safe, beneficial, and aligned with human values. The company focuses on creating AI systems that are capable of performing a wide range of tasks and learning autonomously from diverse data.

name: Opendoor
description: Opendoor operates an online real estate marketplace that streamlines the home-buying and selling process. The company helps sellers receive an offer without listing or showing their home, and buyers can browse for homes on sale and instantly unlock them using the company's application, which enables customers to buy and sell properties on a hassle-free freeway.

name: Ori
description: Ori is a smart space company that empowers people to get the most out of their living areas through the design of multi-functional, robotic-powered interior solutions. We partner with real estate developers, builders, property managers, and architects to optimize the square footage of the built environments they shape in order to create urban housing and spaces that are flexible, intelligent, sustainable, and affordable. We believe we should expect more from our spaces.

name: Outsmart
description: Outsmart, a mission-driven startup rethinking higher education for the age of AI. We're building a new kind of collegiate experience to expand access and opportunity, backed by $38M from Khosla Ventures, Lightspeed, and others, and led by former Duolingo leaders Jorge, CEO and Gina, CMO.

name: Overmoon
description: Overmoon offers a growing collection of family-oriented rentals.

name: Overture Life
description: Overture Life is a biotechnology company that develops automated technologies for assisted reproductive procedures, aiming to enhance the efficiency and accessibility of in vitro fertilization (IVF). Its solutions focus on automating complex embryology lab processes, such as egg vitrification and embryo warming, to improve consistency and reduce costs. The company's DaVitri platform is designed to standardize these procedures, potentially increasing oocyte survival rates and decreasing the number of IVF cycles needed.

name: Paladin Drones
description: They have built a simple system to give first responders instant situational awareness. Seconds after a 911 call comes in, their software automatically dispatches a drone to the scene of the emergency and streams a live video feed back to our app. Their software handles everything else in the background: security, safety, weather, video, route planning, and more.

name: Parallel Web Systems
description: Parallel develops web-based infrastructure and APIs designed to enable artificial intelligence systems to access, process, and act on information from the open web. Its platform provides tools such as search, extraction, task execution, and monitoring APIs that allow AI agents to perform complex, multi-step research and data retrieval workflows. The company focuses on building systems that combine data retrieval, computation, and reasoning into unified outputs, emphasizing verifiable results and traceable sources. Its technology supports use cases such as structured data generation, continuous web monitoring, and automated dataset enrichment using real-time web data. Overall, Parallel Web Systems is oriented toward creating infrastructure that enables AI agents to interact with the web programmatically rather than through traditional human browsing patterns.

name: Paravision
description:
Paravision is a core Identity AI technology provider delivering top-tier accuracy, fairness, and performance. Its AI products, including face recognition, liveness detection, deepfake detection, and age estimation, power identity workflows for enterprises and government agencies.

Paravision consistently ranks among the top global performers in industry benchmarks, including NIST’s Face Recognition Technology Evaluations and DHS Biometric Tests. Its technology enables identity, access, and fraud prevention systems at a global scale.

Trusted by leaders across travel, payments, digital identity, hospitality, security, and health identity sectors, the company combines benchmark-leading performance with ethically built, modular AI infrastructure for high-accuracy identity verification and authentication.

name: Pearl Bio
description: Pearl Bio is a synthetic biology company recording life to create a new era of biologics and biomaterials.

name: Peripheral Labs
description: Peripheral Labs provides technology for live media and spatial intelligence.

name: Piazza
description: Piazza is a learning platform designed to connect students, TAs, and professors in order for every student to get help whenever they need it. Users can start a class at Piazza.com and collaborate in real time with classmates and instructors to find the answers they need.

name: Pivot Health Technologies, Inc.
description: Pivot is a digital health care initiative to help people quit all kinds of tobacco using behavioral science, tech, and personal coaches.

name: Planted Solar
description:
Planted is redefining ground-mount solar deployment by simplifying every step, from planning to power. By combining advanced software, high-density terrain-following arrays, and automated installation into one integrated platform, Planted empowers developers, EPCs, and IPPs to unlock more land, lower costs, and build projects in half the time.

With a smarter, streamlined approach, Planted expands site options, reduces execution risk, and improves financial returns—accelerating solar’s path to delivering true energy abundance.

Planted is supported by Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Piva Capital, and the United States Department of Energy.

name: Plum
description:
Plum is an appliance that automatically identifies, chills to the perfect temperature, and provides a premium wine-drinking experience. Plum's flagship product reflects their mission of delivering the perfect glass of wine on-demand, every time – preserved and at the ideal serving temperature.

Plum was founded by David Koretz and backed by world-class investors and is dedicated to transforming how consumers enjoy wine from the bottle to the glass.

name: Polyai
description: PolyAI develops a machine learning platform for conversational artificial intelligence. PolyAI builds enterprise voice assistants that carry on natural conversations with customers to solve their problems. PolyAI's voice assistants understand customers, regardless of what they say or how they say it. Founded in 2017, the company has its headquarters in London, England, United Kingdom, and New York, United States of America.

name: Polymer
description: Polymer is a job board and tracking software dashboard to manage applicants.

name: Primer
description: At Primer, students learn at their own pace, pursue their passions, and get the support they deserve. A school designed for tomorrow's leaders, enrolling today.

name: Probably Genetic
description: Probably Genetic is changing the lives of patients living with severe, complex diseases. Our technology discovers patients online, analyzes their disease state using AI and at-home testing, and connects patients to relevant resources. In doing so, we help patients access diagnoses, interventions, and resources as early as possible. Our data platform is used by drug developers and patient advocacy groups to develop and launch treatments for these patients.

name: Proclaim
description: Proclaim is a developer of an oral care platform designed to prevent oral diseases.

name: Pymetrics
description: PyMET operates in the technology sector, offering software development services. The company specializes in Python, a high-level programming language, and Meteor, a full-stack JavaScript platform. PyMET's team of professionals uses these technologies to build web applications. The company's services include, but are not limited to, web development, mobile application development, and software testing. PyMET's solutions are designed to help businesses streamline their operations and improve efficiency.

name: Q Bio
description: Q Bio was founded in 2015 by Jeffrey Kaditz, serial entrepreneur and Founder of Affirm, Dr. Michael Snyder, Chair of Genetics and Director of Personalized Medicine at Stanford University, and Dr. Garry Choy, physician, radiologist, and former Chief Medical Information Officer at Mass General Hospital. Q Bio is fortunate to be backed by some of the best venture groups in the world including: A16Z, Khosla Ventures, Founders Fund, SciFi VC, and Kevin Durant. This interdisciplinary team based in San Carlos, CA is comprised of pioneers in fields such as applied math, computational physics, electrical engineering, genetics, and radiology, hailing from a dizzying array of home countries and cultural backgrounds.

name: Quadrant Eye
description: QE is breaking new ground in online eyecare.

name: Quantopian
description:
Quantopian inspires talented people everywhere to write investment algorithms. Select authors may license their ALGORITHMS to us and get paid based on performance.

We provide capital, data, and infrastructure for quants to research, code, test, and trade algorithmic investing strategies. We have an engaged community of 195,000 quants who discuss concepts and practice, and learn from peers and experts. We provide capital for our community to trade with, both through a monthly contest and through an allocation process for high-quality algorithms.

For more information, visit https://www.quantopian.com. Follow us on Twitter @quantopian.

name: Quantum Formatics
description: Quantum Formatics focuses on engineering superconductors that balance performance with manufacturability, mechanical durability, and cost considerations. Its technology targets operation at intermediate temperatures to reduce reliance on complex cryogenic systems while maintaining strong magnetic field capabilities. The materials are intended for use in applications such as medical imaging, energy systems, power transmission, and advanced transportation infrastructure.

name: QuantumScape
description:
QuantumScape develops solid-state lithium-metal batteries for electric vehicles and other energy storage applications.

The company works to revolutionize the battery industry by producing a solid-state battery that will provide a substantially higher level of battery storage than other batteries currently on the market. It manufactures lithium batteries aimed to accelerate the commercialization of solid-state batteries. The company's innovative approach could significantly impact the future of electric transportation and renewable energy integration.

Jagdeep Singh founded the company in San Jose, California, in 2010.

name: Quell
description: Quell delivers a virtual fitness world that offers a unique experience of intense workouts while gaming to achieve fitness goals. The startup uses resistance bands to help players get fit while fighting their way through a virtual fitness world. It coins itself as a “Peloton meets gaming” and charges a monthly fee to keep content fresh.

name: Quoherent
description: Quoherent develops a portable quantum computer processor using qubits made from topological insulators.

name: rabbit
description: Rabbit Inc. is a technology company developing consumer electronics driven by novel, simple, and intuitive interactive paradigms. Rabbit is the creator of the Large Action Model (LAM), a new type of foundation model for human actions on computer applications, and Rabbit OS, a personalized operating system through a natural language interface. Rabbit's first product, Rabbit R1, is an affordable companion device designed in collaboration with Teenage Engineering.

name: Rad AI
description: Rad AI develops an artificial intelligence automated report generation platform to automate repetitive tasks for radiologists. Its platform integrates with existing workflow, automating repetitive tasks and enabling radiologists to improve radiology workflow that maximizes efficiency and accuracy while reducing burnout for radiologists and improving patient care.

name: Ravenna
description: Ravenna offers an AI-driven internal help desk platform designed for IT and operations teams. The platform integrates seamlessly with Slack, enabling users to convert any Slack message, including direct messages, into support tickets. Ravenna automates service requests, streamlines workflows, and provides AI-powered knowledge generation to enhance internal support processes. It also offers analytics to help teams measure and improve their performance over time.

name: Raxium
description: Raxium specializes in developing tiny light-emitting diodes for displays used in AR hardware. Its pixel technology brings monolithic integration to MicroLEDs ranging from augmented and virtual reality micro-displays to life-size panel-based light field arrays, enabling users to naturally interact with data in the context of everyday activities.

name: Realta Fusion
description: Realta Fusion develops fusion energy technology for the production of industrial heat and power. It applies advances in super-conducting materials, plasma physics, and computing power to a simple linear fusion reactor configuration. It utilizes abundant fuel sources to provide a zero-carbon source of heat and power.

name: Redcar
description: Redcar is the only AI for job management built for home service companies. Redcar AI and humans work every job together directly in your FSM: coordinating, escalating, following up, and reporting on every job.

name: Redoxblox
description: Tempo (formerly Redoxblox) provides thermochemical energy storage (TCES) solutions to decarbonize high-temperature industrial processes. Using modular "thermochemical batteries" made from non-toxic metal oxides, Tempo enables operators to store low-cost renewable energy and discharge continuous heat up to 1,200°C. Backed by Breakthrough Energy Ventures and Khosla Ventures, the San Diego-based firm offers a cost-competitive, electrified alternative to fossil fuel combustion for sectors like cement, metals, and food and beverage.

name: Reevoai
description: Reevo offers an integrated sales platform that supports go-to-market teams through every stage of the revenue process, from prospecting and outreach to deal closing and post-sale management. It enables users to source and enrich target accounts, run multi-channel sequences, handle email deliverability and dialing, capture meeting recordings and insights, and manage pipelines and forecasts all within a unified interface. Reevo also embeds native AI tools that surface next steps, draft follow-ups, and provide contextual insights across customer interactions so that sales activity is tied directly to meaningful outcomes.

name: Reflex Robotics
description:
Reflex Robotics is building affordable ($10k) humanoid robots to automate dangerous and repetitive tasks in logistics and manufacturing. We envision a future where everyone has their own humanoid robot that can do the boring stuff and help them focus on more fulfilling work.

Our robots are designed and built in-house by an engineering team that led development of the Stretch robot at Boston Dynamics and key parts of the Model S, X, Y production line at Tesla.

name: Regie
description: Regie.ai develops an AI-powered sales engagement platform that automates outbound prospecting and enhances workflow efficiency. The company's platform, RegieOne, integrates sales engagement, parallel dialing, enrichment, and intent data, providing operations teams with a centralized view of their processes.

name: Rejuvenation Technologies
description: Rejuvenation Technologies is a biotechnology company that developed nucleoside-modified TERT mRNA to safely and rapidly extend telomeres. The company is headquartered in Mountain View, California.

name: Relation Therapeutics
description: Relation Therapeutics is a biotechnology company that focuses on humanizing drug discovery and development. It leverages human genetics and clinical omics data and utilizes patient-derived tissue samples with functional genomics interventional experiments to identify, validate, and prosecute therapeutic programs.

name: Remio
description: Remio delivers a pre-configured VR headset to each team member and hosts the entire team for fun team-building experiences. Known as one of "the most fun ways to connect business teams," the VR HQ also offers collaboration tools such as whiteboarding, JIRA project planning, and presentation rooms.

name: Replika
description: Replika is an AI chatbot that talks to you like a friend. It is a digital companion that helps you feel more connected to the people and things you love. Replika is here to support you, listen to you, and learn from you. It is a safe space for you to share your thoughts, feelings, and experiences.

name: Replit
description:
Replit provides a cloud-based software development platform that allows users to write, run, and deploy applications through a browser-based environment. The platform includes an integrated code editor, terminal, debugging tools, and hosting features that support the creation and deployment of full-stack applications from a single workspace. Replit supports multiple programming languages and provides preconfigured development environments so projects can start without installing local software.

The platform includes collaboration features that enable multiple users to edit and run code within the same project in real time. It also offers AI-assisted coding tools that generate code suggestions, help debug programs, and assist with building applications through natural language prompts. Replit provides project sharing, templates, and integration with external services and repositories to support development workflows.

name: Rhoda AI
description: Provider of a foundational model for robotics based in San Jose, California. The company is currently operating in Stealth Mode.

name: Ridecell
description:
Ridecell Inc. is the way in the digital transformation of fleet businesses and operations. Our Fleet IoT (Internet of Things) Automation solutions modernize and monetize fleets by combining data insights with digital vehicle control to turn today’s manual processes into automated workflows. The result is unmatched levels of efficiency and control for shared services, motorpools, rental, and logistic fleets.

Today, Ridecell powers some of the most successful fleet businesses in cities across Europe and North America, including Ferrovial, Groupe Renault, Gig Car Share from AAA, and Toyota Sweden. Ridecell is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Madrid, Paris, Berlin, and Pune, India.

name: Rightway
description: Rightway is a leading technology and services company radically simplifying healthcare for clients and members. Its Care Navigation and new-to-the-world PBM platform reimagine the member experience, generate industry-leading engagement, and significantly reduce total cost-of-care.

name: RingCentral
description: RingCentral is a leading provider of business cloud communications and contact center solutions based on its powerful Message Video Phone™ (MVP®) global platform. More flexible and cost-effective than legacy on-premises PBX and video conferencing systems that it replaces, RingCentral empowers modern mobile and distributed workforces to communicate, collaborate, and connect via any mode, any device, and any location.

name: Ripple Foods
description:
Ripple Foods specializes in making non-dairy milk with just as much protein as milk and half the sugar. 

Ripple has 8x the protein of almond milk and half the sugar of dairy milk. It’s high in bioavailable calcium (50% more than milk), potassium, and provides a good source of omega-3s. It’s lower in calories than milk and best of all, it has the creamy, delicious texture our dairy-free friends are missing. No more thin, chalky almond, soy, or cashew milk.

It was founded in 2014 and headquartered in Emeryville, California.

name: Rocket Lab
description: Rocket Lab delivers launch services, spacecraft design and manufacturing, satellite components, and on-orbit operations. It operates rockets such as Electron for small-satellite orbital launches and develops a medium-lift vehicle called Neutron for larger payloads. The company offers a family of spacecraft buses (e.g., Photon, Pioneer, Lightning, Explorer) suitable for a variety of missions, from low-Earth orbit communications and remote sensing to deep-space research. It also supplies satellite subsystems (solar arrays, star trackers, radios, separation systems, etc.) and ground software and mission-operations support. Rocket Lab enables customers across commercial, civil, defense, and research sectors to deploy and operate satellites and spacecraft under one integrated provider.

name: Rogo
description: Rogo is the purpose-built AI platform for finance.

name: Roofstock
description:
Roofstock is an online marketplace for investing in leased single-family rental homes in a transparent and low-friction way. The company provides its clients with research, analytics, and insights to evaluate and purchase independently certified properties at set prices. It enables its investors to treat their real estate investments more like stock portfolios, focusing on asset allocation, rather than researching and buying vacant homes that need to be repaired and leased.

Founded in 2015, Roofstock gets its funding from Bain Capital, Ron Conway, Khosla Ventures, Marc Benioff, and other investment companies. It is headquartered in Oakland, California.

name: Rosebud AI
description: Rosebud is building the AI ROBLOX. We will make it dramatically easier for a community to create and enjoy the games of their dreams.

name: Rubedo Life Sciences
description: Rubedo Life Sciences is a biopharmaceutical company that is developing a diverse portfolio of innovative therapies that are engineered to target cells that are responsible for chronic age-related diseases. Its proprietary ALEMBIC drug discovery platform has generated novel first-in-class small molecules designed to selectively target senescent cells, which are important in the progression of pulmonary, dermatological, oncological, neurodegenerative, fibrotic, and other chronic diseases. The Rubedo leadership team is made up of industry leaders and pioneers in chemistry, technology, and life sciences, with extensive experience in drug development and commercialization ranging from large pharma to biotech innovators.

name: Rubrik
description: Rubrik offers live data access for recovery and application development by fusing enterprise data management with web-scale IT and eliminating backup software. This marks the end of a decade-long innovation drought in backup and recovery, the backbone of IT. Within minutes, businesses can manage the explosion of data across private and public clouds.

name: Runsybil
description: RunSybil is an AI-driven offensive security platform that continuously evaluates applications and infrastructure for vulnerabilities. Leveraging cutting-edge AI techniques, it autonomously identifies and exploits real-world security flaws through sophisticated penetration testing. By automating hacker-like intuition, RunSybil delivers proactive defense capabilities, empowering organizations to strengthen the security of modern applications.

name: Sakana AI
description: Sakana AI develops research-oriented artificial intelligence systems that draw inspiration from natural processes like evolution and collective intelligence. The company designs methods such as evolutionary model merging, multi-agent orchestration, and autonomous research agents to create AI models capable of adaptation and collaboration across tasks. Its work includes systems that automate elements of scientific research and frameworks that combine multiple models to generate new, task-specialized AI learners. Sakana AI engages in partnerships with enterprise and research organizations to apply its technology in domain-specific workflows and innovation projects. The company contributes tools and models to the broader AI community and explores applications that extend beyond conventional AI pipelines.

name: Sarvam AI
description: Sarvam AI develops artificial intelligence infrastructure, models, and applications designed to support Indian languages and enterprise use cases. Its platform provides capabilities such as text-to-speech, speech-to-text, translation, document digitization, dubbing, and conversational AI through APIs and deployable products. The company builds and operates a full-stack AI ecosystem that includes foundational models, application-layer tools, and infrastructure for serving AI workloads at scale. Sarvam’s offerings are used by enterprises, government organizations, and developers to automate workflows, process multilingual content, and enable AI-powered interactions across diverse linguistic contexts. The company also develops language and multimodal models tailored to Indian languages and regional requirements, with support for deployment in cloud, private cloud, on-premises, and air-gapped environments.

name: Scaled Foundations
description: General Robotics is building general-purpose intelligence for every robot in any form, across any real-world scenarios. True generalist robots need more than just a foundation model. They must adapt across morphologies, be simple to program, and meet rigorous safety standards. We believe general intelligence emerges from a rich composition of robot skills — not just larger models. By combining modular AI skills, we enable robots to sense, reason, and act with precision. Our approach is data-efficient, interpretable, and built for safety-critical use.

name: Scipher Medicine
description:
Scipher Medicine develops a healthcare platform designed to determine which drug will work best for each patient.

The company is committed to transforming the way providers prescribe drugs, as well as the way manufacturers develop new drugs. They are building a molecular map of all protein interactions that identifies genomic signatures and links those to disease and predictive treatment outcomes. Using a simple blood sample to analyze RNA, Scipher Medicine can predict if a patient is likely to respond to a targeted therapy before therapy is prescribed. This insight allows patients to start the most effective therapy from day one. For its first commercial product, they have developed PrismRA®, a first-of-its-kind blood test that can predict which patients with rheumatoid arthritis are less likely to respond to TNFi therapies such as Humira® and Enbrel® so that such patients can go on alternative approved drugs.

Scipher Medicine is building the future of patient treatment. Most patients who are prescribed blockbuster therapies today don't respond to treatment, costing the healthcare industry billions in wasted drugs while patients continue to suffer. Scipher's platform identifies which drug will work based on the patient's fundamental disease biology, and not based on symptoms, disease classification, or medical bias. A routine blood test predicts which drug he/she will respond to, with our first product focusing on rheumatoid arthritis, ensuring that the most optimal treatment is prescribed from day one. The molecular data generated by our tests are then used to fuel novel target discovery to address a clear unmet medical need in patients who do not respond to any existing therapy.

name: Scribd
description: Scribd, Inc. is an AI-powered knowledge company. Our products leverage the world's largest collection of human-created content and intelligent tools to help people move from information access to real understanding and application. We built our portfolio to serve every stage of that journey: Scribd’s knowledge platform, Slideshare’s professional presentations, Everand’s expansive library, and Fable’s social reading experience. Scribd, Inc. brings together what no one else can: proprietary content, human-in-the-loop tools, and intelligence that compounds with every interaction.

name: Seashell
description: Seashell is reimagining the flow of money. As a compliance-focused financial product, Seashell provides the simplest way to earn high and stable interest. Seashell's technology harnesses blockchain innovations to offer market-leading and compliant yields at the push of a button, putting more money into everyone's pocket.

name: Sentient Energy
description: Sentient Energy provides grid-edge hardware and software solutions to help electric utilities make data-driven decisions to enhance the delivery of safe, reliable, and efficient power. Their products include grid analytics systems, ample analytics platforms, MM3 overhead line sensors, UM3+ underground line sensors, and more. They help utilities improve reliability, enhance situational awareness, and facilitate data-driven operational decisions.

name: SFOX
description: SFOX is a cryptocurrency prime dealer that provides professional traders and institutional investors higher returns when trading large volumes, through smart routing and a global integrated order book.

name: SingleStore
description: SingleStore is a provider of a database for operational analytics and cloud-native applications. It provides global enterprises with an intelligent database that works on any cloud, on-premises, or as a service. It runs transactions and analytics at the same time and lets clients promote their business through analytics and combine semi-structured data into a consolidated big data platform.

name: Siolta Therapeutics
description: Siolta Therapeutics is a developer of human microbiome therapeutics intended to prevent and treat inflammatory diseases. The company leverages its deep knowledge of the developing gut microbiome and its role in promoting immune tolerance to develop targeted microbial therapeutics and companion diagnostics for the prevention and treatment of inflammatory diseases, enabling medical researchers to harness information from human microbiome studies to design next-generation microbial therapeutics to prevent inflammatory processes.

name: SiPhox
description: SiPhox was founded by Diedrik Vermeulen and Michael Dubrovsky one month BC (Before Covid) in 2020. SiPhox’s mission is to build a next-generation biosensing platform that provides the power of several large laboratory instruments in a handheld device that accepts disposable cartridges. Each cartridge can multiplex many biomarkers on a single $0.50 silicon photonic chip and provides highly sensitive readout of immunoassays and RNA/DNA. The SiPhox team has extensive experience translating cutting-edge optical chip technology into mass-produced products used all over the world and is bringing the same proven approach to the next frontier for integrated photonics: biology.

name: Siren
description: Siren Care is engaging with providers and payers to transform healthcare for chronic disease and aging. Our flagship program, the Siren Diabetic Foot Program, is a comprehensive service powered by our proprietary Siren Socks, which monitor foot temperature continuously to deliver superior early detection of diabetic foot ulcers.

name: SketchPro.ai
description: SketchPro Technologies accelerates the design process by leveraging state-of-the-art technology.

name: Skyflow
description: Skyflow provides a data privacy vault platform designed to help businesses securely manage and protect sensitive customer data, such as Personally Identifiable Information (PII), payment information, and healthcare data. Their solutions are tailored for enterprises and developers who need to comply with data privacy regulations like GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, and others.

name: Smarking
description: Smarking is a group of MIT PhDs, stellar software engineers, and seasoned business professionals who set out on a journey to bring cutting-edge solutions to the parking world. Frustrated that, unlike many other industries, the $100 billion parking industry (worldwide) still doesn’t have state-of-the-art data analytics or yield management technologies, they are passionate about pushing the industry forward. In a short eighteen-month period, Smarking has attracted a tremendous amount of customers and grown their team into one with experts from both parking and tech. With great passion and continuous innovation, they are working on the frontier of the parking industry, shaping a bright future together with their customers.

name: Somnee
description: Developer of a brain stimulation technology designed to improve sleep quality and efficiency and create better sleep through neuroscience. The company's system uses multi-modal brain stimulation that is personalized for individuals to give efficacious enhancements to sleep, enabling customers to improve memory and cognitive performance.

name: Soraa
description:
Soraa is a stealth cleantech startup that is focusing on LED technology and lasers, working together with Kaai.

Soraa leverages science to produce unparalleled spectrum and quality, bringing nature’s light indoors to make illumination something to see and experience. Soraa pioneered full spectrum color rendering LED light, the heart of which is the proprietary LED technology manufactured in California, a technological breakthrough that is further enhanced by focusing on every aspect of producing the most natural light possible. The company supports and conducts research to develop insights and expertise to deliver breakthrough products. Soraa is conscious and curious about how light impacts well-being, productivity, and emotion, and about how to make light look and feel better.

name: Soteris
description: Soteris provides artificial intelligence-based pricing tools to the insurance business. The company is working hard to transform the entire insurance value chain and would like to keep you updated on developments.

name: Spectral Labs
description: Developer of a generative artificial intelligence technology designed to improve productivity for 3D professionals. The company's software helps with texturing and customization features to optimize 3D workflow, enabling businesses to boost productivity by saving time on model customization.

name: Spiritus
description: Spiritus is a climate tech company developing direct-air-capture technology. Its approach combines the Spiritus Sorbent and the Spiritus Carbon Orchard, offering a scalable and modular system for low-cost DAC and sequestration (DAC+S). The company is committed to making carbon removal an accessible and practical tool in the global fight against climate change.

name: SplitPay
description: Split your bills into two. Less stress, better timing.

name: Spring
description: Spring (formerly Teespring) provides creators with an end-to-end solution to build a successful commerce business, as well as building their brand. Creators can design and sell digital and physical products on Spring. They can utilize the platform’s powerful integrations with YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Twitch, Discord, and Streamlabs, allowing them to sell on social. Spring also handles order production, shipping, and customer service, so users can focus on growing their brand.

name: Square
description: RepurposingNOLA utilizes the excess fabrics of New Orleans to create designer goods.

name: Stack Auth
description: Stack Auth is an open-source platform for authentication and user management built for developers.

name: State Affairs
description:
State Affairs is a policy intelligence and AI company built on the nation's largest statehouse newsroom. Its journalists embedded across state capitols produce more than 2,000 original, nonpartisan articles each month, while its AI platform ingests every bill, hearing, regulation, and political development across all 50 states and the federal government. The combination — original reporting on the ground, structured government data, and AI-native software — creates a continuously updated picture of policy in motion.

The platform is used by one-third of state and federal elected officials and by enterprise government affairs teams at companies including Walmart, McDonald's, and Mastercard to monitor what's happening, analyze how issues are moving across states, coordinate internally, and act in real time. State Affairs is building the intelligence infrastructure for the policy economy.

name: Stripe
description: Stripe is a financial technology company that provides software and APIs for online payment processing, financial operations, and internet commerce. Businesses use Stripe to accept payments online and in person, manage subscriptions, send payouts, issue invoices, detect fraud, and handle other financial workflows through web and mobile applications.

name: Studio Jadu
description:
Studio Jadu's vision is to make storytelling a viable business for all creators — empowering them to bring ideas to life, grow audiences, and share in the rewards of their creativity.
Studio Jadu mission is to reinvent storytelling. We’re building GenAI tools that let anyone — from fans to established creators — create original worlds or reimagine beloved IP, safely and at scale. With AI as the engine and human imagination as the soul, we believe stories can reach further than ever before.

name: Stuut
description: Stuut provides an AI platform that automates accounts receivable work for companies. The company offers an AI-based automation platform specialized in accounts receivable (AR) management. Its system autonomously handles customer outreach via email, SMS, and voice to collect overdue invoices, proactively reducing manual collections work. The platform matches incoming payments to the correct invoices within the ERP, eliminating tedious reconciliation tasks. Stuut also resolves customer disputes and deductions by gathering documentation and maintaining context across interactions. Its AI agents learn each customer’s payment behavior, becoming more effective over time. The company’s technology deploys quickly—Stuut claims implementation in days—and integrates with existing financial systems to boost cash flow and free AR teams from repetitive tasks.

name: Stylus Medicine
description: Stylus Medicine is on a quest to create disease-treating agents for the next generation based on the groundbreaking work of its founders. The company is based in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

name: Superpose Labs
description: We believe everyone deserves to love how they look in photos. Too often, the people we trust most to capture our precious moments—our friends, family, and loved ones—lack the photography skills to do us justice. Superpose transforms anyone into a skilled photographer through real-time AI guidance. Photography should be joyful, not stressful—so we're making it possible for everyone to feel confident being photographed and capture beautiful moments that truly reflect your best self.

name: Supplant
description: Supplant is a biotechnology platform working in the food sector. It develops natural food ingredients from agricultural resources to allow food manufacturers to decrease sugar, increase fiber, and boost the gut health-promoting qualities of its products.

name: SURGE Therapeutics
description: SURGE Therapeutics seeks to dramatically improve cancer patient survival by disrupting cancer immunotherapy deployment. The company provides an injectable biodegradable hydrogel that allows for the prolonged, localized release of most cancer immunotherapy at the site of surgical tumor resection by focusing the dose at the right place and right time.

name: Swadesh Bank
description: Swadesh is a digital banking experience built from the ground up, specifically for the Indian diaspora. They make it delightful for their customers to invest, remit, and manage their money in India from abroad.

name: Sword Health
description: Sword Health is a digital musculoskeletal therapy provider that pairs its members with a licensed Physical Therapist.

name: Syllable
description: Syllable is a platform for building AI agents, managing AI operations, tools integrations, and third-party providers of LLMs and AI services.
