description: Nile is disrupting the enterprise network market by modernizing IT operations with a new AI networking architecture, delivering enterprise networks entirely as a service. For the first time in the industry, its Nile Access Service integrates zero trust security and offers performance guarantees. With Nile, IT organizations close the gap between their digital aspirations and legacy realities, reduce their total cost of ownership by more than 60%, and recover critical IT resources while their users gain superior connectivity. For more information, visit nilesecure.com/journey.

name: Nimbus Health
description: Breeze Medical System enables paper-based or electronic medical records to be shared and stored online using an Application Service Provider (ASP) model.

name: Nines
description: Nines is the first-of-its-kind teleradiology practice. Our radiologists and engineers are on a mission to build world-class tools in-house to enable the best radiologists to deliver the best patient care.

name: Noble Money
description: Noble Money is on a mission to make sound money accessible to every human.

name: Notable
description: Notable is the AI platform for healthcare operations. Deployed at over 10,000 sites of care, Notable automates over a million repetitive workflows every day across Registration and Intake, Scheduling and Referrals, Assistant, Authorizations, Care Gap Closure, and HCC Chart Review. The result: personalized, streamlined care for patients, the elimination of burdensome manual work for caregivers, and improved financial health for healthcare providers.

name: NuID
description: NuID is a pioneer in trustless authentication and decentralized digital identity. The NuID platform leverages zero knowledge cryptography and blockchain technology to eliminate the need for businesses to store passwords and other authentication credentials. NuID’s unified protocol for strong authentication supports passwords, tokens, and biometrics—enabling businesses to reduce security risks and streamline user experience. Our mission is to end wide-scale credential breaches by returning data ownership to the individual.

name: Nutcracker Therapeutics
description:
Nutcracker Therapeutics is a biotech company that develops and produces mRNA therapeutics on its proprietary, microfluidic, and biochip-based platform. The company specializes in a fully integrated system for the production of mRNA therapeutics at the push of a button that enables scalable on-demand experimental and manufacturing capacity, thereby enabling healthcare companies to produce complex multimodal therapeutics at the point of care.

Nutcracker Therapeutics combines the productivity of RNA biology with innovations inspired by semiconductor manufacturing techniques to develop a proprietary miniaturized platform that enables the rapid discovery, development, and manufacturing of mRNA therapies and vaccines. Its ACORN platform is a first-of-its-kind, computer-controlled RNA manufacturing system that starts with a nucleic acid sequence of interest and produces optimized nanoparticle-encapsulated RNA therapeutics on dedicated, single-use biochips.

Igor Khandros and Benjamin Eldridge established the company in Emeryville, California, in 2018.

name: Oklo
description: Oklo develops clean energy plants to provide emission-free, reliable, and affordable energy using advanced fission. Oklo’s first product, the Aurora, produces 1.5 MW of electric power and can save 1,000,000 tons of carbon emissions during its operation compared to other forms of power generator alternatives. It converts nuclear waste into clean energy and can produce clean energy for decades without refuelling.

name: Onda AI
description: Onda AI provides client assessment and underwriting processes and rapid access to cyber insurance.

name: ONEHOPE
description: OneHope is a social enterprise that sells wine and other products and services to raise awareness and funding for charitable organizations and social causes, as well as donates half of its profits to charity, enabling its customers to contribute to social causes.

name: Opencare
description: Opencare is transforming the dental industry by creating the first premium dental care network. With Opencare, patients can have confidence that they are getting top quality care, and top dentists can grow their practice with ease.

name: OpenComp
description:
OpenComp empowers high-growth companies to confidently make the best business decisions with compensation intelligence. More than 2,000 companies use OpenComp to attract and empower top talent in fair, consistent ways, including Calm, DataRobot, Discord, DrChrono, Figma, Medium, Mosaic, Mux, and Reddit.

Founded in 2021 by Thanh Nguyen and Nancy Connery, Salesforce’s founding HR team, OpenComp has raised $24 million in venture capital from J.P. Morgan, TIME Ventures (the investment fund for Marc Benioff), 8VC and more.

OpenComp is available for free for organizations up to 50 employees, with tiered pricing and services for other organizations based on size and needs.

name: OpenGov
description: OpenGov is a provider of modern cloud software that enables government operations for local governments and state agencies. The company's software is designed specifically for the public sector's particular budgeting, procurement, and community development requirements.

name: OpenTeams
description: Welcome to OpenTeams—where AI isn’t a mystery box, but a tool you control. We’re not here to sell you off-the-shelf software and call it a day. We’re AI architects, building open source solutions that put you in the driver’s seat. Our mission? To empower government agencies, enterprises, and their partners with transparent, customizable AI that scales with ambition and respects your ownership—of data, code, and outcomes.

name: Opto Investments
description: Opto Investments offers a complete solution for independent investment advisors to access private market investments.

name: Orca Bio
description: Orca Bio is a clinical-stage cell therapy company dedicated to delivering curative medicine to patients. Orca Bio has developed a pipeline of proprietary technologies that have the potential to impact over 100 malignant and autoimmune diseases. Orca has assembled a team of world-leading experts and technologists to execute this vision.

name: Orchestra
description: Orchestra BioMed is a biomedical innovation company that develops therapeutic products for procedure-based medicine. The company collaborates with medical device companies to advance its product candidates. Orchestra BioMed's pipeline includes BackBeat Cardiac Neuromodulation Therapy™ (BackBeat CNT™), an investigational treatment for hypertension, and Virtue® Sirolimus AngioInfusion™ Balloon (Virtue SAB), a drug/device combination product for treating artery disease.

name: Oula Health
description: Oula is redesigning maternity care from the ground up. Its modern maternity center combines obstetrics and midwifery care to deliver a more evidence-based and personalized pregnancy experience. The company provides a standard for pregnancy that unifies modern medicine and human intuition.

name: Our Place
description: At Our Place, they believe in the power of home-cooking to bring people together. Their mission is to create products and experiences that celebrate cultures, honor traditions, and cultivate connections.

name: Outrider
description: Outrider is a software company automating logistics hubs with electric, self-driving trucks. The company helps large enterprises improve safety and increase efficiency. Outrider works with logistics-dependent enterprises to eliminate manual tasks that are hazardous and repetitive.

name: Outset
description: Outset provides an AI-moderated research platform that helps research teams conduct, analyze, and share qualitative and quantitative studies. It offers tools for designing research guides, recruiting participants, running AI-moderated interviews in multiple formats and languages, and generating synthesized summaries and reports. The platform supports workflows that move from question setup through automated analysis to stakeholder communication. Outset’s services aim to streamline the research lifecycle and make insights available quickly for strategy and decision-making. This platform is used by teams to explore customer needs, test concepts, evaluate usability, and gather feedback at scale.

name: Overland AI
description: Overland AI develops autonomous ground vehicle technology for tactical and operational applications. The company designs fully autonomous vehicles capable of navigating rugged terrain and GPS-denied environments, integrating seamlessly with human-operated systems. Its core technologies include OverDrive, an autonomy stack for off-road maneuvering; OverWatch, a command and control platform for coordinating multiple vehicles; and SPARK, modular hardware that enables autonomy on existing platforms. Overland AI focuses on minimizing risk to human operators while enhancing operational capabilities, supporting applications in defense, wildfire response, and logistical operations. The company emphasizes modularity, tactical versatility, and autonomous coordination to extend ground power in challenging environments.

name: Pact
description: Pact develops a platform that automates asynchronous task management and communication. It tracks commitments between people at work. Pacts are created within Slack and updated by each person using automated messages. Analytics on past performance and current blockers are sent frequently to drive accountability and trust without extra meetings.

name: Pair Team
description: Pair Team is on a mission to build the primary care infrastructure for vulnerable communities. They are the first tech-enabled care team that empowers safety-net primary care systems and the MEDICAID & MEDICARE patients they serve. They act as an extension of the clinical staff to provide a personalized, high-touch care experience while addressing patients' barriers to care such as lack of transportation, housing/food insecurity, and mobile phone access. Internally, they are building a unique care delivery platform to ensure clinical best practices, integrate care with community-based organizations, and automate administrative work so clinicians can focus on patient time.

name: Parallel Fluidics
description: Parallel Fluidics is a new microfluidics manufacturing company out of Boston. The company started in 2019 to solve a problem they’d faced firsthand as engineers: it’s hard to get quality microfluidic prototypes, fast.

name: Paravel
description: Paravel is a designer and manufacturer of luggage bags and travel accessories. The company's product catalog includes luggage, kits, and accessories hand-painted and customized with appliqué designs and monograms.

name: PathAI
description: PathAI develops artificial intelligence software and digital pathology systems used in diagnostic workflows, clinical research, and drug development. The company provides AI-powered tools that analyze tissue samples and pathology images to support biomarker discovery, disease characterization, and laboratory operations. Its platform includes AISight, a digital pathology image management system used for case review, image analysis, workflow coordination, and integration of AI applications into pathology environments. PathAI also offers laboratory services, pathology data analysis, and machine learning models designed for clinical trials and pharmaceutical research. The company collaborates with healthcare organizations, pathology laboratories, and biopharmaceutical companies to support precision medicine and pathology digitization initiatives. Its technology is applied in areas such as oncology, liver disease research, companion diagnostics, and pathology workflow automation.

name: Patlytics
description: Patlytics is an AI-powered patent intelligence platform that provides tools for patent drafting, analysis, and portfolio management, enabling companies to improve research efficiency and streamline patent-related processes. The platform facilitates the identification of potential infringements, assists in the evaluation of patent portfolios, and supports the overall management of intellectual property assets. By leveraging advanced algorithms and data analytics, Patlytics helps organizations optimize their patent strategies and make informed decisions regarding their intellectual property.

name: pave.dev
description: Pave delivers AI-powered cash flow analytics for consumers and SMB credit risk teams. Its core value centers on converting real-time cash flow data into predictive, dynamic credit signals.

name: People Data Labs
description: People Data Labs builds B2B data for developers, engineers, and data scientists. They empower clients to build and scale innovative data-driven products using 3 billion highly accurate B2B records.

name: Perpetua
description: Perpetua Labs helps the world's best brands improve e-commerce ad performance with AI-powered automation and industry-leading expertise. Perpetua Labs builds growth infrastructure for e-commerce brands and agencies. The company's product takes all of the friction out of how to leverage keywords, creatives, audiences, campaigns, etc., and makes it easier for brands to maximize profits and optimize placement on the digital shelf.

name: Personio
description: Personio is the People Operating System for small and medium-sized companies with 10 to 2,000 employees. The company's mission is to make HR processes as efficient and effective as possible so HR can focus on what matters most: people. Personio does that by offering an all-in-one HR software that includes Human Resources Management, Recruiting, Talent Management, and Payroll.

name: Photys Therapeutics
description: Photys Therapeutics’ proprietary bifunctional small molecules platform unlocks fine-tuned control of protein post-translational modifications, going beyond degradation to restore protein function, repair signaling, and amplify endogenous disease-fighting mechanisms. Photys was co-founded by the Broad Institute’s leading bifunctional chemist, Amit Choudhary, and the Longwood Fund, alongside a scientific advisory board comprised of distinguished scientists and drug developers – MIT’s Angela Koehler, Salk’s Tony Hunter, Berkeley’s Dan Nomura, MPM’s Wendy Young, and Dana-Farber’s Eric Fischer.

name: Phylo
description: Phylo provides an integrated workspace with AI-assisted tools to support planning, execution, and review of biological research.

name: Platform Science
description: Platform Science is an enterprise-grade IoT fleet management platform for the new era of connected trucks, freight, and the digital supply chain. Since its launch in 2015, Platform Science has spent thousands of hours working with fleets to make transportation smart. The company is based in San Diego, California, United States.

name: Plotlogic
description: Plotlogic is a global technology company allowing mine operators to understand the location and material properties of every rock in the mine. It utilizes an AI and sensor-driven platform to enhance yield in the critical mineral industry.

name: PointOne
description: PointOne is a provider of communication solutions for carriers and enterprise markets. It focuses on building a network to offer communication services into a single-network platform. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.

name: Portal Biotech
description: Portal Biotech is a pioneering biotechnology company, set to deliver the “holy grail” of full-length single-molecule protein sequencing. Their never-before-accomplished breakthrough promises transformative impact on drug discovery, precision medicine, and global biosecurity.

name: Premise
description:
Premise is a data and analytics platform that empowers decision-makers with real-time, actionable intelligence. By combining the power of a global network of on-the-ground contributors with industry-leading data science and machine learning, Premise is ‘The Source of Ground Truth.’ A $66M Series C venture capital organization, we are backed by Valor Equity Partners, Social Capital, Google Ventures, and Andreessen Horowitz, among others.

Premise is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with offices in Washington, D.C., Seattle, and Portland.

name: Prepared
description: Prepared offers an AI-powered platform designed to enhance emergency response operations. The platform integrates functionalities such as automated triage for non-emergency calls, real-time translation of audio and text in multiple languages, and situational awareness tools including live video and multimedia sharing. It also provides quality assurance features that allow supervisors to evaluate call-taking performance in real-time. By consolidating these tools into a single interface, Prepared aims to assist Public Safety Answering Points in managing calls more efficiently and effectively.

name: project44
description:
Project44 is on a mission to make supply chains work. As the supply chain connective tissue, Project44 operates the world’s most trusted end-to-end visibility platform that manages more than 1 billion unique shipments annually for over 1,300 of the world’s leading brands, including top companies in manufacturing, automotive, retail, life sciences, food & beverage, CPG, and oil, chemical & gas. Using Project44, shippers and carriers across the globe drive greater predictability, resiliency, and sustainability.

The undisputed leader in the market and innovator of Movement GPT, Project44 was named the Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant, #1 in FreightWaves FreightTech 2023, a ten-time leader in customer satisfaction on G2’s Supply Chain Visibility Grid, one of SupplyChainBrain’s 100 Great Supply Chain Partners of 2022, and the Customer’s Choice in Gartner Peer Insights Voice of the Customer report. Project44 is headquartered in Chicago with a diverse team spanning 15 global offices including Amsterdam, Kraków, Paris, São Paulo, Shanghai, and Tokyo. Learn more at project44.com.

name: Prometheus Alternative Investments
description: Prometheus Alternative Investments, Inc., a Los Angeles, California-based fintech startup.

name: Promise
description: Promise streamlines government payments and benefits with secure technology, simplifying income verification and enabling flexible payment plans to improve revenue collection and accessibility.

name: ProteinQure
description: ProteinQure is a biotech company focused on the design of novel exotic peptides with broad therapeutic applications. Powered by atomic-level simulations and artificial intelligence, it designs dynamic peptides to deliver drugs straight to their target sites. The company's lead therapeutic PQ203 for TOP1-resistant triple-negative breast cancer entered Phase I trials in the US and Canada. The company has various anti-cancer drugs in its pipeline.

name: Prox Biosciences
description: Arpelos Biosciences is an early-stage biotechnology company developing multivalent biologics.

name: Psyonic
description:
Psyonic makes advanced bionic limbs that are accessible to all people with amputations. Its first product is an advanced bionic hand. It is the fastest on the market, easy to control, provides touch feedback, and is robust to impacts. It is also affordable, and they aim to have it completely covered by insurance companies with no out-of-pocket costs to users.

It was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Champaign, Illinois.

name: Public
description: Public is a venture capital firm that supports technology startups aiming to work more deeply with the UK’s public services.

name: Pulley
description: Pulley offers tools for issuing equity, tracking ownership stakes, managing SAFEs, and conducting fundraising dilution modeling. Organizations use the system to generate 409A valuations, prepare financial compliance reports, and execute secondary market liquidity programs. Additionally, the software integrates with accounting software systems to assist companies with financial audit preparation and employee equity distribution.

name: Purplefish
description: Developer of an AI agent designed for high-volume recruiting at a large corporation. The company's agents let recruiters automate phone screens with human-quality voice AI that gives candidates a fast, consistent experience, enabling Human Resource professionals to screen candidates faster at an affordable cost.

name: Quadrant Health
description: Quadrant Health provides real-time analysis of EHR and patient messaging data to predict patient harm before it occurs. Founded by Krishna Gorrepati and Anin Sayana in 2021, the company has developed a disease prediction platform designed to identify patient infections and injuries earlier and more accurately than other physicians.

name: Quince
description: Quince is an e-commerce retailer that sells apparel, accessories, jewelry, home goods, and personal care products through an online platform. The company offers clothing categories for women, men, and children, including items such as sweaters, shirts, dresses, outerwear, and activewear. Its product assortment also includes bedding, bath textiles, furniture, kitchen items, and decorative home products. Quince distributes products using a manufacturer-to-consumer retail model in which goods are produced by partner factories and shipped directly to customers through online orders. The platform also features beauty, wellness, and lifestyle products, along with accessories such as bags, footwear, and jewelry. Quince manages product design, sourcing coordination with manufacturing partners, digital storefront operations, and order fulfillment for consumer purchases.

name: Rainbow
description: Rainbow offers insurance to small enterprises, beginning with eateries.

name: Realm Alliance
description:
Realm is an AI-driven platform that delivers significant cost savings for industrial operations. By preventing 80% of failures before they happen, Realm maximizes uptime, potentially saving millions in lost revenue. Built on the latest advances in AI, Realm integrates with your existing cameras, sensors, and control systems to automatically detect and predict equipment failures, flag unsafe and suspicious behavior, automate response actions like shut-offs, and immediately notify and dispatch key personnel. Realm also augments your existing monitoring infrastructure with edge AI devices and drones for comprehensive, customizable event detection in low-connectivity and unmonitored areas (large-scale infrastructure, vehicles, etc.).

Realm has a proven track record with clients in gold, gemstones, coal, and oil & gas operations across Africa, Latin America, and the United States.

name: RealScout
description: RealScout is the platform that powers successful relationships between real estate professionals and their clients. For home buyers and their agents, RealScout offers a collaborative home search experience that makes picking the perfect home simple and easy. For home sellers and their agents, RealScout uncovers real-time market insights and unique marketing opportunities.

name: Rebellion Defense
description: Rebellion Defense turns data into a decision advantage, developing advanced software to stay ahead of national security threats. It equips warfighters with cutting-edge capabilities to detect, deter, and outpace adversaries at speed and scale by combining private-sector tech experts with defense veterans. Their mission is to build transformative technology for defense and national security.

name: REK
description: REK, Our robots face off in the ring, putting engineering to the test and thrilling fans with the combat sport of the future.

name: Reserv
description:
Reserv develops an AI-powered insurance claims platform that combines third-party administration services with data-driven software to manage and optimize property and casualty claims. The company provides end-to-end claims handling, including intake, evaluation, processing, and settlement, supported by a digital infrastructure designed to replace legacy claims systems. Its platform leverages Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to ingest and analyze structured and unstructured data from insurers, customers, and third-party sources, enabling automated workflows, coverage decisioning, and real-time reporting. These capabilities allow claims professionals to access consolidated claim data, generate insights, and make faster, more informed decisions throughout the claims lifecycle.

Reserv operates as a digitally native third-party administrator, providing both technology and operational services, including claims adjuster support and compliance handling across multiple insurance lines. Its system digitizes processes from first notice of loss through settlement, improving efficiency, reducing cycle times, and enhancing transparency for insurers and policyholders. The platform includes analytics and data warehouse capabilities that deliver detailed insights into claims performance and portfolio risk, helping insurers refine underwriting strategies and pricing decisions. It also automates reporting and integrates with existing insurance systems, enabling scalable deployment across different organizations and workflows.

name: Reveal Technology
description: Reveal Technology is a visual analytics and edge artificial intelligence company that offers a defense tech platform and AI products that generate critical intelligence for military and public safety users. The company provides offline intelligence platforms designed to function without network connectivity, supporting real-time decision-making in contested or remote environments. Its main products include Farsight, which generates 3D maps from drone video, and Identifi, a mobile biometric identification tool. These technologies are deployed by the U.S. Army, Special Operations Command, Marine Corps, and various international military forces.

name: Revinate
description: Revinate empowers hoteliers to connect directly with guests at every touchpoint to deliver delightful experiences and drive direct revenue. Our data platform and guest communication solutions put hoteliers in control of every step of their guests’ journeys — initial research, booking, check-in, throughout the stay, and even after check-out. We do this all using the communication channels that the guests prefer, whether it’s voice, text, email, or web chat. We have 4 international offices, located in California, Oregon, Amsterdam, and Singapore.

name: Revion
description: Revion offers voice AI software that converts technician speech into structured repair orders, inspections, and time logs for dealerships.

name: RightSite Health
description: RightSite Health helps patients with urgent-but-non-emergency situations navigate away from the emergency room. The company combines EMS relationships with emergency room physicians and trained patient navigators to assess patients and help them get the urgent treatment they need at the Right Site of care — for better outcomes, lower cost, and a better experience for everyone.

name: Ritten
description: Ritten delivers a platform that helps clinicians and administrators provide personalized, data-informed care. The company's platform offers customized workflow configurations that help to deliver complex treatment consistently and compliantly, enabling clinicians and administrators to maintain a comprehensive patient record that tracks all aspects of a patient's care, including clinical notes, medications, and treatment plans.

name: Rocketlane
description: Rocketlane is a Professional Services Automation (PSA) platform designed to enhance project profitability and streamline customer onboarding processes. The platform combines project management, collaboration, and communication tools to help teams plan, track, and execute client-facing projects. It includes features such as task management, document sharing, time tracking, and customer portals, enabling visibility into project progress for both internal teams and clients. Rocketlane also supports workflow automation, resource planning, and reporting to help organizations coordinate onboarding activities and monitor performance. The system integrates with other business tools to streamline data flow across sales, customer success, and service teams.

name: Roundtrip Systems
description: Roundtrip Systems is a software that makes managing last-mile and local deliveries easy. It coordinates the future of local commerce.

name: Sable
description: Developer of AI (artificial intelligence) agents intended to run and explain software demos at scale. The company offers agents that can visually interpret interfaces, interact through clicks, and provide step by step explanations, enabling sales and product teams to demonstrate software effectively and consistently.

name: Samara
description: Samara is a home services company that provides home renovation, interior design, and architectural services.

name: SAPIAT
description: SAPIAT is a technology platform for short to long term scenario simulations of capital markets and investor decisions.

name: Saris AI
description:
Saris AI is an artificial intelligence company that builds agent-based workflow automation systems for financial institutions, particularly banks and credit unions. The company develops AI “agents” that handle back-office operations such as lending workflows, document processing, compliance checks, data extraction, and internal operational tasks. Its platform integrates directly with existing banking systems like core banking software and loan origination systems, allowing institutions to automate processes without replacing their current infrastructure. The system is designed to reduce manual workload by executing multi-step workflows such as data validation, case handling, and administrative processing while keeping humans in control of approvals and oversight.

Saris AI focuses on improving operational efficiency by reducing processing costs and increasing output capacity through automation of repetitive and rules-based tasks. The company positions its technology as a way for financial institutions to streamline operations, improve compliance tracking, and enhance customer service responsiveness.

name: Saronic Technologies
description: Saronic is a defense technology company that designs, builds, and deploys autonomous surface vessels (ASVs) for naval and maritime applications. The company focuses on integrating advanced hardware, artificial intelligence, and software into scalable unmanned systems that enhance maritime awareness, extend operational reach, and improve survivability in complex environments. Its vessels are capable of functions such as navigation, target identification, communication, and payload deployment, enabling both independent and coordinated mission execution. Saronic emphasizes rapid innovation and high-throughput manufacturing to support defense and commercial maritime needs. The company primarily serves government and defense customers, aiming to modernize naval operations and strengthen maritime capabilities through autonomous, software-driven platforms.

name: Second Front Systems
description: Second Front Systems (2F) is a venture-backed public-benefit software company that accelerates secure delivery of commercial and SaaS applications to government and regulated environments, simplifying compliance and deployment for defense and national security missions.

name: Seed Health (Biotechnology)
description: Seed Health is a microbial sciences company pioneering applications of microbes for human and planetary health. In collaboration with leading academic researchers, we advance breakthrough discoveries in microbial sciences across a pipeline of novel therapeutics, consumer health innovations, and environmental solutions. All consumer innovations in probiotics are commercialized under Seed®.

name: Seen Health
description: Tech-enabled Healthcare Services

name: Senra Systems
description: Senra Systems designs and manufactures wire harnesses for Aerospace, Defense, and other industries while integrating software with engineering and production workflows. The company provides wire harness design support, digital manufacturing, cable assembly, testing, inventory management, configuration management, and production tracking services. Its software platform connects quoting, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain management, and production to improve coordination across the manufacturing process. Senra Systems also offers design-for-manufacturing guidance, digital twin conversion, and production support for wire harness assemblies from prototype development through manufacturing.

name: Senti Biosciences
description: Senti Biosciences Inc. is a preclinical biotechnology company developing next-generation cell and gene therapies engineered with their gene circuit platform technologies to fight challenging diseases.

name: Sequence Holdings
description: Sequence Holdings is a permanent holding company that brings AI and engineering to the core of great American businesses. Our team comes from Scale, Palantir, Lone Pine, Silver Lake, and other world-class organizations. We have raised ~$75M from top-tier investors including Lux, Conviction, 8VC, Factory, Definition Capital, Avenir, and others.

name: Showroom
description:
Showroom is the parent company to Vesta, the country’s largest home staging, interior design, and furniture studio. 

Since 2017, we’ve worked with developers, real estate brokers, agents, architects, designers, and individual clients, from design and staging of luxury properties for sale to contract manufacturing and furniture rental. 

Vesta has revolutionized a traditionally fragmented and outdated industry, setting a new standard for high-end home presentation and empowering homeowners to optimize their most significant financial asset. The impact is tangible: for sellers, homes staged by Vesta sell faster and for higher prices, while for buyers, we provide a seamless transition into a beautiful home they can buy furnished or work with us to personalize.

Our vertically integrated operation, from design and customer service to state-of-the-art technology, warehouse capacity, and furniture manufacturing, serves a wide range of budgets, styles, and logistics.

name: Side
description:
Side transforms agents, teams, and independent brokerages into businesses and boutique brands. It partners with the best agents, helping them with proprietary technology and a premier support team so they can be more productive, grow their business, and focus on serving their clients.

The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

name: Sigma Squared
description: Sigma Squared offers a platform designed to enhance meritocracy through economic intelligence. The company focuses on addressing complex people challenges across various industries, including law enforcement and quick service restaurants. Sigma Squared's solutions aim to optimize the diversity of experiences and skills within organizations.

name: Sila Nanotechnologies
description: Sila is a battery materials company that manufactures energy-density lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles. It works directly with consumer electronics and automotive OEMs to help accelerate product roadmaps and partners with battery manufacturers' commercial cell production. The company was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in California, United States.

name: Sirona Medical
description: Sirona Medical is revolutionizing radiology by delivering a cloud-native platform that unifies the worklist, viewer, reporter, archive, and AI into a single, intuitive workspace. Designed specifically for radiologists, Sirona’s platform simplifies complex workflows, enhances productivity, and empowers practitioners to work as fast as they think. Founded in San Francisco, CA, Sirona combines deep expertise in the practice and business of radiology to create purpose-built solutions that address the evolving needs of the field. By streamlining radiology workflows and integrating cutting-edge AI, Sirona enables radiologists to deliver better, faster, and more efficient care.

name: Sizzle AI
description: Sizzle AI operates as a free app that helps you solve problems step-by-step.

name: Socotra
description:
Socotra is a technology platform that builds a modern cloud-based platform for technology-driven insurers. Its platform is built from the ground up using the latest technologies to be transparent, reliable, flexible, and secure. It aims to provide insurers with a modern, enterprise-grade core system that enables them to rapidly develop and distribute products that better serve their customers.

Socotra was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

name: SOFR Academy
description: SOFR Academy, Inc. is an American financial market infrastructure company focused on developing benchmark credit-spread infrastructure designed to complement risk-free reference rates in global capital markets. In connection with global reference rate reform and the transition away from the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR), which underpinned approximately US$400 trillion in financial contracts globally, the firm operationalized U.S.-dollar Across-the-Curve Credit Spread Indices (AXI) that can be referenced in financial products in conjunction with the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR) to address asset-liability funding mismatches observed under risk-free rate regimes.

name: Sonoma BioTherapeutics
description: Sonoma Biotherapeutics develops engineered regulatory T-cell (TREG) therapies aimed at treating autoimmune and inflammatory diseases by restoring immune system balance. The company employs proprietary cell-therapy platform technologies to engineer and deliver targeted TREG approaches designed for durable, disease-modifying treatment. Its services include preclinical development, clinical evaluation of TREG-based therapies, and collaboration frameworks for advancing new modalities in immune-mediated conditions. Sonoma Biotherapeutics engages with partners and stakeholders across research, manufacturing, and clinical operations to bring engineered cell therapies from concept toward clinical proof of concept.

name: Spartan Radar
description: Spartan’s proprietary software algorithms leverage machine learning and edge-processing to provide high-resolution sensing that mimics the human ability of instantly shifting focus to safely respond to obstacles. Spartan works with existing ADAS sensors to increase resolution, response time, and range. Our software increases sensing performance at an affordable cost with low computational overhead. Signal processing expertise built over decades of commercializing aerospace and automotive technologies.

name: Spawn
description: Developer of a platform intended to create apps and games from words. The company is currently operating in stealth mode.

name: Spotnana Technology
description: Spotnana is the travel platform that connects humanity. We are modernizing the infrastructure of the travel industry in order to bring freedom, simplicity, and trust to travelers everywhere. Our groundbreaking Travel-as-a-Service platform revolutionizes travel for corporations and consumers, modernizes how travel suppliers sell their inventory, and enables any company to provide the world’s best global travel experiences to their customers. To learn more, visit spotnana.com.

name: Standard Metrics
description: Standard Metrics is an automated financial cooperation platform that assists investors and creators in smarter, more forward-thinking decisions. Say goodbye to data silos in spreadsheets, personal inboxes, and archaic applications. Access firm data throughout the portfolio, from financial metrics to investment information, and engage in real-time with the team and founders.

name: STARFACE
description: Starface World is reinventing the way they care for acne-prone skin.

name: Street Context
description:
Street Context is the only email intelligence software purpose-built for the pace and scale of global capital markets. We power the email infrastructure that connects capital markets.

In this industry, deals are won and lost in the inbox within minutes, but CRMs and email marketing tools don’t provide the timely, streamlined data firms need to act first and fast. Our software enables buy- and sell-side teams to cut through the email chaos so they can focus on high-value conversations.

We’re not just analytics — we’re the Street's call list. With timely, streamlined data, Street Context infuses insight into every outreach, enabling buy- and sell-side teams to target high-value conversations first and fast. That’s why the world’s sharpest capital markets firms — 150 of them across 21 countries — leverage our email intelligence to maximize their time, keep the intel flowing, and make every conversation count.

name: Structify
description: Structify scans any data source on the internet to create a custom dataset. Customers use it to create data processes by specifying the data format, selecting the source(s), and assigning agents to search and extract the data. The company's in-house model ensures quality and accuracy across all use cases. Structify has already experienced widespread application in Finance, Construction, and Corporate Technology. For example, Finance teams can submit pitch decks and extract the company name, industry, founders, investors, and fundraising amount from each one. Construction teams use it to convert geotechnical documents into comprehensible tables. Sales and Operations teams receive real-time chain of command data for their accounts, allowing them to speed up their pipeline.

name: Subskribe
description: Transform the quote-to-revenue lifecycle with AI-native subscription management that unifies your entire revenue workflow, combining quoting, billing, and revenue recognition to unlock revenue at scale. Subskribe has been officially acquired by DealHub.io - November 2025.

name: Sumer
description:
Sumer builds technology for micro small businesses. We enable businesses to grow sales and improve their management with simple features.

Our first goal is to enable businesses to go digital with our “15 Second Store”: Via Sumer App, any business can create a digital store rapidly, upload a catalogue of the products, and share it with clients. Thus, we leverage the mobile penetration in LatAm and simplify the cumbersome experience of having an online store. We have a Digital Ledger and an Ads tool to allow businesses to reach new audiences. From there, we are working on adding features (centered in Customer Service, Payments, Financing) that will complement the operating system we will put in every entrepreneur’s hand.

SUMER was founded in June 2021. The company is headquartered in Bogotá, Colombia, with offices in Mexico City, Mexico.

name: Superpower
description: Superpower offers a digital health platform that integrates comprehensive diagnostics, personalized care plans, and health tracking tools. The service includes over 100 lab tests per year, covering areas such as cardiovascular health, hormone levels, inflammation, and gut microbiome analysis. Users receive a customized action plan with recommendations on diet, supplements, and lifestyle adjustments. The platform provides a centralized dashboard for storing and monitoring medical records and test results over time. Additional services include access to a concierge care team, specialty testing for toxins and genetic markers, and a curated marketplace of health products. Superpower operates on a membership model, offering its services for an annual fee.

name: Surglogs
description:
Surglogs streamlines and automates the administration of logbooks, medications, supplies, in-services, and drills in healthcare facilities. The outdated pen-and-paper method is replaced with a HIPAA compliant state-of-the-art digital application, complemented with a desktop portal that serves as an administrative dashboard.

Surglogs was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in California, United States.

name: Synaptic
description:
Synaptic helps investors get company insights from a wide spectrum of alternative data on a single no-code platform. We unify data from proprietary and custom sources with a rich analytics toolkit, enabling more efficient ways to complete and complement the research workflow—from sourcing and tracking to due diligence of companies and sectors. We work with top Venture Capital firms, Private Equity firms, and Hedge Funds across the globe.

Alternative datasets include app, marketing, employee, product reviews, gaming, search trends, funding, public markets, company firmographics, and more.

name: SyntheX
description: SyntheX expands the druggable proteome using synthetic biology-driven drug discovery platforms. The platforms rely on empirical intracellular selection to discover protein interaction modulators. These can discover compounds that disrupt a specific protein-protein interaction (PPI), or achieve the inverse, and bring an E3 ubiquitin ligase and a neosubstrate of interest together to achieve functional protein degradation. In addition to external discovery collaborations, the platforms have generated an internal oncology pipeline focused on unique mechanisms of action around genetically validated targets.

name: TAP
description: Operator of a vocational training company intended to provide vocational skills to people in need. The company prepares talent with the exact skills needed to be productive on the job using a model that is practical and sustainable, enabling people to help enhance the skills to get on a job.

name: Tasca
description: Tasca is a biotechnology company that offers small molecule drugs for hard-to-treat oncology indications.

name: Telegraph.io
tags: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
description:
Telegraph simplifies complex workflows and enables collaboration between railroads, shippers, and 3PLs across the freight ecosystem. With a modern first-of-its-kind cloud platform, Telegraph empowers unparalleled visibility and insights into rail operations and facilitates commerce for the rail supply chain of the future.

Telegraph was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.

name: Tempero Bio
description: Tempero Bio is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing treatments for substance use disorders and related conditions. It is part of the Aditum Bio portfolio and conducts research supported by external funding, including grants. The company focuses on addressing unmet medical needs through pharmaceutical development.

name: Terminal Industries
description: Terminal Industries is the first AI-native Yard Operating System backed by global logistics leaders, leveraging computer vision and AI to provide a scalable, subscription-based solution that automates and optimizes yard operations for enterprise and mid-market global supply chains.

name: Tetrate
description:
Tetrate partners with enterprises in their journey to app modernization.

The company is an enterprise-ready service mesh for any workload in any environment. Tetrate's service mesh platform makes it easy for DevOps, security, and network administrators to manage the complexity of modern hybrid cloud application infrastructure.

name: Teza
description: Provider of communication platform services intended to help mission-driven organizations and public figures shape and direct their narrative. The company offers proprietary methodology, AI-powered distribution tools, and structured messaging frameworks, enabling advocacy groups and leadership teams to guide public perception and increase message reach.

name: The Boring Company
description: The Boring Company develops tunnel-based transportation systems and related infrastructure designed to move people and vehicles through underground routes. Its services include tunnel construction, transportation system development, and infrastructure solutions intended to address road congestion and improve urban mobility. The company develops LOOP, an underground transportation concept in which electric vehicles carry passengers between designated stations. It also develops tunneling equipment and construction methods intended to reduce the cost and time associated with building underground infrastructure. The Boring Company provides information about its transportation projects, tunnel technology, construction activities, and potential applications for underground mobility.

name: Tigris Data
description: Like the Unix philosophy, we do one thing and do it right: storage, built for AI. Tigris is an S3-compatible, globally distributed object storage service that unlocks true choice for builders. Use all the familiar tools you love, mix and match any compute provider, and stay free from Big Cloud lock-in.

name: Tilda
description: Tilda Research concentrates on providing Phase I–IV clinical trial research for a variety of indications in collaboration with other healthcare organizations, enabling pharmaceutical companies to accelerate clinical innovation, lineup pharmaceutical breakthroughs, and life-saving patient treatments.

name: Titan
description:
Titan operates as an AI holding company focused on transforming IT services through its augmented AI platform. It acquires and partners with managed IT service firms, then equips their technicians with AI-driven agents that reduce response times, deliver proactive, personalized support, and bolster endpoint security.

The platform also includes access to sales, marketing, finance, and operations experts, as well as strategic M&A capabilities to scale efficiently.

name: Tome
description:
Tome radically changes the way sales teams get deals done, with custom LLMs that assist reps throughout every stage of the sales process. 

Book more qualified pipeline with detailed account and persona research, generated value hypotheses, and automated outreach. 

Accelerate existing pipeline with automated call summaries & next steps, updated account plans & CRM sync, and auto-generated collateral. 

Optimize your sales playbook with insights on which messages, features, and collateral lead to bigger, faster deals. 

With the Tome platform, AEs can focus less on manual work and more on spending time with customers. Sales leaders can ensure quality pipeline creation is maximized, more deals are won, and reps ramp faster. And RevOps leaders are at peace of mind knowing their systems and processes are being used to their full potential.

name: Trackonomy Systems
description: Trackonomy Systems is a provider of package-tracking applications designed to simplify the process of parcel delivery. This technology provides end-to-end visibility and control for tracking parcels effectively. It simplifies the complexity of the parcel delivery process, offering a package tracking application designed for efficiency.

name: TradeWing
description: TradeWing is a member engagement platform that helps build a community for an association that provides clear and lasting value to its members. Its platform provides a community manager that works with the clients to enable them to maximize value for their members. It provides online communities for associations, their members, and their sponsors to congregate, meet, and share ideas to keep their members connected and engaged and drive renewals and non-dues revenue.

name: Tul
description: Developer of an e-commerce application designed to connect construction material manufacturers with small businesses. The company's online store allows for the purchase of all hardware and construction products in one place and gets them delivered to the destination of the buyer's choice, enabling businesses to meet operation inventory requirements and customers to acquire parts they need for their projects without any hassle.

name: Twingate
description:
Twingate is a solution for securing remote access to an organization’s private applications, data, and environments, whether they are on-premise or in the cloud. Built to make life easier for DevOps, IT, and infrastructure teams, as well as end users, it replaces outdated and insecure business VPNs which were not built to handle a world in which "work from anywhere" and cloud-based assets are now the norm.

Twingate’s modern zero trust-based approach to securing remote access focuses on improving security, while not compromising on usability and maintainability.

name: Uncountable
description: Uncountable provides a unified R&D laboratory informatics platform for digital transformation in industrial research and development. The company offers a cloud-based solution purpose-built for R&D environments that allows enterprises to unify experimental data, accelerate product development cycles, and deploy AI-driven optimization tools. Its AI-powered solution helps enterprise R&D organizations modernize and streamline data management and analysis—providing scientists, chemists, and researchers with a single and easily accessible web-based platform that comes integrated with all the critical data systems and tools used in the laboratory, including Electronic Lab Notebooks (ELNs), Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Quality Management Systems (QMS), and advanced visualization and reporting tools.

name: Unlearn.AI
description:
Unlearn.AI is a biotech AI company that develops a digital twin service for clinical trials. Digital twins enhance healthcare by assessing health risks before a disease manifests its symptoms, according to some experts. Unlearn brings together a world-class team of experts across pharma, medtech, machine learning, and business who share a vision of using machine learning and biostatistics to improve clinical trials for the benefit of patients and sponsors.

Unlearn invented their TwinRCT solution to enable biopharma partners to run faster, more successful clinical trials. A TwinRCT is a randomized trial that uses machine learning to achieve a higher probability of success with a smaller number of patients. As in a traditional RCT, patients are randomized to a treatment group and a control group, but, unlike a traditional trial, a prognostic digital twin is created for every patient using a machine learning model trained on historical data. The treatment effects for the primary and secondary outcomes can all be estimated from the trial with greater precision after correcting for a prognostic score derived for each patient's digital twin.

TwinRCTs provide a scientifically sound method for using deep learning and historical patient data to improve clinical trials.

name: Ushur
description: Ushur is a cloud-based automation platform that automates service workflows in both the backend process and conversational interfaces. The company develops intelligent automation solutions that include Ushur Virtual Customer Assistant, smart technology that automates proactive member, claimant, agent, or broker communications across virtually any channel, reaching out to customers, understanding what they need, and automatically taking the next steps; Ushur SmartMail, a software that allows insurers to process high volumes of customer, agent, and broker email automatically, allowing carriers to respond faster and efficiently; Ushur Flowbuilder, the web-based no-code builder that allows claims, broker services, and customer support teams to build, deploy, and track rich digital engagements that improve business agility and the customer experience while minimizing the burden on IT. By leveraging the company's Robotic Process Automation (RPA) and Language Intelligence Service Architecture (LISA), insurance companies can accelerate capital and time-intensive processes like claims, customer support, billing, and enrollment to digitally transform service workflows.

name: Valius Sciences
description: Valius Sciences offers maximalist oncology diagnostics for personalized cancer treatment.

name: Vals AI
description: Vals.ai improves model benchmarks by focusing on industry tasks, addressing compromised leaderboards, and ensuring transparent evaluations.

name: Vector
description: Vector offers a logistics workflow platform that digitizes and simplifies interactions among shippers, carriers, 3PLs, and receivers. It enables Electronic Bill of Lading (eBOL), digital check-in, and yard management to replace paper processes and automate gate operations. The platform supports document capture, imaging with OCR and AI, rendition billing, and a carrier connectivity program. It integrates with systems such as SAP, E2Open, Manhattan, and Microsoft to connect with existing enterprise tools.

name: Very Great
description: Very Great is a digitally-native consumer product platform and holding company, growing a family of real, crave-worthy brands for a new generation. Based in New York City, Very Great is powered by a technology-enabled growth infrastructure that spans supply chain, creative, marketing, and sales, all designed to rapidly develop, launch, and scale modern consumer product brands. The current family of brands includes W&P, Courant, and Wild One, with future brand launches currently under development.

name: Vontive
description: A first-of-its-kind embedded mortgage platform, Vontive creates an entirely new and digital way to finance investment properties. Our no-code, white-label solution empowers any business serving real estate investors to launch its own investment-property mortgage business in 1-2 weeks. Vontive creates a new revenue stream for these retail brands, integrates financial institutions through a debt marketplace, and opens the market for new investors to participate in real estate. Our company was founded by FREDDIE MAC and PALANTIR alumni who have nearly four decades of experience in the mortgage and financial services industry.

name: Welcome Homes
description: Welcome Homes is the online home building platform that makes buying a beautiful new home simple by streamlining the entire new home construction journey from land selection to customization to construction, so home buyers can save time, know what they are going to pay, and live where they want to live in a beautifully designed home that they love.

name: Wholesail
description: Wholesail modernizes the invoicing and payment process for food distributors and their buyers. Founded in 2018, the company is based in San Francisco, California, United States.

name: Whoosh
description: Whoosh develops modern club operations software to help private clubs manage everything from the course to the clubhouse. Built with the input of the world's best operators, Whoosh streamlines operations, improves member and staff communication, and enables better hospitality and member experiences.

name: WisePal
description: WisePal helps people save on monthly expenses by using AI to find the best real-time offers without losing current benefits.

name: Wisy Platforms, Inc.
description: Wisy’s AI Agents deliver real-time insights that help CPG brands move faster, optimize resources, and grow market share with precision. Purpose-built for CPG, Wisy turns fragmented data into clear, actionable intelligence—empowering brands to understand their market position, make confident decisions, and act at the right moment to stay ahead.

name: WithCoverage
description: Developer of a risk management platform intended to provide insurance services for consumer brands. The company is currently operating in Stealth Mode.

name: Womp
description: Womp is a 3D software company that makes it simple for users to bring their 3D ideas to life. Womp was founded in 2017 by founder and CEO Gabriela Truela as a design and consulting studio. Womp's support for social and collaboration features, which encourages users to learn from one another, improve their 3D design skills, and share their artwork with the rest of the world, is a key differentiator. The service offers a free tier as well as subscription-based tiers with access to premium features.

name: X.ai
description: SpaceXAI builds deep learning systems, including language reasoning models, real-time voice application programming interfaces, and generative media tools. It operates computing clusters composed of graphics processing units to train machine learning models on complex data pipelines. The company provides software tools for technical teams to run logical inference, process synthetic audio inputs, and build custom applications with neural network technology. Through its engineering operations, the organization creates scalable models that analyze data inputs from foundational principles to expand computer-assisted technical capabilities.

name: xDOF
description: Developer of core robotics technology designed to enable universal control of robots. The company offers flexible control systems, general-purpose robots, and intelligent control, enabling various clients to improve automation and operational efficiency.

name: Xilis
description: Xilis is a biotechnology company that develops technologies to guide precision therapy for cancer patients and accelerate drug discovery. The company's platform enables diagnostics, drug screening, and scalable patient-derived models for drug discovery, enabling physicians and pharmaceutical companies to develop tailored treatments for patients by conducting drug screening.

name: YourChoice Therapeutics
description: YourChoice Therapeutics develops a non-hormonal contraceptive product. Its technology is based on the “molecular condom” concept: the active compound inhibits vigorous sperm motility and prevents sperm from fertilizing the egg.

name: Yugabyte
description:
Yugabyte is the company behind YugabyteDB, the high-performance distributed SQL database for building global, internet-scale apps. It is built using a unique combination of the high-performance document store, auto sharding, per-shard distributed consensus replication, and multi-shard ACID transactions (inspired by Google Spanner).

YugabyteDB serves both scale-out RDBMS and internet-scale OLTP workloads with low query latency, extreme resilience against failures, and global data distribution. As a cloud-native database, it can be deployed across public and private clouds as well as in Kubernetes environments with ease. YugabyteDB is fully open-source under the Apache 2.0 license.

It was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California.

name: Yumi
description: Yumi is the definitive source for parents seeking to understand what they are feeding their children and why, offering a science-based early childhood meal delivery program that is the most convenient and most nutritional option in the market.

name: Zenreach
description: Zenreach created Walk-Through Marketing to help businesses with physical locations dramatically improve customer acquisition and lifetime value by connecting digital marketing with in-store results. Zenreach Engage automatically tracks customer visits, effortlessly builds rich customer profiles, and keeps them up to date. Zenreach Attract improves ad performance 4x by targeting audiences based on your best customers. Results are measured with our Walk-Through Rate™, a proprietary metric that shows when someone exposed to an ad visits a location. Founded in 2012, Zenreach serves thousands of independent merchants and leading brands like Peet’s Coffee, Ruth’s Chris, and BCBG Max Azria.

name: Aescape
description: Aescape is a technology company that builds data-driven massage therapy and wellness experiences. They provide a holistic approach to physical wellness and recovery for everyone, from elite athletes to those just starting out in fitness. It brings together cutting-edge research, a user-friendly interface, and a comprehensive, insights-driven approach to physical wellness and recovery that leaves people feeling great. The company aims to solve this problem and help the industry grow by providing operators with a scalable, dependable solution that supplements the labor shortage and serves as a support tool for massage therapists and athletic trainers.

name: AltoVita
description:
AltoVita powers the corporate accommodations sector with enterprise software layered with a human-centric approach, providing every traveler with precisely what they need.

AltoVita’s technology creates a cloud-based bridge between the highly fragmented property distribution system and Global 2000 companies, SMEs, and business travelers, reducing the legacy 48-to-72-hour bidding process to a few minutes. The fully customizable platform provides instant access to a diverse network of 1 million+ housing options worldwide – including serviced apartments, professionally managed homes, aparthotels, and co-living – with the ability to sort by desired amenities, pet friendliness, sustainability scores, and more. All properties are fully vetted and verified to provide a duty of care and compliance, backed by our extensive Four-Tier Quality Control system.

AltoVita’s fast-growing global footprint currently spans 165 countries and 1,238 cities. They are headquartered in London, with regional offices in Singapore and Dallas, TX.

name: Appear Here
description: Appear Here is an online marketplace for retail space. Since the company was founded in 2012, it has facilitated the opening of over 10,000 stores in the UK, US, and France. Appear Here has raised a total of $21.4 million in VC funding from the previous backers of Spotify, Pinterest, Hailo, and Trivago.

name: Aquicore
description: Aquicore is an information technology company that offers cloud-based software designed for an asset operations platform for the CRE sector. Its SaaS platform provides seamless real-time building intelligence, analytics, and process automation solutions that drive higher NOIs.

name: Assembly OSM
description: Assembly OSM delivers architecturally distinctive high-rise buildings through their innovative building systems. Assembly OSM achieves buildings that are both beautiful and innovative — high-quality in performance, high-end in aesthetics, green in materials, and highly cost-effective in componentry, fabrication, delivery, and operating expense. Perhaps most importantly, Assembly buildings entail a significantly reduced time to completion, with vastly improved cost- and schedule-certainty, compared to conventional projects.

name: Assignar
description: Assignar is a cloud-based construction operations software built to help infrastructure-focused subs and self-perform contractors improve productivity, profitability, safety, and quality in the field and office. Assignar's platform upgrades key components of operations: production tracking and quantities, labor and equipment management, resource-loaded scheduling, field data, timesheets, and more.

name: Aurora Solar
description: Aurora Solar develops solar industry software. It develops cloud-based software that enables solar PV engineering design, provides workflow management functionality, and facilitates sales and customer acquisition for solar installers and financiers.

name: Belong
description: Belong is a residential network that vertically integrates all aspects of the home rental and home improvement process. Powered by AI. Made and loved by people.

name: Brimstone
description: Brimstone developed a deeply decarbonized process to make ordinary Portland cement and another key concrete ingredient, supplementary cementitious material. The Brimstone Process uses carbon-free calcium silicate rock instead of limestone to deliver a product that is identical to conventional materials and cost-competitive at scale.

name: Built Robotics
description: Built Robotics’ mission is to build the robots that build the world. By automating repetitive tasks in the $300 billion solar industry, Built is bridging the workforce gap to accelerate our transition to clean energy.

name: Cambio
description: Cambio is an AI-powered commercial real estate operations platform that automates the collection, analysis, and reporting of building data to support workflows like capital planning, compliance, sustainability tracking, and retrofit planning. It uses large language models and agentic AI to ingest unstructured documents, integrate utility and performance data, and produce actionable insights and priority-ranked recommendations for property owners, asset managers, and investors. The platform consolidates disparate data into a unified system of record and generates automated reporting for regulatory and investor frameworks. Cambio also supports collaboration across teams and helps clients evaluate investment opportunities and monitor progress toward financial and performance goals.

name: Clarity AI
description: Clarity AI is a sustainability technology platform that uses machine learning and big data to deliver environmental and social insights to investors and organizations. As of December 2021, Clarity AI’s platform analyzes more than 30,000 companies, 135,000 funds, 198 countries, and 187 local governments, and delivers data and analytics for investing, corporate research, and reporting. Clarity AI has offices in the US and Europe. Clarity AI’s client network manages trillions in assets under management.

name: Cobalt
description:
Cobalt builds indoor robots that work alongside human guards to provide security. It offers indoor security robots that do patrolling in the premises, as well as look for intruders or anything that's out of the ordinary; and comprise intruder and anomaly detection, human-robot interaction, and mapping and sensing capabilities.

Erik Schluntz and Travis Deyle founded it in 2016, with its headquarters in San Mateo, California.

name: Cobli
description: Cobli is the FleetTech that simplifies and improves fleet management. Founded by Parker Treacy and Rodrigo Mourad, the company has been growing more than 100% year over year. With more than 400 employees and US$ 45M raised in funding led by SoftBank, Cobli is present all across Brazil, reaching thousands of customers and serving several industries, such as telecommunications, transportation, energy, e-commerce, and construction. Through IoT, Artificial Intelligence, Big Data, and Video Telemetry technologies, its solutions help to reduce costs, boost productivity, increase driver safety, raise operational compliance, and improve the end-customer experience.

name: Cottage
description: Cottage is tackling housing affordability via a managed marketplace for building Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs).

name: Docsumo
description: Docsumo is a data entry automation software. It captures data from documents such as invoices, receipts, and forms and feeds that data directly to CRM, ERP, and accounting software. It reduces the time spent on data entry and increases the accuracy of the captured data. Using AI, Docsumo eliminates the need for manual setup or templates. It is as simple as uploading or emailing your documents to Google Drive and sending the captured data to your ERP and accounting software with the click of a button.

name: Document Crunch
description: Document Crunch is a contract intelligence platform that simplifies construction contracts by quickly identifying critical risk provisions and provides teams with guidance to make great decisions throughout the entire project lifecycle. The company aims to empower individuals across the construction industry, enabling them to comprehend the content of their contracts.

name: Doma
description: Doma enables an instant real estate closing experience. The company uses machine intelligence and its patented technology solution to transform residential real estate, making closings instant and affordable.

name: EcoCart
description: EcoCart is a climate and sustainability-focused eCommerce enablement startup pitching consumers on ways to offset their carbon emissions for free at select merchants. The company offers two core carbon offsetting products: an eCommerce plugin for merchants to offer a carbon neutral order option at checkout and a free-to-use Google Chrome extension that calculates the carbon footprint of users' orders at over 10,000 stores and automatically offsets that impact by donating to independently verified carbon offsetting projects.

name: Electric Hydrogen
description:
Electric Hydrogen (EH2) is a deep decarbonization company building low-cost, high-efficiency, fossil-free hydrogen systems. Industrial sectors like ammonia and steel production account for a third of global GHGs and will require fossil-free hydrogen at cost parity to eliminate CO2 emissions. Electric Hydrogen is rethinking electrolysis from the ground up to compete with dirty hydrogen on cost and scale. The company's technology brings hydrogen solutions to industry, infrastructure, freight, and beyond.

The experience of Electric Hydrogen's leadership team at revolutionary clean energy companies like Tesla and First Solar makes EH2 a qualified hydrogen company to break through today’s barriers of efficiency and cost to make measurable progress toward a zero-emission industrial sector in this decade.

name: Enertiv
description:
Enertiv is a real estate technology company that transforms building data into asset value. Our platform streamlines building operations by digitizing the physical infrastructure of commercial real estate portfolios. We collect better data, faster and more affordably than anyone else, enabling owners and operators to eliminate waste within their largest and most controllable operating expenses.

In addition to utilizing existing data sources, we deploy IoT devices to continuously track every critical piece of equipment, tenant space, and indoor environmental condition to enable operators to ensure peak performance of their assets around the clock.

name: EV Realty
description: EV Realty develops, deploys, and owns grid-scale charging infrastructure critical to electrifying last-mile delivery and service fleets.

name: Ever/Body
description: Ever/Body is a digital company offering cosmetic dermatology services. It is a provider of beauty treatments intended to demystify cosmetic dermatology. The company offers injectable medically tested cosmetic treatments and high-tech facials along with non-surgical solutions that provide clients with optimal results by reducing wrinkles to offer a younger and rejuvenated look.

name: Fifth Wall Ventures
description: Fifth Wall is a venture capital firm focused on technology solutions for the Built World.

name: Flyhomes
description: Flyhomes is an end-to-end real estate brokerage and technology company that empowers home buyers, sellers, and agents to win. They are transforming the homebuying and selling experience through comprehensive consumer education, segmented expertise, financial innovation, and on-demand technology.

name: Hippo Insurance
description:
Hippo is a technology-enabled insurance group that leverages Spinnaker, its hybrid fronting carrier, to diversify risk across both personal and commercial lines. Through the Hippo Homeowners Insurance Program, the company applies deep industry expertise and strong underwriting capabilities to deliver tailored, proactive coverage for homeowners. With a flexible portfolio and a disciplined risk management approach, Hippo is well-positioned to adapt to changing market conditions and capitalize on market cycles.

Hippo Holdings Inc. subsidiaries include Hippo Insurance Services, Spinnaker Insurance Company, Spinnaker Specialty Insurance Company, and Wingsail Insurance Company. Hippo Insurance Services is a licensed property casualty insurance agent with products underwritten by various affiliated and unaffiliated insurance companies. For more information, please visit http://www.hippo.com.

name: Honest Networks
description: Honest Networks is a rapidly growing Internet Service Provider built to provide faster speeds, greater reliability, transparent pricing, and an enhanced customer experience.

name: Houm
description: Houm is reinventing the way of leasing and selling properties in LATAM by leveraging technology, data, and design to transform a currently painful and bureaucratic process into a pleasant, quick, and simple experience, both for the owner and for the tenant/buyer.

name: Huspy
description: Huspy provides a platform that simplifies the home buying process, offering services for both mortgages and property acquisition. It helps users find suitable mortgage rates and access a range of properties, from off-plan to move-in ready. Huspy aims to guide clients through the entire process from mortgage pre-approval to disbursal.

name: Impulse
description: Impulse, a concept to create the ideal indoor pizza oven using batteries, served as the initial impetus for Impulse. It became a goal to reposition the home appliance sector.

name: Industrious
description:
Industrious is a premium workplace platform, blending five-star service and stunning design to provide an unparalleled workplace experience for established professionals.

Founded in 2013 by Jamie Hodari and Justin Stewart, the company provides members with stunning offices, inviting hospitality, and inspiring communities. By transforming real estate into a personal, elegant, and high-quality experience, Industrious built the concept of co-working into a scalable platform for businesses of all sizes. Industrious has more than 20 locations across the country.

Industrious is headquartered in New York, New York.

name: Lime
description: Lime aims to provide a sustainable solution to the first- and last-mile transportation problems by helping people move around their cities in an affordable and convenient way while eliminating their carbon footprint. The company empowers future generations to change their behavior so they can save this planet together. From the electric scooter to the e-assist and pedal bike, experience the excitement of Lime’s smart mobility fleet.

name: Loft
description:
Loft leverages a tight-knit network of brokerage partners, an end-to-end digital workflow, and proprietary transaction data to facilitate the insurance, financing, lease, purchase, and sale of hundreds of thousands of homes in Latin America every year.

Founded in 2018, the company combines data, software, and embedded fintech to digitize and simplify all parts of the real estate journey – from property listing to closing, financing, and rental management.

Partnering with thousands of real estate brokerages, Loft is accelerating the modernization of one of Brazil’s largest and most fragmented industries by empowering real estate professionals with digital infrastructure and financial tools.

Loft is headquartered in São Paulo.

name: NavigateAI
description: AI platform boosting construction team efficiency with automation and real-time insights

name: Neighbor
description: Neighbor is an Internet company that specializes in the fields of public storage, economic empowerment, sharing economy, and peer-to-peer marketplace. It connects people who have unused space in their homes, garages, or apartments to renters who are looking for affordable storage.

name: Oosto
description: Osto offers enterprises the ability to better protect their customers, employees, and guests in real-time by analyzing safety and security threats in real-time without compromising on fair and ethical behavior.

name: Parcl
