The company provides recurring wellness assessments that analyze more than 100 biomarkers across areas such as metabolism, cardiovascular health, hormones, recovery, immunity, and sleep, with results presented through a digital dashboard and personalized action plans. The platform also offers guidance related to nutrition, exercise, recovery, and daily habits, while emphasizing that its services are educational and not a replacement for medical diagnosis or treatment. We are pioneering AI techniques that find biomarkers for clinical researchers, helping break down barriers to save lives.

For Researchers:  
Our platform shortens the clinical research process using advanced AI techniques that provide research hypotheses for even the most understudied diseases.

All of your data, all in one place. Cleaned, organized, and analyzed. Medeloop transforms the research approach, enabling researchers to publish more and publish faster.

name: Modular

name: Monzo

One of the key features that distinguishes Monzo from traditional banks is its app-based approach, which provides users with real-time updates on their spending, categorized transactions, budgeting tools, and instant notifications for transactions. Monzo also offers features like "Pots," which are sub-accounts that allow users to set money aside for specific purposes, and "Monzo Plus," a premium subscription service that offers additional features like custom card designs and travel insurance.

name: Mosaic.tech
description:
Mosaic.tech combines big data and machine learning that provides predictive reporting capabilities, leveling the playing field, and giving startups tools and insights for large enterprises. Its one-click integrations and real-time analytics offer clear insights and straightforward recommendations. Mosaic provides greater visibility into the most important dynamics of the business.

Founded in 2019, Mosaic.tech is headquartered in San Diego, California.

name: mostik.ai
description: Mostik is an AI research company. We build bridges that allow models to communicate and cooperate by exchanging the fullness of what they compute with each other as opposed to traditional methods that make them reduce what can be shared into text. To produce a single word, a language model builds around two megabytes of internal state. Then it emits about seventeen bits of that and discards the rest. Every system that connects models together today runs on those seventeen bits, because text is the only channel any of them has. We built a wider one. Hidden states from one model cross a small trained bridge, and the receiving model works with them directly. No text passes between them, and neither model's weights are touched. In our first result, a 4B model paired with a 753B model reading for it closes half the quality gap between them, at 2.5x less compute than a mid-sized model that scores the same. Both models stay frozen. Only the bridge learns. We are 15 people, including 12 PhDs, alongside a Fields Medalist. We came out of stealth in September 2026 and are backed by General Catalyst. If you serve models, run several open models in one product, or work on representation geometry and interpretability, we would like to hear from you.

name: Multiverse
description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and tech adoption. Multiverse has partnered with over 1,500 companies in the US and UK to deliver a new kind of learning that’s transforming the workforce through tech skills.

Multiverse apprenticeships are for people of any age or career stage and focus on critical AI, data, and tech skills. Multiverse learners have driven $2 billion + ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

name: MULTI·ON
description: MultiOn is a technology and design group developing AI agents that complete tasks online from start to finish. These agents use websites and services to perform various tasks based on simple inputs. The goal is to automate routine tasks, allowing people to focus on more meaningful or enjoyable activities.

name: Nace.AI
description: Nace AI develops enterprise artificial intelligence systems that automate complex professional workflows by generating task-specific AI models and coordinating multiple specialized agents within a unified platform. The company’s core technology, known as a MetaModel, converts enterprise policies, procedures, and data into small, customized language models that are designed to execute tasks with higher precision and alignment to business requirements. Its platform orchestrates more than a hundred AI agents that can process large volumes of structured and unstructured data, including financial records, legal documents, and operational datasets, to produce structured outputs such as reports, audits, and compliance analyses. These agents operate autonomously across workflows, while human experts provide final validation to ensure accuracy and adherence to professional standards.

name: Native Security
description: Native Security is a cloud security control plane for enterprises. It translates security outcomes into native cloud controls, simulates deployment impacts, and maintains alignment as environments change. The platform enforces security at the architectural level across multi-cloud setups.

name: Neko Health
description:
Neko Health is a healthcare technology company that develops and operates an AI-powered preventive healthcare platform centered on comprehensive, non-invasive health assessments. The company combines proprietary medical devices, artificial intelligence, data science, and clinical care to detect early signs of disease before symptoms appear. Its mission is to shift healthcare from reactive treatment to proactive prevention through technology-enabled screening and personalized health insights.

The company's flagship Neko Health Scan integrates full-body imaging, cardiovascular measurements, blood analysis, skin mapping, and AI-assisted data analysis into a single preventive health assessment completed in approximately one hour. Neko has developed its own proprietary hardware, including the Neko Spectrum, Derma, Echo, and Neko Lens, which collectively capture millions of health data points to support clinicians in identifying potential risks related to cardiovascular disease, diabetes, skin cancer, and other chronic conditions. Patients receive personalized health reports, clinical consultations, and ongoing health tracking through the Neko mobile application.

name: NewDays

name: NewStore
description: NewStore operates a platform for retailers to run their stores on the iPhone. Purpose-built for mobile shoppers, the company provides Omnichannel-as-a-Service with the only integrated cloud OMS and mobile POS. Intuitive store associate apps allow retailers to offer seamless shopping experiences through the endless aisle, mobile checkout, store fulfillment, real-time inventory, and clienteling. An API-first architecture and an expansive ecosystem of partners means retailers can deploy fast and flexible omnichannel with ease. NewStore was founded by Stephan Schambach, who pioneered e-commerce at Demandware (now Salesforce Commerce Cloud). The company has offices in Berlin, Boston, and New York.

name: Nirvana Insurance
description:
Nirvana Insurance is an AI-driven commercial trucking insurer that utilizes telematics data to enhance safety and reduce fleet costs.

The company leverages artificial intelligence and telematics data to offer personalized insurance solutions that reward safe driving practices. NuPlay AI focuses on replacing manual enterprise workflows with AI systems that are reliable in production, governed by design, and designed to operate at lower cost at scale. Implementing Pantomath is simple. Our wide range of connectors seamlessly integrates into a variety of data tools in minutes. With pre-configured monitors and AI agents auto-deployed for various use cases, customers see immediate value and streamlined operations.

Automate data operations and eliminate data reliability issues with Pantomath.

name: Paradigm
description:
Paradigm is rebuilding the clinical research ecosystem by developing a platform that allows all patients equitable access to trials while improving trial efficiency and lowering barriers to participation for healthcare providers. It is an innovative company that is dedicated to transforming the clinical research ecosystem. Their mission is to create a more accessible and equitable healthcare system by developing a platform that enables patients from diverse backgrounds to participate in clinical trials.

Clinical trials are essential for testing and developing new drugs, therapies, and medical devices, but historically, they have been plagued by inefficiencies, barriers to access, and inequities in patient representation. Paradigm aims to solve these challenges by creating a platform that uses technology and data-driven insights to streamline the clinical trial process, making it more efficient, cost-effective, and inclusive.

The Paradigm platform is designed to facilitate seamless communication and collaboration among all stakeholders involved in clinical research, including patients, healthcare providers, pharmaceutical companies, and regulatory agencies. By leveraging technology such as AI, machine learning, and predictive analytics, Paradigm can identify and match eligible patients to clinical trials, streamline the recruitment and enrollment process, and provide real-time data insights to all stakeholders.

Overall, Paradigm's innovative approach to clinical research has the potential to revolutionize the healthcare industry by improving patient outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and accelerating the development of new treatments and therapies.

name: Parloa

The platform enables organizations to deploy autonomous AI agents capable of handling a wide range of customer service scenarios while also assisting human agents with real-time translation and contextual support. Parloa integrates with existing business systems, including CRM, ERP, and contact center infrastructure, enabling AI agents to access and act on relevant data during interactions. The platform incorporates simulation testing, quality assurance, and content filtering to ensure voice conversations remain reliable and safe. Pelico seamlessly connects your supply chain data, maps dependencies, and reveals the blockers that matter. Our AI-powered operations anticipate disruptions, simulate responses, and recommend the best course of action — allowing your teams to coordinate before problems escalate. Precision insights provide executives with answers to critical questions needed to deliver to plan and optimize revenue. Pelico empowers operations teams to resolve issues in real time and keep production moving.

name: Polymarket
description: Polymarket enables participants to buy and sell shares that represent the probability of specific outcomes, with prices ranging between zero and one dollar to reflect market expectations. Trades occur in a peer-to-peer order book where users transact directly with one another rather than with a central counterparty. Polymarket uses USDC.e as collateral and represents positions as conditional tokens that are settled through smart contracts on the Polygon blockchain. Event outcomes are resolved through a decentralized oracle process that verifies results before distributing payouts to holders of winning shares. The platform uses a non-custodial model where participants maintain control of their assets through personal wallets while all transactions and positions remain publicly verifiable on-chain.
