Shift has analyzed billions of insurance transactions to date and was presented Frost & Sullivan’s 2020 Global Claims Solutions for Insurance Market Leadership Award.

name: Shyft
description: Shyft is a personalized wellness platform that offers guided nutrition, meditation, and yoga classes. Shyft offers a variety of yoga-based interactive classes and DIY content focused on managing specific conditions across women's health, chronic ailments, everyday wellness, and mental health.

name: Signal Advisors
description: Signal Advisors is a new tech-enabled distributor of annuities and life insurance. Their end-to-end platform for financial advisors and insurance producers simplifies licensing and contracting, new business submission, case design, marketing analytics, compliance, and more. Additionally, the platform pays agent commissions within one day of application submission, at no cost.

name: Singular
description: Singular is a marketing intelligence platform that unifies marketing analytics, giving marketers actionable insights from previously siloed data. By connecting upper funnel marketing data with lower-funnel attribution data, marketers can measure ROI from every touchpoint across multiple channels and optimize spend down to the most granular levels. Singular currently tracks over $10 billion in digital marketing spend to revenue and lifetime value across industries including commerce, travel, gaming, entertainment, media, and on-demand services. Singular customers include companies like Lyft, Yelp, Airbnb, LinkedIn, Symantec, Zynga, Match, and Twitter. Singular is backed by Norwest Venture Partners, General Catalyst, Thomvest Ventures, Method Capital, Translink Capital, DCM, and Telstra Ventures. Visit www.singular.net to learn more.

name: Sleeper
description: Sleeper is a sports platform intended for fantasy leagues and eSports. The platform connects fans and people to create a community and friendship that enable users to enjoy a sporting event in a communal way that creates lasting memories.

name: Slide
description: Slide provides a business continuity and disaster recovery platform for Managed Service Providers.

name: Snackpass
description:
Snackpass is a social food app that makes ordering food more convenient, affordable, and social. It focuses on mobile order pickup at local restaurants. The platform allows users to unlock discounts with friends, send gifts, and collect points.

Snackpass was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

name: Snap Inc.
description: Snap is a technology company best known for its marquis social media application Snapchat, a visual messaging application that has amassed hundreds of millions of users. The app was initially only used to communicate with family and friends through photographs and short videos (known as "Snaps"). Users can now enjoy Augmented Reality, or AR, lenses, content from famous creators and celebrities, updates about local events, and more. Although the app offers a paid subscription option with premium features, advertising sales produce most of the app's revenue. The firm also sells wearable devices called AR Spectacles, which can capture photos and videos overlayed with AR lenses, but these make up a small portion of Snap's overall sales.

name: Somethings
description: Somethings is a platform for wellness tailored to young people that links youngsters with qualified mentors.

name: SonarSource
description:
Sonar, the industry standard for code verification and automated code review, helps reduce outages, improve security, and lower risks associated with AI and agentic coding. As an independent verification platform, Sonar enables organizations to securely develop at the speed of AI. Sonar is the foundation for high performance software engineering, analyzing over 750 billion lines of code daily to ensure applications are secure, reliable, and maintainable. Rooted in the open source community, Sonar is trusted by 7M+ developers globally, including teams at NVIDIA, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company. 

To learn more about Sonar, please visit: www.sonar.com

name: SonderMind
description: SonderMind is a mental health care provider that offers both online and in-person therapy and psychiatric services. Founded in 2014 and based in Denver, the company has expanded its reach to all 50 states, with psychiatry services available in 27 states. SonderMind aims to enhance mental health care by making it more accessible, personalized, and effective.

name: Sora Schools
description: Sora is a private online middle and high school. Sora’s world-class faculty leads one-of-a-kind live classes, transforming today's students into tomorrow’s changemakers. Students truly have a say in their education in terms of what they study, how they learn a subject, and in what format they can demonstrate their knowledge. Sora’s full-time school program is accredited by COGNIA, WASC, and approved by the NCAA.

name: Sovryn
description: Sovryn is a Bitcoin-based decentralized trading and lending platform. It's developed on RSK, a side chain of the Bitcoin blockchain powered by merge-mining, and is governed by the community.

name: Spinny
description:
Spinny is a tech-powered new-age used car buying platform enabling trustworthy and hassle-free transactions in used cars. It also brings absolute trust and simplicity to the Indian used car market. They follow a full-stack business model to offer value, transparency, and simplicity to their customers.

Spinny's goal is to help our customers buy a car that matches their aspirations. It was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana, India.

name: Spiral
description: Spiral is building multimodal warehousing that works with the tools you love.

name: Spring Discovery
description: Spring Discovery is accelerating the discovery of therapies for aging. By targeting the biological processes of aging itself, the company aims to uncover new therapies for the diseases of old age, from cardiovascular to neurodegenerative disease, and increase its healthy lifespans. They built a machine learning platform to accelerate experimentation for discovering such therapies.

name: Sprinter Health
description: Sprinter Health is a mobile healthcare provider that combines technology and a full-stack medical practice to reimagine care at home. We partner with healthcare organizations to drive engagement with proactive, preventive care by combining convenient in-home visits for hands-on diagnostics with support from virtual clinicians to close care gaps, develop care plans, and reconnect patients back into longitudinal care.

name: Stacks
description: Stacks is a software platform that helps accounting teams automate and manage the financial close process with AI-driven tools that handle tasks like reconciliations, journal entries, variance analysis, and reporting in a unified workspace. It provides features to track closed tasks, match transactions, flag discrepancies, and connect directly with Enterprise Resource Planning systems to give real-time insights into financial data. The platform is designed to centralize close activities, reduce manual work, and offer visibility into progress and trends across the monthly close cycle. Stacks includes security controls such as encrypted data and permissioned access to protect sensitive accounting information. The company positions its solution as a way for finance groups to reduce time spent on repetitive tasks and shift focus to analysis and oversight.

name: Stan
description: Stan has built a platform that allows esports fans to collect, play, and trade digital collectibles such as non-fungible tokens (NFTs) of their favorite esports players and content creators, through which they can win physical and virtual world perks and rewards such as getting a chance to meet their favorite players.

name: Standard Bots
description: Standard Bots develops industrial robotics systems that combine robotic hardware with AI-driven software to automate manufacturing and operational tasks. Its product portfolio includes collaborative robotic arms with different payload capacities, as well as software platforms that support robot programming, fleet management, and application development. The company’s technology enables users to teach robots through demonstration rather than relying solely on traditional coding methods, allowing robots to perform tasks such as machine tending, inspection, palletizing, welding, and material handling. Standard Bots also provides AI capabilities that allow robots to learn from observed actions, adapt to changes in their environment, and improve task execution over time. In addition to its robotic systems, the company offers operating software, development tools, and integration capabilities designed to support deployment across a range of industrial workflows.

name: Standard Kernel
description: Standard Kernel builds AI technology that makes the core software running on GPUs and other accelerators faster and more efficient.

name: Step
description: Step is a financial services company that builds mobile-based banking for teenagers. It helps teens and young adults achieve financial independence and knowledge. The company's mission is to create a bank that gives its users the tools to become smarter with money and rewards along the financial journey.

name: Stilla
description: Stilla is an AI-powered productivity platform that transforms how product development teams coordinate work by automating organizational alignment through workflow and AI agent orchestration.

name: Stori Card
description: Stori Card is a digital financial platform serving underserved customers. The company focuses on using AI and technology to promote financial inclusion by providing middle- and emerging middle-class customers with access to digital credit cards as well as other digital financial products.

name: Story Health
description: Story Health helps specialists to understand medical situations and make clinical decisions that are through virtual protocols. Story Health uses data from high-frequency sources to help clinicians understand and take action on the physiological effects of disease and therapy. It was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Saratoga, California.

name: Strawberry
description: Strawberry is an agentic browser with built-in, personalized AI companions.

name: Substrate
description: Substrate builds a semiconductor foundry to revitalize semiconductor production capabilities. The company utilizes advanced X-ray lithography, which uses light billions of times brighter than the Sun to improve chip manufacturing efficiency.

name: Sunborne Systems
description: Sunborne Systems is a manufacturing company that provides sustainable fuel solutions and technology to reduce carbon emissions.

name: Super Evil Mega Corp
description: Super Evil Megacorp develops core games for tablet, mobile, and emerging platforms. The company's gaming platform offers video games on mobiles and tablets, enabling users to play single or multiple player games with special effects.

name: SuperPlay
description: SuperPlay is a game development studio that develops and publishes social games for the web and mobile devices. It specializes in creating engaging games to provide memorable experiences and encourage competition among players.

name: SupportLogic
description: SupportLogic is the leader in Support Experience (SX) management and post-sales Customer Experience (CX) observability. The SupportLogic SX platform enables companies to proactively understand and act on the voice of the customer, protect customer relationships, and retain revenue. Using predictive and generative AI, SupportLogic extracts and analyzes customer sentiment signals from both structured and unstructured data and provides recommendations, content, and collaborative workflows. SupportLogic is helping global enterprises like Salesforce, Qlik, Nutanix, Rubrik, and Snowflake to prevent customer escalations, reduce churn, and elevate the customer support experience. To learn more, visit supportlogic.com.

name: Take-Two Interactive
description: Take-Two Interactive Software is a developer, publisher, and marketer of interactive entertainment for consumers around the globe. The company primarily creates and releases products through the Rockstar Games, 2K, Private Division, and T2 Mobile Games divisions. Its products are currently made for mobile devices like smartphones and tablets, PCs, and gaming consoles. They are distributed through physical stores, digital downloads, online platforms, and cloud streaming services.

name: Talemonster Games
description: TaleMonster is a multinational mobile game firm that genuinely wants to provide millions of gamers experiences they won't soon forget. By putting our passion at the center of everything we make, we hope to reinvent what casual in mobile gaming means.

name: Taurus
description: Taurus is a developer of AI systems to support consumer brands, business operations, and revenue-generating workflows. The company builds AI-powered tools that automate tasks, analyze business signals, and assist with decision-making across commercial activities. Its technology enables organizations to leverage autonomous AI agents for workflow execution, operational efficiency, and business intelligence.

name: Teambridge
description: Teambridge is the only AI-native contingent workforce management platform that is purpose-built for the complexities of managing hourly, contract, and frontline teams. Teambridge helps businesses drive revenue, reduce costs, and retain talent. The fully composable, no-code platform unifies recruiting, onboarding, credentialing, scheduling, time tracking, and compliance into an end-to-end system, replacing manual processes with automations while giving you the flexibility to run your business your way. With a powerful, user-friendly app for everything from shift swaps to time tracking and earned wage access, Teambridge drives worker engagement and retention.

name: Teamworks
description: Teamworks is a privately held software company that provides a centralized platform for sports organizations to manage operations, communication, and athlete engagement. Its suite of applications supports functions such as logistics coordination, recruiting, compliance, performance nutrition, and athlete development. The company serves a diverse clientele, including collegiate and professional sports teams, Olympic and national governing bodies, as well as military and tactical units.

name: Teladoc Health
description: Teladoc Health is a virtual health provider with a telehealth platform delivering 24-hour, on-demand healthcare via mobile devices, the Internet, video, and phone.

name: TellTail
description:
TellTail is a breeder-focused community platform for dog breeders and puppy buyers. It provides community, education, and business support to dog breeders, who have historically been underserved in terms of infrastructure. Breeders are currently juggling inefficient platforms, social media restrictions, and complex business barriers, all while caring for vulnerable litters.

TellTail believes that providing business tools and education to nurturing breeders leads to stronger, healthier breeding programs - and, ultimately, healthier, happier lives for the approximately 6 million puppies that breeders send to new homes in the United States alone each year.

name: Tendo
description: Tendo's mission is to become the trusted connection between patients, clinicians, and caregivers by creating software that provides seamless, intuitive, and user-friendly experiences throughout the care journey.

name: Terragia
description: Terragia Biofuel provides the technology to drive the next generation of biofuels.

name: Thatch
description: Thatch provides a health benefits platform that enables employers to set employee health budgets and allows employees to select insurance and eligible healthcare services according to their needs. The platform supports insurance enrollment, plan selection, and spending on expenses such as prescriptions, therapy, diagnostic testing, preventive care, and other health-related services. Thatch Market provides access to healthcare products and services across areas including mental health, fertility, and weight management. The company also offers a payment card for eligible health-budget spending and provides enrollment assistance, plan-selection guidance, and support through phone, text, and email.

name: The Honest Company
description: The Honest Company creates eco-friendly, convenient, and affordable products for babies and homes. Its products include eco-friendly diapers and a natural line of bath, skincare, home cleaning, and organic nutritional supplement products, all packed in convenient bundles that can be customized, personalized, and conveniently shipped whenever needed.

name: The LAB Miami
description:
The LAB Miami is an innovation campus in the heart of Wynwood, Miami's most creative district. Our mission is to equip innovators with the knowledge and network to disrupt social and technological systems. We want to learn from the best, act on our passions, and build great companies. 

We're a community of entrepreneurs, artists, freelancers, startups, and change-makers who share space and ideas. We learn, act, and build together.

name: The Predictive Index
description: The Predictive Index empowers companies to align their talent strategy with their business strategy for optimal results. Its revolutionary talent optimization framework uses the PI Behavioral and Cognitive Assessments, comprehensive workshops, and expert consulting.

name: Tiyaro
description: Tiyaro is making AI accessible to any developer building an application.

name: TRACTIAN
description: Tractian is a machine intelligence company that provides condition monitoring and asset performance management for industrial operations.

name: Transcarent
description: Transcarent is the One Place for Health and Care that makes it easy for people to access high-quality, affordable health and care. We are transforming healthcare with the WayFinding™ experience. It is the first time the power of generative AI has been placed into the hands of health consumers. Our Members Just Ask Transcarent™ to find trusted, personalized answers, take the next step for their health, and get on-demand care.

name: TravelPerk
description: The intelligent platform for travel and spend. Perk’s powerful platform automates time-consuming tasks like travel bookings, expenses, and invoice processing. So your people can focus on real work, with real impact. Powerful for companies. Effortless for employees.

name: Tristero
description: Tristero develops dark-pool technology to make trading environments more transparent. They provide buyers and sellers with the ability to perform enormous trades discreetly that are hidden from the market and have no impact on market pricing by employing zero-knowledge cryptography.

name: Triumph
description: Triumph is a gaming monetization platform provider. They provide iPhone games with a one-line code drop-in SDK and handle the entire tournament stack through player matching, payment, arbitration, and compliance. They also transform the game into money tournaments.

name: Truvian Sciences
description: Truvian Sciences is a diagnostic company that is transforming the blood testing industry by developing an automated, benchtop system capable of providing lab-accurate results. The company's comprehensive wellness panel covers commonly ordered routine blood tests, including Complete Blood Count, Metabolic Panel, Lipid Panel, and more, all from a single sample.

name: Twenty
description: Twenty Technologies builds cyber warfare software to automate and accelerate offensive cyber operations.

name: Uni Cards
description:
A smart way to get a Visa card within minutes. With Uni, pay flexibly in 3 parts over 3 months for no extra costs. Apply now and get the digital card on the Uni app. We’re currently lifetime free for early users.

Uni Cards was established in October 2020 by Nitin Gupta in Bangalore, Karnataka.

name: Uno Health
description:
UNO Health matches low-income seniors to non-clinical services that meet their needs outside the doctor’s office.

UNO enrolls and re-certifies any Medicare members in all state and federal programs they are eligible for, putting thousands of dollars in their pockets and unlocking direct revenue and savings for their plan.

name: Upside
description:
Upside (formerly GetUpside) is a U.S.-based marketplace for in-person purchases at gas stations, grocery stores, and restaurants. Its two-sided platform connects consumers looking to earn cash back on everyday purchases with businesses looking to grow by attracting new customers and driving repeat visits.

Consumers earn cash back that they can easily cash out to a bank account or their choice of gift cards at any time. Retailers pay only for proven incremental transactions, not for impressions or clicks. The app is free to download with no subscription required. To date, consumers have earned over $1 billion in cash back, and retailers have earned $3 billion in incremental profit.

name: Valinor
description: Developer of a go-to-market engine designed for technologists building products for defense. The company provides a marketplace for the development of technologists building products to get more products into the hands of warfighters and public servants who need them, enabling builders, government, and capital providers to participate in the defense and broader government tech landscape and ensure real mission gaps are fulfilled.

name: Vannevar Labs
description:
Vannevar Labs is a group of technologists and former defense and intelligence officers building computer vision and natural language processing products for some of the country’s most important national security problems. The company believes its military service members and intelligence officers deserve access to the best technology American innovation can offer and is building great products for this mission.

Vannevar Labs was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

name: Variant Bio
description:
Variant Bio is leveraging the power of human genetic diversity to discover new therapeutics. The company's focus is to identify individuals and populations around the world who are extreme outliers for traits of medical relevance and to use innovative sequencing and analytic approaches to identify genes and pathways linked to these traits.

Variant Bio was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Seattle, Washington.

name: Veho
description: Veho provides technology-enabled parcel delivery and logistics services for eCommerce brands. The company operates a network of warehouses and delivery partners to support last-mile shipping, including next-day and two-day delivery, while providing brands and customers with delivery tracking, flexible delivery options, and customer support.

name: Verkada
description: Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, AI-powered platform. A leader in cloud physical security, Verkada helps organizations strengthen safety and efficiency through one connected platform. Its solutions—including video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and workplace tools—work seamlessly in Verkada Command, a cloud-based software experience built for scale. From finding footage in seconds to identifying events like a door held open, a visitor check-in, or a change in air quality, Verkada gives teams the insight to see, understand, and act with confidence—helping create safer, smarter environments.

name: Verta
description: Verta builds software infrastructure to help enterprise data science and machine learning (ML) teams develop and deploy ML models. Verta enables anyone to streamline your data science and ML workflows and deploy models into production faster while ensuring real-time model health.

name: Vevo Therapeutics
description: Tahoe Therapeutics develops AI-powered tools to simulate human cell responses and guide drug discovery. It operates a platform called Mosaic that produces large-scale single-cell datasets detailing how drug molecules interact with diverse patient cells, with initial applications in oncology. It open-sources its Tahoe-100M dataset, comprising hundreds of millions of single-cell profiles, to train AI models that build virtual cell models for therapeutic insights. A recent funding round enabled the creation of an even larger dataset, targeting one billion cell datapoints and one million drug-patient interactions, designed to fuel next-generation precision medicines.

name: Vial
description: Vial is a biotech company that provides advanced programs for clinics to conduct lower-cost trials. They specialize in computationally designed therapeutics and leverage technology to automate clinical trials.

name: Visor
description: Unlike disconnected spreadsheets and complicated integrations, Visor unifies three crucial capabilities in one product: Visor is flexible to evolve as your needs do, it has built-in two-way integrations you can trust, and its real-time collaboration features bring everyone together. Achieve amazing things by bringing people and data together in one place with Visor.

name: Vital Lyfe
description:
Vital Lyfe is a Climatech product manufacturer that develops systems to produce safe drinking water from a range of natural sources, including seawater, without reliance on centralized infrastructure. The company designs portable water-making hardware that combines filtration, purification, and engineering principles adapted from aerospace to enable autonomous operation in diverse environments. Its offerings aim to serve use cases where traditional water infrastructure is limited or unavailable, such as humanitarian relief, maritime operations, disaster response, and off-grid communities.

Vital Lyfe provides hardware platforms alongside supporting software for monitoring and management of water quality and system performance. The company engages with partners in sectors like non-governmental organizations, maritime organizations, and outdoor or expedition users to deploy and validate its solutions. It continues to refine and scale its technologies toward broader market availability and expanded field applications.

name: Viva Translate
description: Viva Translate helps people around the world communicate in English, Spanish, and Portuguese in real time.

name: Vivere
description: Vivere Partners is a specialty insurance company focused on tailored insurance policies.

name: Vroom
description:
Vroom is an innovative, end-to-end e-commerce platform designed to offer a better way to buy and sell used vehicles. The company's scalable, data-driven technology brings all phases of the vehicle buying and selling process to consumers wherever they are and offers an extensive selection of vehicles, transparent pricing, competitive financing, and at-home pick-up and delivery.

It was founded in 2013 and is located in New York City.

name: Vulcan Technologies
description: We build the Al infrastructure that lets governments, enterprises, and policy teams operate at the speed of law. Request an executive briefing to see the platform in your environment.

name: Wag
description: Wag is a mobile application used to instantly find trusted and certified dog walkers. You’ll receive a push notification when the walk starts, followed by real-time GPS tracking of the walk. Once the walk is complete, you’ll receive a report card with a photo, notes, the distance traveled, and a pee/poop report.

name: Warby Parker
description: Warby Parker is a lifestyle brand that offers designer eyewear at a revolutionary price, operating as a socially conscious business. Approximately one billion people don't have access to affordable glasses. Glasses can increase one's income by 20%, enable students to see a blackboard, and offer dignity to those with poor eyesight. Warby Parker works with experienced non-profit partners to ensure that each sale of our frames will give someone in need access to affordable glasses.

name: WellTheory
description:
Autoimmune disease is one of the fastest-growing and most costly categories in healthcare today. It impacts over 50 million Americans and costs the system more than $160 billion annually. It’s also one of the most misunderstood. For too long, patients have been dismissed, unheard, and left without answers. WellTheory is on a mission to change that. We’re building something we wish had existed years ago on our own journeys — care that’s truly personalized, proactive, and rooted in compassion.

This is an exciting moment to join our team. We’ve raised $26.2M in funding and are backed by top-tier investors like General Catalyst, Accel, 7wire, and Box Group. In the past year, we’ve grown 10x in membership and 5x in revenue.

At WellTheory, we believe that anything can be achieved through pure will, determination, and grit and value teammates with a similar mentality. If that sounds like you we hope you’ll join us. 🚀

name: Windsurf
description:
Windsurf offers an AI coding assistant designed to enhance developers' productivity. The platform features an integrated development environment that simplifies coding tasks and streamlines workflows. It supports multiple operating systems, including Mac, Windows, and Linux, making it accessible to a wide range of users.

Windsurf provides a free version for individual developers, while teams can access additional features through an enterprise offering. This flexibility allows users to choose the option that best suits their needs.

By focusing on usability and functionality, Windsurf aims to improve its users' overall coding experience.

name: Wonder
description: Wonder is a food technology company that operates a mealtime platform offering restaurant meals, prepared foods, meal kits, and food delivery through a unified ordering experience. It develops and manages food preparation, ordering, and delivery using proprietary technology, including its Infinite Kitchen food robotics platform. The company partners with chefs and restaurant brands to provide a variety of meal options that customers can order through its platform. It also manages the preparation and fulfillment process to support delivery and pickup services across its locations. Additionally, Wonder expands its food ecosystem through the operation and integration of restaurant concepts, meal kit services, and delivery capabilities.

name: Wordsmith AI
description: Wordsmith AI develops artificial intelligence software for in-house legal teams, helping them manage legal work, review documents, conduct research, and respond to legal requests within existing business workflows. The platform uses AI agents trained on an organization's contracts, policies, playbooks, and internal knowledge to assist with tasks such as contract drafting, document review, legal guidance, and matter triage. Wordsmith integrates with tools such as email, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Word, and document repositories, allowing legal teams to access information and complete work without switching between multiple systems. The platform also provides workflow automation, audit trails, and reporting capabilities that support legal operations and oversight. Its products are designed for corporate legal departments seeking to handle routine legal processes internally while maintaining human review for decisions that require professional judgment.

name: XFlow
description: XFlow is a software company that builds payments infrastructure that enables businesses to send and receive money. They perform compliance checks such as determining the purpose of transfers, completing required forms, and generating electronic Foreign Inward Remittance Advice.

name: ZAGENO
description: ZAGENO is the leading R&D lab supply procurement platform, streamlining sourcing for scientists and procurement teams with 100% automated transactions, pre-negotiated savings, and AI-driven insights. Researchers access 50M+ SKUs from 6,000 suppliers with real-time availability while procurement teams optimize supplier relationships, consolidate orders, and enhance compliance. With end-to-end source-to-pay automation, ZAGENO eliminates manual work and maverick buying, reducing costs and improving efficiency through its industry-first Metacart and One Creditor Model. Available on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices, ZAGENO makes biotech purchases easier than ever and is an ideal sales channel for suppliers and partners. Founded in 2015, ZAGENO has offices in Boston, Massachusetts; Berlin, Germany; and Bangalore, India.

name: Zarminali Health
description: Zarminali Health provides coordinated pediatric healthcare services and support designed to streamline how children receive care from primary providers and specialists through integrated models and technology-enabled tools. The company supports outpatient pediatric physician practices by enabling care coordination, practice management, and collaboration across clinical teams to reduce administrative complexity for clinicians and simplify care navigation for families. Its services include connecting families with comprehensive primary care, specialty services, urgent care options, and virtual care touchpoints that help maintain continuity through various stages of a child’s development. Zarminali Health also deploys technology platforms aimed at improving communication among care teams and enhancing the clinical experience for both providers and patients. The organization works with pediatric clinicians to align workflows, improve access to timely care, and support consistent health outcomes for children. Zarminali Health’s approach integrates care delivery and management to address fragmentation in traditional pediatric healthcare systems and provide a more cohesive care experience.

name: Zego
description: Zego is a motor insurance provider serving consumers and the self-employed, with a mission to make good drivers better drivers.

name: Zepto
description: Zepto is a quick-commerce platform that delivers groceries and daily essentials within minutes through a network of stores. It is an online store that offers a range of fruits, vegetables, snack food, and electronics. It provides a service that enables access to various grocery products. Zepto serves industries such as retail, food and beverage, and logistics.

name: Zerigo Health
description:
Clarify Medical is innovating a well-established treatment, UVB therapy, to become easier, more convenient, more empowering, and more connected for psoriasis, eczema, and vitiligo patients. The company also focused on developing innovative technology, products, and services that improve care for people with chronic skin conditions.

Clarify Medical is indicated for the localized phototherapeutic treatment of dermatologic conditions such as psoriasis, vitiligo, atopic dermatitis (eczema), seborrheic dermatitis, and leukoderma on all skin types (I-VI). It is the first and only connected phototherapy system that uses an app on the patient’s own smartphone (iOS or Android) to manage the dose, frequency, and duration of UVB light therapy, helping to ensure that patients receive the proper doses recommended by the American Academy of Dermatology and Vitiligo Working Group.

The treatment regimen is prescribed by the patient’s physician but monitored and controlled by the Clarify System, enabling patients to administer treatment with clinical precision in the convenience of their homes. The connected system monitors dosing, adherence, compliance, patient progress, and satisfaction.

name: Zip Security
description: Zip Security delivers an AI-driven cybersecurity and compliance platform that automates cloud-based identity management, device management, and endpoint threat detection. The platform automates deployment and management of tools like endpoint detection, device and identity management, secure browsing, and compliance frameworks such as SOC-2 and HIPAA. It integrates with solutions like CrowdStrike, Intune, Jamf, Google Workspace, and Okta, enabling businesses without security teams to maintain effective defenses.

name: Zorus, Inc.
description: Zorus provides cybersecurity solutions for IT professionals and managed service providers. Its platform offers DNS and network filtering, user analytics, zero-trust device isolation, Geo IP and network filtering, and SaaS usage insights. Zorus’s CyberSight technology analyzes user activity across thick-client and SaaS applications to provide security and usage insights.

name: 100ms
description: 100ms is a live-video infrastructure platform that provides subscription-based products to its customers. The company provides a low-code solution for companies looking to add video/audio conferencing within their own applications. The increasingly virtual, remote-first world needs an infrastructure provider that allows these experiences to happen seamlessly. 100ms' best-in-class quality and ease of use are fueling this revolution. Making live video work - our team has been obsessed with this problem for years and solved it at world-class scales for different network and device conditions. A great infrastructure provider also needs to have the shortest integration time - so our foundation is built on the above two principles.

name: 1Balance
description: 1Balance is a personalized nutrition company that helps you be in your optimally balanced healthy zone more often. At 1Balance, our aim is to combine the best of traditional medicine, herbal science, and personalization to create nutritional supplements and foods that are made with the highest quality natural ingredients, just for you. We strongly believe that healthcare should be personal and holistic. Our Personalization technology goes beyond just standard deficiencies, into your body type and needs, and maps it with the latest in herbal science research and the knowledge of the experts in practices like Yoga, Ayurveda, Diet and Nutrition, and Naturopathy.

name: 1Password
description:
1Password is a secure password manager that provides businesses and families with a safe way to share passwords, credit cards, and documents. It keeps important information secure with AES 256-bit encryption. They allow users to keep the information easily organized with convenient categories and tags and find what they need with a customizable search.

Founded in 2005, 1Password remembers and fills web forms with passwords, credit card information, and addresses—with a single click. It is focused on making security convenient and keeping customers happy. It is headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, in Canada.

name: 6sense
description: 6sense reinvents the way organizations create, manage, and convert pipelines to revenue. 6sense Revenue AI captures anonymous buying signals, targets the right accounts, and recommends the channels and messages to boost revenue performance. Removing guesswork, friction, and wasted sales effort, 6sense empowers sales, marketing, and customer success teams to significantly improve pipeline quality, accelerate sales velocity, increase conversion rates, and grow revenue predictably.

name: 99designs
description:
99designs is the global creative platform that makes it easy for designers and clients to work together to create designs they love. Their tried-and-true creative process has become the go-to solution for businesses, agencies, and individuals.

Since 2008, 99designs has grown from a small online forum into a global community of talented designers. Headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, with offices in Oakland, California, and Berlin, Germany, 99designs champions creativity to bring opportunities to people around the world.

name: Aavenir
description:
Aavenir is a Software-as-a-Service-based source-to-pay solutions provider. It revolutionizes age-old procurement processes by using the latest Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing technologies to reduce cycle time, yet offering insightful best practices suggestions based on historical data.

It was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Plano, Texas.

name: Acalvio Technologies
description: Acalvio is an AI-powered preemptive cybersecurity company focused on countering AI-driven identity and infrastructure intrusion. Its 360 Deception platform combines Dynamic Deception, evolving HoneyPaths, and cloaking of production assets within deception fabric to disrupt automated reconnaissance, credential abuse, and lateral movement across identity systems, endpoints, cloud, network, and cyber-physical environments. By altering what attackers can perceive and trust, Acalvio shifts detection from post-compromise analysis to pre-impact exposure, enabling organizations to detect, delay, disrupt, and deny malicious activity at machine speed. The company serves enterprise and government organizations determined to break automated intrusion at its source.

name: Accacia
description: Accacia is an AI-enabled real-estate decarbonization platform that allows RE and infrastructure owners, developers, asset managers, and operators to measure, track, and manage their climate risks.

name: ACKO
description: Acko is a digital insurance company that provides a range of general insurance products through a direct-to-consumer model. The company offers services including motor insurance, health insurance, and employee group health coverage. Acko operates with a technology-driven approach, utilizing data analytics and digital platforms to streamline the purchase, management, and claims process for policyholders. Its motor insurance policies cover private vehicles and two-wheelers, with services such as instant policy issuance and paperless claims. In health insurance, Acko provides personalized plans with features like zero waiting period and flexible benefits. For businesses, Acko delivers group health insurance solutions with digital onboarding, claims support, and wellness programs for employees. The company partners with platforms in sectors such as e-commerce, mobility, and travel to distribute its embedded insurance products.

name: AdRoll
description: AdRoll is a connected advertising platform built for growth-minded marketers. With powerful AI, flexible campaign tools, and seamless integrations, AdRoll helps mid-sized businesses turn complexity into clarity and clicks into customers. The AdRoll platform delivers full-funnel performance through multi-channel advertising, audience insights, and cross-channel attribution, supporting marketers across industries including Ecommerce, Technology, Financial Services, Education, and more. For B2B teams, AdRoll ABM extends these capabilities with account-based precision, multi-touch campaigns, and real-time buyer intelligence. Backed by nearly 20 years of data and award-winning support, AdRoll enables marketing teams to advertise smarter, move faster, and achieve more, all from one place.

name: AegisAI
description: Aegis AI develops an AI-native email security platform that helps organizations detect and respond to email-based cyber threats. The platform uses coordinated AI agents to analyze email content, sender behavior, and communication patterns to identify phishing attempts, business email compromise, malware, ransomware, spam, and other evolving threats. It integrates with email services such as Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 through APIs, allowing deployment without requiring changes to existing mail routing. The platform provides automated threat detection, quarantine and remediation capabilities, along with reporting and visibility into targeted attacks and security trends. Aegis AI also supports security teams by reducing manual review efforts and adapting to emerging email threats through AI-driven analysis rather than relying solely on static rules or signatures.

name: Agave
description: Agave provides a unified API for accessing data across all construction software systems, such as Procore, BIM 360, QuickBooks Online, and others. Agave's software combines project management, financial, and bidding platform tools, allowing developers to access all available data.

name: Agrostar
description: Founded in 2013, AgroStar is one of India’s foremost AgTech start-ups, working on the mission of #HelpingFarmersWin. AgroStar’s omnichannel platform provides end-to-end solutions for Indian farmers, helping them grow better, enabling them to increase their yield and reduce their cost of cultivation. Our solutions are powered by an extensive amount of data and agronomy knowledge. Our omnichannel approach has further enhanced our reach to cover millions of farmers in the country. AgroStar currently operates in the states of Gujarat, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, and Uttar Pradesh. Farmers in these states can avail of agri solutions for the entire crop life-cycle with a simple call to our Agri Advisory Center, through the AgroStar Agri Doctor app, and by visiting an AgroStar retail store.

name: Airkit
description:
Airkit.ai is a customer engagement platform that enables brands to build digital customer experiences faster. Airkit allows customers to abstract away frontend development with prebuilt components and templates for web, mobile, voice, and chat. They can also create brand components and asset libraries while flowing customer data across core systems and Airkit-powered experiences via APIs and integrations.

Airkit can measure and optimize experiences with built-in app analytics and reporting on user engagement, and the platform provides debugging and tooling to help ship apps. It enables developers to test operations and data flows in a staging environment with app tracing, which allows them to preview an app in different resolutions and device frames.

name: Airmeet
description: Airmeet serves as an all-in-one virtual events platform for event organizers, marketers, community builders, and enterprises. With a core focus on creating the immersive and integrated virtual events platform for knowledge professionals, Airmeet’s scalable platform supports a variety of event formats including fairs, expos, meetups, workshops, summits, town halls, and more, virtually.

name: Airs.ai
description: Solda.AI builds brand-custom, multilingual AI voice agents for banks and fintechs. The platform autonomously handles inbound and outbound calls, messages, and emails across a wide range of industry-specific scenarios, while delivering human-like voice quality (with a 1% detection rate) and providing deep CRM integration.

name: Akridata
description: Akridata is revolutionizing AI-powered visual inspection, enabling manufacturers to automate or assist human inspection with human-like judgment and machine-level precision. Our cutting-edge computer vision technology enhances quality control by detecting defects faster, more accurately, and at scale, ensuring higher efficiency and reduced errors across industrial and medical device manufacturing. With AI that sees, thinks, and inspects like an expert, Akridata helps businesses move from manual review to intelligent automation.

name: akridata.com
description: Akridata was started by a team of serial entrepreneurs with the vision to solve a unique set of problems around visual data in the life cycle of AI training. We are the first company to focus exclusively on the problem of visual data at the edge.

name: Akto
description: Akto is a platform for securing APIs and assists in quickly discovering APIs, running tests, and identifying business logic weaknesses.

name: Algolia
description: Algolia is the search-as-a-service platform that enables companies of all sizes to deliver fast and relevant digital experiences that drive real results. With Algolia, consumers can easily find and discover what they want across the web, mobile, and voice. Algolia allows developers and business teams to build and optimize delightful search and discovery experiences that increase online engagement, conversion rates, and revenue.

name: Ally.io (Acquired)
description:
Ally.io is a strategic goal-planning and execution management software helping businesses execute strategies and reach their goals.

It enables businesses to shift from traditional, disjointed planning and execution to a modern, OKR-based framework that drives strong alignment, agility, transparency, and empowers the workforce. The Ally.io solution makes it easy to adopt OKRs as a seamless part of the users' daily workflow. The platform has built-in OKR best practices and provides seamless integration to several enterprise systems including Slack, Salesforce, Jira, Smartsheet, Asana, and ZenDesk. Ally’s comprehensive professional services offer continuous support, dedicated training, and coaching to ensure best practices for implementation and successful change management.

Vetri Vellore launched the company in 2018 in Bellevue, Washington.

name: Altinity
description: Altinity is the real-time data company that lets you run and manage databases anywhere. We enable developers to add real-time analytics to any application, regardless of where it runs, how much data it needs to answer questions, or how quickly the data arrives.

name: Amagi
description:
Amagi Media Labs is a media technology company that offers cloud-based solutions for broadcast and connected TV. The company facilitates the geographic targeting of TV advertisements. It is a unique mix of media and innovation that has made way for a new TV-media advertising platform. Amagi brings services that are cost-effective, powerful, focused, and result-oriented.

Headquartered in New York, Amagi was founded in 2008.

name: Anar
description: Anar helps small and medium business (SMB) communities build their network online and offline, providing access to new products, current market trends, and knowledge to innovate their venture into the broader market.

name: Ando
description: We're reimagining what a work messaging platform looks like when AI agents are actual teammates, not just tools. Backed by Accel, Index, and Emergence.

name: ANSR
description: ANSR Consulting is providing end-to-end services for companies, setting up captive service centers.

name: Anyfin
description:
We want to help as many as possible to the best possible financial situation. Using new technology, we develop fair, simple, and smart services that help you get more from your finances. So that you can do more of what makes you feel good.

We saw that many paid unnecessarily high interest and fees for part-payments, credit cards, and private loans. So that’s where we started out. Through smart technology and skipping unnecessary middlemen, we could offer the lowest possible rate. And we decided straight away: we would always try to help you improve your finances. Never give an offer if we can’t improve your situation. Only make things better.

You could say we started out by helping you deal with your financial past. That was in 2018. In 2020, we launched more services, for instance, helping you keep track of subscriptions and plan your finances. Ways to simplify your financial everyday life. So that we can help you build your financial future. And we’re just getting started.

Anyfin is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

name: Aorato
description:
Aorato protects your organization and Active Directory by automatically learning, profiling, and predicting entity behavior.

Aorato’s Directory Services Application Firewall (DAF™) protects Active Directory and leverages its central role in the network to secure the organization from advanced targeted attacks.

Nowadays, attackers compromise all types of entities (non-privileged and privileged users, devices, servers, etc.) in order to gain a foothold into the network. It is not enough anymore to track only privileged accounts to protect the organization against advanced attacks. DAF introduces a new approach. DAF detects suspicious activities through learning, profiling, and predicting entities’ behaviors.

The best part? DAF is a non-intrusive solution, transparent to Active Directory.

name: Apna Mart
description: ApnaMart is a shop and online retail store.

name: Appbrew
description: Appbrew empowers brands to build and scale high conversion mobile apps through a no-code platform. We are backed by Accel Partners, prominent DTC, and SaaS founders.

name: Appsmith
description: Appsmith provides open-source low code software that helps developers build custom internal and CRUD (Create, Read, Update, and Delete) type applications quickly. The company was founded in mid-2019, and its open-source software has been downloaded over 5 million times, with users at over 1,000 enterprises in 100-plus countries.

name: Aptly
description:
Aptly uses Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to help property teams drive higher retention and renewals by recognizing effective communication patterns from millions of property conversations. Aptly analyzes email, SMS, and phone calls so property teams and executives can understand what’s happening in every conversation. Aptly then correlates these conversation insights with property management data to route conversations to the most qualified team member and suggest or automate responses. Additionally, it automates gathering feedback in a survey which gets factored into a resident and property happiness score.

Our team has 80 years of combined real estate experience, scaled and exited (IPO) a SaaS solution for the rentals industry, and is backed by Accel Ventures, Slack Fund, and C-Level executives from Facebook, Salesforce.com, and Twilio.

name: Aramya
description:
Our vision is to build some of the world’s most loved fashion and lifestyle brands — and enable people to express themselves.

With a fast-moving team driven by creativity, technology, and customer obsession, we’re building a movement that celebrates every woman’s unique journey.

name: Arivihan Technologies
description: Arivihan is an automated virtual learning environment that puts a personal tutor right in each student's pocket.

name: Arrakis Finance
description: Developer of a decentralized market-making platform designed to help businesses bootstrap liquidity for tokens. The company's platform enables projects to create deep liquidity for their tokens while deploying automated liquidity management strategies that earn annual percentage yield, providing businesses with leverage protocol automated liquidity management to acquire the inventory to create deep liquidity for the token.

name: AssemblyAI
description: Speech AI technology development and advancement are the main goals of the AssemblyAI company. Building and scaling extremely accurate, user-friendly, and secure speech recognition models is the main focus of their work. These models are made to interpret and comprehend human speech, and thousands of users, top businesses, and developers around the world are already making extensive use of their technology. The company aims to expand Speech Artificial Intelligence by developing sophisticated models that will open up whole new kinds of voice data-based applications and goods. In essence, they are trying to democratize and innovate the potential of Speech Artificial Intelligence for a variety of use cases and sectors.

name: Astro
description:
Astro is Indonesia’s first and fastest-growing quick commerce platform, delivering groceries and essentials in minutes, 24/7.

With a mission to simplify lives, Astro saves people time, energy, and money through speed and convenience. Inspired by real astronauts, the company embodies boldness, innovation, and agility in everything it does.

name: Atira
description:
Streamline every stage of the sales engineering (CPQ) lifecycle of complex hardware products with industry-specific pre-trained agents.

Atira provides sales and mechanical engineers with the modern toolkit they deserve to ensure that the best machinery products are quoted and sold efficiently. We replace spreadsheets and legacy software with industry-trained AI agents that do the heavy lifting, so engineers can focus on engineering-grade thinking, not data wrangling.

Built by engineers for engineers, our platform integrates with your existing PLM, CRM, and ERP systems, turning weeks of back-and-forth into hours. Headquartered in Munich, we’re building software that lets the world’s best manufacturing minds sell the right machine fast.

name: Atlas
description: Atlas' methodology combines embedded AI technologies, digital growth capabilities, and operational infrastructure to let businesses serve more clients without increasing manpower. We're redefining accounting, one relationship at a time.

name: Atlassian
description: Atlassian develops collaboration and productivity software that helps teams plan, build, and support work. Its products include tools for project management, software development, collaboration, and IT Service Management, delivered primarily through cloud-based subscription models.

name: Atrato
description: Atrato is a fintech company that allows affiliated merchants to offer a safe, accessible, and reliable Buy Now, Pay Later method to their customers. Customers can use Atrato to make purchases at affiliated stores, either online or in person, and pay them off over the course of up to 24 months without using a credit or debit card. Atrato's mission is to provide fair financial tools and services that improve Latin America's quality of life.

name: August Ai
description: August AI is a healthcare technology company building an AI-powered health companion designed to support people between doctor visits. It helps users interpret medical reports, understand symptoms, and navigate healthcare information through conversational AI. Founded in India, the platform combines medical expertise and artificial intelligence to make healthcare guidance more accessible and understandable.

name: Autonomy
description:
Autonomy, an HP company, is a software company specializing in helping organizations globally derive meaning from information. As an industry pioneer, Autonomy's technology is designed to interpret and process unstructured human information, enabling businesses to extract real value from this data.

Human information, which constitutes most content today, exists in various formats such as documents, emails, pictures, audio, video, and communications through mobile and social media. Unlike traditional tagging or keyword-based solutions, Autonomy employs advanced pattern-matching technology to understand this data comprehensively. This approach allows computers to capture the meaning of all types of information, including structured, extreme, or big data from diverse sources like databases, call detail records, gene sequencing, sensors, algorithmic trading, and click streams. Autonomy’s software aims to simplify complexity and unlock the true value within data.

Autonomy's solutions are designed to comprehend the full spectrum of enterprise information and its relationships. By enabling computers to grasp the nuances of information beyond binary classifications, organizations can automate processes, ensure regulatory compliance, act in real-time, and enhance business outcomes.

The challenge with human information lies in its unstructured nature; it does not conform to the orderly format of databases but is found in various forms such as books, emails, surveillance videos, chat streams, and phone calls across different platforms and devices. This unstructured information grows at a rate three times faster than structured data, representing approximately 90 percent of all information. Modern enterprises face the challenge of understanding and extracting value from this extensive and diverse data.

With Autonomy, organizations can now process and comprehend the meaning of all types of information in real-time. This development marks a significant shift in information technology, focusing on enhancing the understanding aspect rather than just the technological components.

name: Avenue
description: Avenue is a software platform that enables business and operations teams to set up alerts directly from their databases and data warehouses. It allows teams to create automated, persistent alerts based on nuanced data triggers, helping them monitor operational activity beyond standard dashboard metrics. By delivering alerts directly from existing data sources, Avenue helps teams identify critical issues and respond to them in real time.

name: Avito
description:
Avito is a classified advertisements platform that allows users to buy and sell used cars, clothes, real estate, and other accessories. The buyers and sellers use its line of business for the exchange of products and services such as coins, collectibles, computers, memorabilia, stamps, and toys, as well as concert and sporting tickets.

Jonas Nordlanderr and Filip Engelbert founded Avito in 2007. Its headquarters is in Moscow in the Russian Federation.

name: Away
description:
Away is a modern travel and lifestyle brand. The company is a vertically integrated company offering beautiful, high-quality luggage at an affordable price point.

Away designs special objects for modern travel. It started with luggage, designed with thoughtful features that solve real travel problems—for life. Now all that’s left is the world in front of you and the people you share it with. Because getting Away means getting more out of every trip to come.

name: Axio Biosolutions
description: Axio is a MedTech R&D and Manufacturing Company focused on Advanced Surgical and Wound Care. Axio has the distinction of being the first company from India to get USFDA clearance for a Wound Care/Hemostat product. Controlling life-threatening bleeding continues to be the major cause of death from traumatic injuries. Axiostat is its flagship product developed to reduce mortality due to traumatic bleeding. A CE approved product, Axiostat is based on a patented novel 100% chitosan platform and has variants catering to Emergency & Trauma, Military, Cardiovascular, and Dental applications.

name: Axle Energy
description: Axle's software dynamically gives flexibility to the electricity grid and adjusts energy usage to when it is cheapest and greenest.

name: Axonius
description: Axonius is a cybersecurity asset management platform that enables organizations to maintain a comprehensive asset inventory, identify gaps in security solution coverage, and validate and enforce security policies. The platform offers a unified, extensible, and open system that consolidates data from networked devices and existing device-specific management tools into a single environment for visibility and control.

name: Beam
description: Beam helps construction businesses build more. We build AI and financial tools designed to automate the spreadsheets and paperwork that slow contractors down, replacing hours of manual work with a system that drives more profitable projects. With Beam’s AI Assistant, builders can turn plans into professional estimates in minutes rather than hours. Beam lets you view real-time project financials, manage expenses, and automate bill payments in a single place. Beam connects directly to QuickBooks to eliminate double-entry, making it faster and easier for contractors to estimate, invoice, and pay bills.

name: Beek
description:
Beek is building the top audio platform in Latin America. 10/10 people you see on the streets with headphones will be listening on Beek to the best audiobooks, podcasts, meditations, and any audio content that they like. 

There will be a Netflix for spoken word audio for the 480M+ native Spanish speakers, and Beek is the team building it.

name: bere.al
description: BeReal is a social networking app that encourages users to share authentic, unfiltered photos of their everyday lives with friend

name: BestDoc
description: BestDoc is an Intelligent Patient Relationship Management (PRM) system for hospitals and other healthcare providers in India.

name: Bevy
description:
Bevy is an enterprise-grade virtual conference and community events SaaS platform. It incorporates a variety of tools to plan, promote, and execute virtual conferences and community events. The platform is a flexible software solution that can be used to manage and host thousands of different types of virtual events. Built with enterprise-level analytics, integrations, and data security, the Bevy platform is used by a range of enterprise, consumer, and education teams who want to host virtual events and turn them into thriving global communities. Featuring a deep permissions system and webcasting capabilities, community and field marketing teams can empower local brand advocates all over the world to build small local communities that collectively provide reach and scale.

The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

name: Binocs
description: Binocs is an agentic AI platform that automates deal research and strategic advisory for private equity funds, consulting firms, investment banks, and corporate development teams. Its AI agents mimic the structure of real-world investment teams to generate decision-ready outputs — including commercial due diligence reports, investment memos, industry primers, deal screening summaries, growth strategies, sell-side CIMs, credit assessment memos, and financial statement analysis — at a fraction of the time and cost of traditional approaches. Trusted by 2 of the top 60 PE funds in the US and 2 of the Big 4 consulting firms, Binocs delivers consistent, citation-backed outputs with enterprise-grade security (SOC 2 compliant). Its platform covers the full deal lifecycle — from origination and screening to diligence, portfolio value creation, and exit preparation. Backed by Accel, Blume Ventures, Beenext, Arkam Ventures, and Premji Invest, Binocs has been recognized by CIO Tech Outlook as one of the top 10 most promising GenAI startups of 2025 and selected for the NASSCOM GenAI Foundry and INSEAD AI Venture Lab.

name: Biostate Ai
description: Biostate AI is a company focused on providing AI-powered solutions for the life sciences and healthcare industries. The company develops data-driven tools to optimize medical research, drug discovery, and clinical trials. By leveraging artificial intelligence and machine learning, Biostate AI aims to streamline complex processes and improve decision-making. Their products include platforms for predictive analytics, data integration, and patient recruitment, which help organizations enhance efficiency and accuracy in medical and clinical operations. Through their innovations, Biostate AI supports the advancement of healthcare through smarter technology applications.

name: Bird
description: MessageBird powers communication between businesses and their customers — across any channel, always with the right context, and on every corner of the planet. Its products and solutions are the foundational building blocks to business communications across preferred channels, like SMS, Voice, WhatsApp, WeChat, Messenger, Email, and more. Founded in Amsterdam in 2011, MessageBird connects to billions of devices and is trusted by nearly 20,000 customers. It operates across nine worldwide hubs and is proud to be a “Work Anywhere” company.

name: Bizongo
description:
Bizongo develops a tech-enabled B2B e-commerce and supply chain platform for packaging, apparel, and other customized goods. It digitally transforms the fragmented and unorganized yet unique and ubiquitous B2B segment of customized goods. The company focuses on packaging, textiles, apparel, and other contract manufacturing goods as its product portfolio and has a network of over 1,500 curated manufacturers across these categories.

Bizongo was founded in 2015 by three IIT graduates Aniket Deb, Sachin Agrawal, and Ankit Tomar.

name: BlaBlaCar
description:
BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading long-distance carpooling community, connecting people looking to travel long distances with drivers going the same way. They travel together and share the costs of the journey.

The platform is engineered to create a secure, trust-based community with declared identities and full member profiles. Members can even specify how chatty they are from “Bla” to “BlaBlaBla,” hence the name BlaBlaCar.

BlaBlaCar is creating a global people-powered network with a trusted community of drivers and passengers.

Backed by Accel Partners, Insight Ventures, Index Ventures, Lead Edge Capital, Baring Vostok, and ISAI, it operates in 22 countries across Europe, Russia, Turkey, Mexico, Brazil, and India. The site and free mobile apps provide a range of features to create a secure, trust-based community and easy connections between drivers and passengers.

BlaBlaCar is based in Paris with offices across a dozen countries.

name: Blackbuck
tags: Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage
description:
Keeping technology at the core, BlackBuck is redefining the logistics landscape of India, making it reliable and efficient. BlackBuck's comprehensive approach to problems creates impact on the entire ecosystem of transportation, which stitches across a large number of livelihoods. The transportation sector is ripe for a revolution, and BlackBuck marks the beginning.

Founded in 2015, BlackBuck has been a pioneer in bringing the offline operations of trucking online, be it matching a shipper with a trucker or reshaping the infrastructure around trucking to facilitate payments, insurance, and financial services. BlackBuck is committed to making it easier for millions of truckers to book a load and move at capacity and enable shippers of all sizes to have access to the right truck, at the right time for the right price – all at a click of a button. Today, BlackBuck is India’s largest trucking network, and the company’s robust technology platforms deliver reliability, efficiency, and a seamless experience for shippers and truckers.

BlackBuck is powered by a 2000 strong incredible team and is supported by the best of investors’ fraternity that includes Accel Partners, Apoletto Asia, B Capital, Flipkart, Goldman Sachs, IFC, Light Street, Sands Capital, Sequoia Capital, Tiger Global, and Wellington. BlackBuck has won the ‘CNBC-TV18 - Young Turks Startup of the Year’ award and the ‘Zee Business - Company of the Year - Logistics’ award in 2018. BlackBuck is also the subject of a ‘Harvard Business School’ case study.

name: BlackPoint
description: Blackpoint Cyber is a technology that offers a nation-state-grade cybersecurity ecosystem. Blackpoint Cyber serves the MSP community using its own proprietary security operations and incident response platform, SNAP-Defence, available as a product or as a 24/7 true managed detection and response (MDR) service.

name: Blameless
description: Blameless offers the only complete Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) platform that brings together AI-driven incident resolution, Blameless postmortems, SLOs/Error Budgets, and reliability insights reports and dashboards, enabling businesses to optimize reliability and innovation.

name: Bluestone
description: BlueStone offers a diverse collection of jewellery, featuring designs in gold, diamond, and platinum. The company provides options for various occasions, catering to different customer preferences. BlueStone also introduces a flexible financing plan known as the Gold Mine 10+1 Plan, which allows customers to purchase jewellery through monthly installments. This plan includes a discount on the final installment, making it accessible for a wider audience. The emphasis is on creating unique and contemporary designs that appeal to modern consumers. Overall, BlueStone focuses on delivering an extensive range of jewellery choices to meet the needs of its customers.

name: Bonobos
description:
Bonobos is a clothing brand focused on delivering great fit, excellent customer experience, and a fun approach to menswear. Launched online in 2007 with its signature line of better-fitting men's pants, Bonobos is now the largest apparel brand ever built on the web in the United States.

In 2011, Bonobos extended offline, launching Bonobos Guideshops, e-commerce stores that deliver personalized, one-to-one service to those wanting to experience the brand in person. In 2012, Bonobos expanded its distribution by partnering with Nordstrom, bringing Bonobos apparel into select doors nationwide and to Nordstrom.com. Across channels, Bonobos is focused on delivering a well-targeted brand promise: world-class fit, innovative shopping experience, and an energetic brand spirit. Bonobos was named “One of America’s Hottest Brands” by Advertising Age, “Best Men’s Pants” by New York Magazine, one of Inc. Magazine’s “20 Awesome Facebook Pages,” and was awarded Crain’s “Best Places to Work in New York City” in 2011 and 2013.

description: Stay tuned for all official updates and announcements.

name: BORN.COM
description: BORN is a private B2B marketplace where exciting brands can showcase their new products in tech, fashion, interiors, sports leisure, and beauty. Our community of professional buyers and retailers come to BORN to discover, connect, and transact with brands. Each year, BORN celebrates creative excellence in design lifestyle with the internationally acclaimed BORN Series. BORN was founded by Jean-Christophe Chopin, a serial internet entrepreneur in FinTech who co-founded E*TRADE Europe and Verisign Europe.

name: Borqs Technologies
description:
Borqs Technologies is a high-tech company providing intelligent terminal software platforms and end-to-end service platform solutions for operators, terminal manufacturers, and chip manufacturers in the global mobile Internet industry.

Borqs Technologies specializes in the development and industrialized promotion of holistic solutions for the mobile Internet terminal basic infrastructure software, application software, and end-to-end software. Established in September 2007, the company has 600 personnel in Borqs, more than 90% of whom are technical and 50% of whom have a master’s degree, along with a 70% engineer population with more than 5 years of experience in research and development. The core members of the team mainly come from terminal designers and manufacturers, providers of switching technology, Internet service providers, software and hardware manufacturers, and other global enterprises. The management team of Borqs consists of domestic and international experts in wireless communications, telecommunications, and semiconductor industries.

name: Bounce Infinity
description: Bounce Infinity is India’s first electric scooter with removable batteries and a Battery as a Service (BaaS) model for easy swaps.

name: Braintree
description:
Braintree's payment platform provides all the tools online and mobile businesses need to accept payments.

Providing the global commerce tools people need to build and grow businesses, Braintree’s global platform powers payments for thousands of online and mobile commerce innovators including Airbnb, Uber, GitHub, Facebook, and Pinterest. Merchants in more than 40 countries across North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia can accept, split, and enable payments in more than 130 currencies. Braintree’s SDK powers PayPal, including PayPal One Touch™, Venmo, Apple Pay, Android Pay, credit/debit cards, and Bitcoin across any device. Braintree was acquired by PayPal in 2013.

name: Breathe Well-being
description: Breathe Wellbeing is a health tech startup that helps people manage and prevent Type 2 Diabetes. It also helps people move towards a healthy life and reduce their risk of chronic diseases. Their clinically proven program has helped over 10,000 members to lose weight, reduce blood sugar, and prevent health complications. With individual lifestyle tracking and personalized counseling, combined with social interactions via healthy competitions, Breathe will partner in building long-term healthy habits.

name: Brick&Bolt
description: Brick&Bolt is an e-commerce marketplace providing end-to-end construction services with absolute trust and transparency. We ensure money safety through our escrow facility, transparency using technology, quality through our in-house project management team, and on-time delivery through penalty clauses for any delays. If you are looking for any building or house construction, Brick&Bolt is the place to go!

name: Bridgetown Research
description: Bridgetown Research designed Teamroom - an AI workbench that helps consultants, investors, and corporates strategy teams amplify their impact. Teamroom offers an integrated platform to gather data, execute analyses, and communicate results using embedded AI agents.

name: Brik
description: Brik is a construction material aggregator that enables small and midsize contractors to procure construction materials from vendors.

name: brndme.in
description: At Brnd.me (formerly Mensa Brands), we set out with a bold vision - to create India’s most beloved consumer brands across fashion, beauty, FMCG, and home decor. We’re committed to infusing innovation and excellence into everyday products, making them an integral part of your life.

name: BrowserStack
description: BrowserStack is a software testing platform that runs more than two million tests per day across 15 global data centers. It enables Microsoft, Twitter, Barclays, Expedia, and more than 25,000 customers to produce high-quality software quickly by transferring testing to the cloud. Its technology delivers rapid access to over 2,000 real mobile devices and browsers via a highly reliable cloud architecture that scales seamlessly as testing requirements grow. BrowserStack enables development and QA teams to move quickly while providing an exceptional client experience.

name: brumbrum
description:
Brumbrum is a provider of used vehicles for sale with up to 3 years of warranty that can be purchased online. The company's goal is to revolutionize the car market by offering a simple, innovative, practical, and competitive shopping experience. 

Brumbrum was founded in 2016 and is based in Milan, Italy.

name: BRYTER
description:
BRYTER is a no-code software platform that automates and helps its users to develop and build digital applications. It helps consulting firms, banks, corporates, and public administration across the globe to digitize and scale their services.

BRYTER operates offices in Berlin, Frankfurt, and London. The software supports professionals at Baker McKenzie, Hogan Lovells, Taylor Wessing, Simmons & Simmons, ING, Telefónica, and other companies around the globe.

It was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Berlin, Germany.

name: Bumble
description:
Bumble is an app that brings dating, friend-finding, and career-building into a single social networking platform.

The location-based social app facilitates communication between interested users. It enables people to connect and build equitable and healthy relationships. In heterosexual matches, only female users can make the first contact with matched male users, while in same-sex matches either person can send a message first. Users can sign up using their phone number or Facebook profile and have options of searching for romantic matches or, in "BFF mode," friends. Bumble Bizz facilitates business communications.

It was founded in 2014 by Whitney Wolfe Herd and is based in Austin, Texas.

name: Calastone
description:
Calastone is the largest global funds network, connecting the world’s leading financial organisations.
