SureWaves is building media applications on top of the SureWaves Media Grid to allow a variety of digital mediums to attach to the SureWaves Media Grid through specific SureWaves Edge Devices. The company has filed for more than 40 patents to date on the above technology and was recognized as the most innovative start-up in 2008 by Software Technology Parks of India. In the first phase of commercialization, SureWaves has made a good penetration in the centrally managed Digital OOH market and has successfully expanded the scope of SureWaves offerings to the Local Television advertising space.

name: Surf AI
description: Surf AI aims to help enterprise security teams continuously identify and close security exposure gaps through an AI-driven operations platform. Surf applies agentic AI to operationalize your security program at scale. Surf finds your exposures and accelerates time-to-resolution across identity, cloud, and SaaS assets. It connects your systems, closes exposures end to end with specialized AI agents, and keeps your team in control at every step.

name: Swan
description: Swan is the leading European fintech specialized in embedded banking. Companies of all kinds can unlock the full potential of their product by embedding Swan's banking features such as accounts, cards, and payments. Founded in 2019, Swan processes over 1 billion euros of transactions per month, for 150+ companies, and operates across thirty European countries. The company has received growth capital from leading VC investors such as Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Bpifrance and Eight Roads. Swan is a Mastercard principal member and a licensed financial institution, regulated by the French banking authority (ACPR).

name: Swiftkey
description:
SwiftKey is a technology company that aims to enhance interaction between keyboards and people. It upgrades smartphone keyboards to make typing faster by utilizing artificial intelligence to learn from each user in order to autocorrect and predict their next word. The SwiftKey Keyboard for Android supports more than 80 languages.

SwiftKey was founded by Ben Medlock and Jon Reynolds in 2008 and is based in London, United Kingdom.

name: Swiggy
description:
Swiggy is an on-demand food delivery platform that brings food from neighborhood restaurants directly to customers' doors.

The company's food delivery platform lists local restaurants and menu lists on an app for users to order from and track the delivery of its delivery executives, enabling users to order food with speed and convenience. Its service is used to pick up and drop off a diverse array of items, including laundry and document or parcel deliveries to business clients and retail customers.

name: Swypex
description: Swypex develops spend management software designed to spend intelligently, fast, and effortlessly. The company's platform includes real-time expense tracking, easy transfers, and security.

name: Synthflow
description: Synthflow AI is a platform that enables businesses and creators to harness the power of conversational AI and voice technology. The company provides a no-code environment where users can design, deploy, and manage AI agents tailored to their unique requirements, delivering personalized experiences that drive customer satisfaction and business growth.

name: Syrup Tech
description: Syrup Tech is a machine-learning decision-support engine for inventory in commerce. The company uses advanced demand forecasting and stochastic optimizations. Syrup Tech's software empowers brands and retailers to significantly increase full-priced inventory sell-through by (1) preventing stock-outs and end-of-season markdowns, (2) decreasing unnecessary excess inventory and reducing overproduction, and (3) reducing the time spent on manual tasks for stretched merchandising and planning teams.

name: Sysdig
description:
In the cloud, every second counts. Attacks move at warp speed, and security teams must protect the business without slowing it down. SYSDIG stops cloud attacks in real time, instantly detecting changes in risk with runtime insights, a unique AI architecture, and open source Falco. SYSDIG delivers live visibility by correlating signals across cloud workloads, identities, and services to uncover hidden attack paths. By knowing what is running, teams can prioritize the vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, permissions, and threats that matter most. From prevention to defense, SYSDIG helps enterprises move faster and focus on what matters: innovation.

SYSDIG. Secure Every Second.

name: Tailscale
description: Tailscale develops a software-defined networking platform that simplifies the creation of secure private networks using the WireGuard protocol. Its solution enables devices to connect directly through peer-to-peer mesh networking, reducing latency and eliminating the need for traditional VPN configurations. The platform integrates with existing identity providers, allowing for streamlined user authentication and access control. Tailscale supports various operating systems, including Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS, and offers compatibility with cloud services and Kubernetes environments. The company emphasizes ease of use and scalability, catering to teams and organizations seeking straightforward network security solutions. Tailscale builds on top of WireGuard’s Noise protocol encryption, a peer-reviewed and trusted standard. Their vision is to remove overhead and complexity from this long tail of software and operational problems that people face every day.

name: Taxdoo
description: Taxdoo provides software solutions for automated sales tax compliance and financial accounting in e-commerce. The platform collects and evaluates transaction data from marketplaces and other systems to automatically submit sales tax reports. Taxdoo also offers accounting features with DATEV compatibility and services specifically for tax advisors managing e-commerce mandates.

name: Teabox
description: Teabox designs an online platform intended for organic tea and tea-based products direct from the source. The company's online tea shop delivers fresh Indian teas sourced directly from the tea gardens in Darjeeling, Assam, the Nilgiris, and Nepal, enabling consumers to get access to 100% fresh and organic tea without compromising on aroma and flavor.

name: Tema ETFs
description: Tema Global builds an ETF platform focused on ETF infrastructure and differentiated ETF strategies managed by experienced investment professionals.

name: Tenable
description: Tenable is a cybersecurity company that offers an exposure management platform designed to identify and close security gaps across IT, cloud, and operational technology environments. The platform unifies security visibility and insight, enabling organizations to manage vulnerabilities effectively and reduce business risk.

name: Tenderly
description:
Tenderly is a blockchain operations platform for teams running production systems onchain. It pioneered transaction simulation in Web3 and built one of the first smart contract debuggers, and today gives engineering, finance, and risk teams a single environment to simulate, validate, and monitor onchain activity, so they can model the outcome of any transaction, integration, or capital allocation against live production state before it happens.

High-fidelity simulations preview any onchain action against real, current state, including live oracle prices and synced liquidity. A multichain Explorer decodes transactions and contract activity into readable operational context. Real-time monitoring detects anomalies and triggers automated, validated responses. The platform supports 100+ EVM networks, from Ethereum and leading Layer 2s (Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Polygon, Linea) to emerging chains such as World Chain, MegaETH, and Plasma.

Tenderly is a chosen infrastructure and tooling provider for major new networks, including Robinhood Chain, Circle's Arc, Sony's Soneium, and Tempo, the payments blockchain incubated by Stripe and Paradigm. Founded in 2018, it is used across the onchain ecosystem: by protocols such as Aave, Uniswap, Morpho, Safe, Chainlink, and Sky; by institutions, exchanges, and market makers including Kraken, Binance, Anchorage Digital, Maple, Tether, and Wintermute; and by security teams such as the Security Alliance (SEAL), zeroShadow, and Cyfrin. Teams have run more than 4 billion simulations and debugged over 10 million transactions on the platform, which powers protocols and organizations behind more than 50 billion dollars in onchain value.

name: Tessian
description:
Tessian’s mission is to secure the human layer. Using machine learning technology, Tessian automatically stops data breaches and security threats caused by human error - like data exfiltration, accidental data loss, business email compromise, and phishing attacks - with minimal disruption to employees' workflow. As a result, employees are empowered to do their best work, without security getting in their way.

Founded in 2013, Tessian is backed by renowned investors like Sequoia, Accel, March Capital, and Balderton, and has offices in San Francisco and London.

name: Tessl
description: Tessl transforms software development for the AI era with its innovative AI-native development approach. Its AI-powered development platform provides secure, high-quality, and self-maintaining code tailored to the user's requirements.

name: Testsigma
description: Testsigma is a cloud-based platform that uses Artificial Intelligence to help businesses automate testing for web, mobile, and API applications. It allows testers to create and run tests faster and easier, with features like Natural Language Processing and AI-powered maintenance. Testsigma integrates with popular CI/CD tools and offers a free trial.

name: Teya
description: Teya is an all-in-one solution for small and growing businesses. From payments to loyalty to the cash advance merchants use to give their shops that facelift, Teya has helped over 300,000 business owners connect with the joy of running their business.

name: The Lafz
description:
Lafz is a range of halal compliant personal care products, created with a vision to provide the community with pure, clean, cosmetic products that abide by halal standards. 

Lafz is made in a hygienic manner and does not contain any alcohols, parabens, or animal ingredients. It is manufactured in halal compliant factories, and the products are tested to be safe for use on human skin.

name: The Zebra
description: The Zebra operates as an online insurance comparison marketplace. It provides rates and educational resources to inform consumers and help them find the coverage, service level, and pricing to suit their unique needs, while simultaneously helping insurance companies connect with the consumers they best serve in today’s digital world. It aims to simplify the process of finding and purchasing insurance by offering transparent and easy-to-understand options for car, home, and other types of insurance. The Zebra's platform allows users to input their information and receive personalized quotes, helping them find the best coverage and rates available.

name: Thinking Machines Lab
description:
Vertice Compliance Manager S.L. pertenece a un grupo de empresas formado por miembros con más de 25 años de experiencia en el ámbito empresarial y penal.

Nuestro objetivo principal es instaurar en nuestros clientes una política de Compliance que sea capaz de transmitir una imagen de compromiso ante el cumplimiento normativo, dotando así a las empresas de una seguridad y tranquilidad ante futuras situaciones de responsabilidad penal que puedan llegar a surgir.

Disponemos de un Sistema Personalizado de gestión de riesgos penales capaz de analizar y desglosar detalladamente la situación actual de la sociedad. A su vez, contamos con un Canal de Denuncias propio capaz de instaurarse en cualquier tipo de empresa, sea cual sea su magnitud.

name: Threeflow
description: Threeflow is the first benefits placement system, a new category of enterprise software that allows brokers and carriers to manage the entire placement process in one shared system. We make it easier for carriers to win business and brokers to empower employers with the details they need to make better benefits decisions. By connecting people, systems, and information, we enable easier communication, a quicker process, and better decisions making busy people more productive. Learn more (and see our open roles) at threeflow.com. Note: scams in which fraudsters impersonate legitimate businesses for personal gain are on the rise and can come in many forms. Threeflow doesn’t interview candidates via email, and job offers are only extended by the hiring manager after a thorough interview process involving phone and/or zoom interviews. Our recruiters only use @threeflow.com email addresses, and we will never ask you to provide sensitive information like your social security number or bank account details as a part of our interview process or through a pdf form. If you receive a suspicious email regarding a position or job offer with threeflow, please don’t respond. Report it as spam, and forward that email to careers@threeflow.com.

name: Time is Ltd
description:
Time is Ltd. was founded in 2017 to improve the everyday productivity of large corporations and companies. An easy way to integrate solutions for companies that are going through the process of adopting a diverse number of cloud tools, it allows them to understand the performance data behind their productivity.

Powered by machine learning, the platform brings the data from a number of tools, such as Office 365, G Suite, and Slack, amongst others, together in one. By unlocking the hidden gems in this combined data, it reveals a company’s successful working patterns and allows organizations to operate more effectively.

Time is Ltd. is a Prague-based startup founded by serial entrepreneurs Jan Rezab and Cyril Höschl.

name: Tines
description: Tines is a no-code workflow automation platform tailored for security teams, allowing them to easily build, run, and monitor workflows. The platform offers a free Community Edition, enabling users to explore its features and capabilities.

name: tolmo.com
description:
Tolmo is an agent-driven security platform that secures every layer, code, CI, cloud applications at the speed of AI changes.

Codebases are growing faster than ever, at a rate humans can’t keep up with. Tolmo deploys fleets of AI security agents on a live production knowledge graph that connects data from cloud services, containers, databases, and third-party providers (Observability, Security, etc.).

Tolmo agents triage, verify impact, and remediate security issues autonomously, escalating to humans only when truly necessary.

name: Tonkean
description: Tonkean is the OS for business operations, transforming operations teams from facilitators into makers with an enterprise-grade, no-code process orchestration platform. By abstracting the technical knowledge required to automate, monitor, and manage mission-critical business processes, while still maintaining compliance and security, Tonkean enables enterprises to accelerate operational velocity at scale.

name: Tracxn
description: Tracxn is the research partner for Venture Capitalists and Corporate Development offices powered by the largest Startup Data platform tracking over 10M companies globally.

name: Trade Republic
description: Trade Republic is the largest savings platform in Europe enabling millions of people to create wealth.

name: Transcend
description:
Transcend is the only autonomous “Can I use this data” platform that powers every data decision to scale customer growth. Fortune 500 companies and emerging category leaders leverage Transcend to encode complete data use permissions directly into the enterprise systems that process customer data, delivering a real-time source of truth for consent, preferences, and business rules. The result is superior data quality, ethical use that protects the brand, and audit-ready compliance at scale. With Transcend, companies can unlock revenue from AI, personalization, and other first-party data initiatives with confidence. Founded in 2017 by Ben Brook (CEO) and Mike Farrell (CTO), Transcend is headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area. The company has been recognized as a Leader in IDC’s MarketScape for Worldwide Data Privacy Compliance Software and twice named to the Deloitte Technology Fast 500™. 

Learn more at transcend.io.

name: Transit
description:
Transit is a mobile app intended to help its users navigate their cities. Transit simplifies local travel in 125 cities worldwide. Upon launch, the bright, intuitive interface shows all nearby transportation options and departures. Users can plan trips, set reminders, and get notifications about disruptions. Plus, Transit also integrates other sustainable transport modes—bike sharing, car sharing, and UBER—so users can determine the best way to get from A to B. With millions of active users in the US and Canada, Transit has emerged as the leading urban transit app in North America.

The company is based in Montreal, Quebec.

name: Travelstop
description:
Travelstop (now WegoPro as part of Wego.com) is a revolutionary platform aimed at modernizing and simplifying business travel. Travelstop makes it super easy to manage your business trips, automate your expense reporting, and provide meaningful insights to business owners.

Headquartered in Singapore, Travelstop is founded by a team that brings a wealth of experience from companies including Yahoo!, Expedia, and HomeAway. Travelstop is now part of the Wego group of companies.

name: Trifacta
description:
Trifacta delivers an intelligent, collaborative, visual data engineering cloud platform to transform data, ensure quality, and automate data pipelines, enabling consumable data at any scale. With universal data connectivity, Trifacta provides flexibility to connect to any data from any source for any application. Using an AI-assisted, self-service approach, Trifacta users can collaborate to evaluate, correct, and validate data quality, accelerate data transformation, and automate robust data pipelines. Trifacta’s open cloud platform drives increased business value through informed decisions.

Around the globe, tens of thousands of users at more than 10,000 companies, including leading brands like Deutsche Börse, Google, Kaiser Permanente, New York Life, and PepsiCo, are unlocking the potential of their data with Trifacta’s market-leading data engineering cloud platform.

name: Trinkerr
description: Trinkerr is a Social Trading Platform. Trinkerr helps users to follow real-time investors' portfolios and replicate them in a single click.

name: Truebill
description:
Rocket Money is a leading personal finance app with a mission to help everyone money. We offer over 5 million members a centralized destination to manage their finances, with valuable services that save both time and money — ultimately giving them a leg up on their financial journey. Members can manage their subscriptions, lower their bills, build budgets and automatically set aside money to reach their savings goals.

At Rocket Money, we believe we can do our best work operating as a team. We are committed to using our experience at work to support our own and each other's personal growth. If you are someone who enjoys solving hard problems, thrives on collaboration and is passionate about our mission, let's talk. We hire from all industries and look for a diverse set of experiences in our talent.

name: Truemeds India
description:
Truemeds is a telehealth platform that makes healthcare accessible to every patient. It advises patients about substitute medicines offered by reputed pharmaceutical companies and recommends appropriate value medicines to customers with precise scientific matching and outcome history.

Co-founded in 2019 by Akshat Nayyar and Kunal Wani, the company is headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

name: TRUORA
description: Truora provides identity verification and fraud prevention tools that help businesses validate users and reduce risk in digital interactions. Its platform offers services such as background checks, identity authentication, and phone number verification to support secure onboarding and transactions.

name: TrustArc
description: TrustArc specializes in privacy compliance and data protection. They focus on building and maturing privacy programs and enabling continuous compliance, information governance, and data security. Their solutions include customer consent, preference, privacy strategy and operations, privacy insights, and managed services.

name: Turbine
description: Turbine builds a platform to understand the inner mechanisms of cancer, enabling the discovery of novel protein targets, precision biomarkers, and better translation to patients. Turbine uses its proprietary Simulated Cell technology in combination with Artificial Intelligence to build a faster and deeper biological understanding of therapeutic targets or indications, untangling the complexity of cancer.

name: Tweed
description: Turn siloed compliance and risk data into intelligent, automated operations that unlock scale for your business.

name: UiPath
description: UiPath designs and develops robotic process automation software. The platform offers foolproof development tools, automation of intricate processes, enhanced control, cloud and on-premise deployment, robust governance, and multiple robots on a single virtual machine. It is a company that specializes in the creation of intelligent business processes and robotic software.

name: Uniqode (Formerly Beaconstac)
description: Uniqode (formerly known as Beaconstac) is a QR Code generator platform that is focused on enhancing operational efficiency, elevating customer engagement, assessing the ROI of physical marketing channels, and reducing marketing costs. Uniqode boasts a user base exceeding 50,000 businesses across various sectors, such as consumer goods, hospitality, retail, and real estate, from diverse global enterprises and small businesses relying on it for their QR Code requirements.

name: Unit
description: Unit is the market leader in embedded finance. We offer ready-to-launch solutions — embedded capital, banking, and bill pay — that help tech companies grow their revenue, delight customers, and win their markets.

name: unitQ
description: unitQ is the AI quality intelligence platform that unifies every customer signal into one system, connects it to your most critical business metrics, and tells every team exactly what to prioritize — before your KPIs move. Built on six purpose-built products in one platform, unitQ gives organizations everything they need to detect issues the moment they emerge, understand their business impact, benchmark quality against competitors, evaluate every support interaction, uncover qualitative insight at scale, and act on what customers are saying across social — all from a single source of truth. The result: product, engineering, CX, and leadership teams stop working from fragmented tools and different versions of customer reality — and start making faster, more confident decisions grounded in what customers are actually experiencing right now. The products millions of consumers love every day — including Pinterest, Adobe, PayPal, and Bumble — trust unitQ to close the gap between what customers experience and what companies know about it.

name: Unmannd Autonomy
description: Founded in February 2025 by Yeshwanth Reddy and Hemaditya Prasad, Unmannd is developing systems for the future of Defence logistics and aerial security. Its first product, Titan, is a heavy-duty drone designed to carry and deliver supplies.

name: Unreal Foods
description: Unreal Foods identifies breakout food & beverage concepts around the world and brings them to India with operational excellence, cultural sensitivity, and a strong creator-led growth engine.

name: Uppercase
description: Uppercase operates as a D2C travel accessories company that offers sustainable products. Its products are made using a curated material library, fresh color schemes, innovative branding details, and custom-developed hardware with recycled plastic bottles and environmentally sensitive packaging material.

name: Urban Company
description: Urban provides a marketplace for freelance labor. It offers a variety of home services to consumers, including beauty treatments, haircuts, deep cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, and appliance repairs. The platform helps customers book reliable home services, and it aims to help millions of service professionals across the world deliver services at home. The company partners with tens of thousands of service professionals, helping them with training, credit, product procurement, insurance, and technology.

name: useavenue.com
description: Avenue is a software company that provides an operations observability and workflow automation platform, helping businesses monitor data, automate alerts, manage incident-resolution playbooks, and improve operational efficiency

name: UserTesting
description:
UserTesting is an on-demand human insights platform that empowers organizations to make timely, customer-centric business decisions with confidence. With UserTesting, brands can target their exact customer audience, readily create and execute studies, and engage in live conversations to better understand, capture, and spotlight meaningful reactions and responses.

Easily package these human insights into a video reel and share them across the organization to make more informed decisions that influence the customer experience and increase brand loyalty and revenue.

name: Val Town
description: Val Town is a collaborative platform for writing, deploying, and running JavaScript and TypeScript code in the cloud.

name: VComply
description:
VComply is the Compliance & Risk Operating System (CROS) for growing businesses.

We help mid-market organizations manage compliance like they manage operations—with clarity, accountability, and zero chaos. No more spreadsheets. No more missed obligations. No more email chases.

With VComply, every obligation, control, and compliance task is tracked, assigned, and closed in one system—giving leadership real-time visibility and teams a clear path to execution.

Companies across healthcare, energy, education, and financial services use VComply to:
• Centralize all compliance responsibilities
• Assign clear ownership across departments
• Automate reminders and escalations
• Stay always audit-ready—without the fire drills

Our platform is built for operational teams. It integrates seamlessly with your workflows and empowers your people to get compliance done—not just documented.

VComply is trusted by 300+ organizations in over 100 countries, including government bodies, mission-critical infrastructure providers, and regulated enterprises.

We’re not just another GRC tool. We’re building the infrastructure layer for operational compliance—and defining a new category in the process.

name: Vedantu
description: Vedantu provides students with LIVE online master classes and personalized one-to-one tutoring for school boards and competitive exams. The platform offers educational courses and study materials across Science, Math, Coding, and English for various age groups. Vedantu also operates offline centers for students focused on cracking competitive entrance exams like JEE and NEET.

name: Venmo
description: Venmo offers an app that allows users to share and make payments with friends for a variety of services. Venmo offers a debit card in partnership with Mastercard (MA). It was founded in 2009 by Andrew Kortina and Iqram Magdon-Ismail.

name: Venue
description: Venue turns internal meetings like All Hands, Town Halls, and AMAs into events that engage and inspire. It makes it simple for teams to replicate the production and entertainment value of talk shows, ensuring that employees pay attention, get excited, and achieve more.

name: Venwiz
description: VenWiz is building an online B2B platform for manufacturers and skilled service vendors to partner and prosper together. While B2B services are core to the manufacturing industry, the discovery, procurement, and execution of these services in India have stayed underserved by digitization. They provide end-to-end digital solutions to their manufacturing clients to ensure a seamless procurement experience. The platform's cutting-edge digital tools optimize the procurement lifecycle for businesses. They digitize post-PO milestone management, allowing for on-time project completion.

name: Veriff
description:
Veriff is an online identity verification company that protects businesses and their customers from online identity fraud. It is a highly automated identity verification platform connecting companies with honest customers.

Veriff makes it easy to connect with people to trust. With the combined forces of machine learning and eagle-eyed specialists, Veriff is always two steps ahead of digital fraud. AI speeds up sessions with immediate feedback, while manual checks by their verification gurus nip risks in the bud.

Veriff was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Tallinn, Estonia.

name: Veza
description:
Veza is the data security platform that helps users use and share their data safely. It makes it easy to understand, manage, and control who can and should take what action on what data. It organizes authorization metadata across identity providers, data systems, cloud service providers, and applications, all to address the toughest data security challenges of the modern era.

The company is funded by top-tier investors including Accel, Bain Capital, Ballistic Ventures, Blackstone, GV, Norwest Venture Partners, and True Ventures.

name: Vinculum Group
description: Vinculum is a SaaS omnichannel software company enabling brands to sell on multiple marketplaces. Brands and retailers go omnichannel. Brands and retailers go direct to consumer (D to C). Brands set up marketplaces. Brands scale internationally with an uberized network of brand distributors. We work with brands like P&G, Jockey, Fossil, Bata, Harman Electronics, Titan, Skechers, Body Shop, Nykaa, Swiggy, Blue Dart, DHL, LF Logistics, DTDC, and Dairy Farm Group and are backed by Accel Partners and Ivycap Ventures.

name: Vinted
description:
CHISKO BRAND -

CHISKO GRAPHIC STUDIO - 

Logo design - Motion design - Print design - Visual identity.

name: Virgio
description: Virgio is an early-stage, tech-led, direct-to-consumer fast fashion brand that aims to provide trendy, elegant, and affordable clothing to its fashion-forward users. It's a completely vertically integrated brand that takes care of everything from trend curation, fashion designing, and manufacturing to selling goods on its own properties.

name: VISOA
description:
Viso Suite provides end-to-end computer vision application infrastructure for enterprises to build and scale computer vision applications dramatically faster and easier. The model-driven infrastructure is used by some of the world's leading organizations across industries.

The end-to-end infrastructure consolidates the entire machine learning lifecycle, increasing productivity, maximizing system compatibility, and establishing standardization across a portfolio of different computer vision applications. Applications built with the Viso Suite are flexible, easily upgraded, and can be ported across different hardware platforms (cameras, computing) with little or no modification, providing a solution that future-proofs customers' investment in computer vision application development.

name: Vite (Singapore)
description: Developer of frontend tooling designed to provide a leaner development experience for modern web projects. The company's tool offers various features such as NPM dependency resolving and pre-bundling, hot module replacement, TypeScript, TypeScript compiler options, JSX, and CSS, enabling users to provide feedback by testing them in production.

name: Vivun
description:
Vivun delivers Hero, the world’s most advanced AI Sales Teammate—automating the critical work required to move complex deals forward. By providing expertise and generating sales-ready outputs that help every rep engage stakeholders, build value, and drive urgency, Vivun empowers sales teams to close more deals, faster. 

For more information, visit vivun.com.

name: VLT Technology Inc.
description: VLT /VŌLT/ is a new home for open source. Building a next-gen package manager, registry, and more.

name: Vmware Workspace One
description:
VMware Workspace ONE, an integrated platform powered by VMware AirWatch Unified Endpoint Management technology, empowers the digital workspace by combining a consumer-simple experience with enterprise-class security. It offers enterprises a digital workspace platform that simply and securely delivers and manages any app on any device by integrating access control, application, and Unified Endpoint Management.

VMware, a global leader in cloud infrastructure and digital workspace technology, accelerates digital transformation by enabling unprecedented freedom and flexibility in how our customers build and evolve IT environments. With VMware solutions, organizations are improving business agility by modernizing data centers and integrating public clouds, driving innovation with modern apps, creating exceptional experiences by empowering the digital workspace, and safeguarding customer trust by transforming security.

name: VoiceOps
description: VoiceOps provides a conversation intelligence platform that focuses on coaching and training for sales teams. The platform captures and analyzes call data, offering insights into how sales representatives communicate with prospects and customers. It is designed to identify behaviors, measure adherence to sales processes, and highlight areas for improvement. VoiceOps enables managers to track coaching effectiveness and ensure that strategies are consistently applied across teams.

name: VoidZero
description: Voidzero is a software development company that offers an open-source toolchain for JavaScript.

name: Vorlon
description: Vorlon secures the converged SaaS and AI ecosystem with agentless DataMatrix technology, giving enterprises visibility, control, and protection for sensitive data.

name: Vpersonalize Inc
description: MyWear® from vPersonalize is the only integrated platform to let you launch your own line of apparel or accessories, designed, produced, and delivered to order under your label, with no upfront costs or minimum order quantities. MyWear® provides you everything you need: design tools, integrated e-store, pattern generation, supply chain, production, shipping, and payments!

name: VSCO
description:
VSCO is a creative platform that develops software and digital tools that support photography workflows, image editing, portfolio management, client collaboration, and creative community engagement. The company provides photo and video editing applications with film-inspired presets, manual adjustment controls, artificial intelligence features, and color grading tools for photographers and visual creators. Its platform also includes portfolio websites, client galleries, studio management, collaboration workspaces, content publishing tools, and educational resources that help photographers organize projects and manage creative businesses.

VSCO integrates mobile, desktop, and cloud-based applications that support image capture, editing, workflow management, and content sharing across different stages of the creative process. In addition, the company offers community features, photography events, workshops, and business tools that enable creators to connect with peers, showcase their work, and manage client relationships within a unified platform.

name: Wakao
description: Developer of a talent face-off entertainment software designed to reimagine popular television talent shows and game show formats for mobile-first audiences. The company's platform offers short videos and authentic content for viewing and judging, enabling individuals to participate and win in dance, music, and fashion competitions.

name: Wallapop
description: Wallapop is a hyper-local mobile marketplace for buying and selling secondhand goods, primarily accessible via a mobile app. It uses a geo-localized technology that connects a community of 15 million users by offering an easy and convenient way to buy and sell items that are no longer used. The platform, which has found a second home for more than 180 million items, provides people with access to unique goods at great prices while extending the life of fully functional products. Since its inception, Wallapop has been committed to continuous innovation in the online classifieds industry and second-hand market and aspires to use technology to contribute to sustainability. The company is backed by investors Korelya Capital, NAVER, Accel, Insight Venture Partners, 14W, and Northzone. It was founded in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain by Agustin Gomez, Miguel Vicente, and Gerard Olive in 2013.

name: Weaveworks
description:
Weaveworks simplifies operating Kubernetes workloads and provides a developer-centric operating model for cloud-native applications.

Founded in 2014, Weaveworks makes it fast and simple for developers and DevOps teams to build and operate powerful containerized applications. They minimize the complexity of operating workloads in Kubernetes by providing automated continuous delivery pipelines, observability, and monitoring. It is one of the first members of the Cloud Native Computing Forum.

Weaveworks also contributes to several open-source projects, including Weave Scope, Weave Cortex, and Weave Flux.

name: Webflow
description:
Webflow is the first design and hosting platform built from the ground up for the mobile age.

Webflow allows the user to design, build, and launch responsive websites visually, while writing clean, semantic code. It is the only hosted service that allows designers to create websites that work on every device and push it to live production without a developer.

Webflow is a visual web design platform, CMS, and hosting provider for building production websites and prototypes. Webflow offers a way to design, build, and launch websites visually without coding.

name: Webroot
description: Webroot provides cybersecurity and security intelligence services. They secure businesses and individuals with threat intelligence and protection for endpoints and networks. Their services include endpoint protection, network protection, and security awareness training solutions for Managed Service Providers and small businesses.

name: Welcome: A Smart City Guide
description: Welcome provides an app that utilizes real-time search, a proprietary context-driven discovery mode that considers dozens of data points to make the most relevant and personalized recommendations in the exact moment the user opens the app.

name: Whimsical
description: Whimsical is a software company that develops tools for workplace collaboration. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.

name: Wibmo
description: Wibmo is a fintech company that specializes in digital payment solutions and online payment processing services for customers, banks, and merchants. They also provide ecommerce security that enables credit and debit card holders to make mobile payments directly from their cards at Visa and Mastercard merchants.

name: Winden
description: Winden is a financial technology company that offers banking products for entrepreneurs and businesses. The company provides deposit banking, spend management, and other financial products for digital freelancers, agencies, and more. Its products are primarily aimed at single-person e-commerce businesses, but it also caters to digital freelancers and agencies. Winden offers digital entrepreneurs features such as free ACH, wire, and check payments and the ability to manage transactions, payments, and expenses in one place.

name: Wiom
description: Wiom delivers an asset-light digital platform that enables individuals and small Internet Service Providers to resell home broadband as minute- or day-sized sachet internet packs starting at just ₹5. It operates as India’s licensed Public Data Office Aggregator (PDOA) under the government’s PM-WANI initiative, aggregating surplus bandwidth from local operators and redistributing it affordably. The platform supports pay-as-you-go usage, allowing hosts to earn while often eliminating their own internet costs. Wiom targets underserved urban, Tier II/III, and rural areas through partnerships with hundreds of local operators and leverages proprietary backend software and router firmware for seamless service delivery.

name: Wizard
description: Wizard operates a commerce technology startup to transform e-commerce with conversational AI. The company was founded in 2021 and is headquartered in New York.

name: World View Enterprises
description:
At World View® Enterprises, Inc., we are pioneering a new frontier at the edge of space: the stratospheric economy. Over 115 successful stratospheric flights and 10,274,598 vertical feet flown (Nov 2022), World View has innovated exploration of the stratosphere through advanced research, discovery, and now human spaceflight. We have engineered and patented sophisticated takeoff and landing systems and developed complex methodologies for controlling trajectories in the stratosphere. These innovations have earned us the trust of NASA and other government, scientific, and aerospace organizations. Our expertise enables us to bring edge-of-space travel to the public and stratospheric remote sensing to governments and businesses, as World View embarks on the mission to inspire, create, and explore new perspectives for a radically improved future.

We are on a mission to inspire, create, and explore new perspectives for a radically improved future. Whether through our remote sensing vehicles called Stratollites® that can persist in the stratosphere over areas of interest for months at a time, or our space tourism and exploration services that are introducing meaningful space tourism to an entirely new addressable market, World View is delivering the first purpose-first service offering from the stratosphere.

name: WorldRemit
description: WorldRemit is a secure service that allows online money transfer using a computer, smartphone, or our app and also provides international remittance services. It believes in helping customers' hard work go further. They’ve helped millions of children to go to school, helped thousands of people to receive medical treatment, and every week, it helps tens of thousands of people to pay their bills. But most importantly, they do it all with the creativity, imagination, and colorful spirit of our customers.

name: Wrogn
description: Wrogn is a youth-focused fashion brand house. Wrogn offers a range of apparel including casual wear, denim, shirts, t-shirts, jackets, and accessories. Its brand portfolio includes brands across men’s wear and women’s wear, like Wrogn, Imara, Ms. Taken, Single, and Wrogn Active. Wrogn has become popular in India, especially among the youth, for its trendy designs, quality, and affiliation with Virat Kohli, one of India's most prominent and influential cricketers. The brand has expanded its reach through both online and offline retail channels, establishing a dedicated customer following nationwide.

name: www.getfibr.co
description: Fibr transforms your URLs into intelligent, adaptive web experience agents. Each page senses intent, makes decisions, and reshapes itself in real time for whoever arrives

name: Wyzant
description: WyzAnt is an online marketplace where students and parents can find qualified, local in-person and online tutors in more than 250 different subjects. Visitors can browse WyzAnt's network of 75,000+ available tutors at no cost and compare tutors' experience, qualifications, personality and teaching style, background checks and more to ensure they find the perfect fit. With WyzAnt's 100% Good Fit Guarantee, students can start lessons knowing they will only be charged if they are 100% satisfied with the tutor they have chosen. Tutors on WyzAnt are individually screened and required to pass proficiency exams in the subjects they wish to teach. Tutors offer personalized instruction to students and professionals of all ages in subjects ranging from academics and test preparation to language and computer training, to music and art lessons, as well as sports and recreation lessons.

name: xalts
description:
Xalts is a technology platform that enables treasury and finance teams to scale and achieve efficiency. Finance teams leverage our AI agents to perform various financial operations based on internal processes and policies, and our connectivity network with banks, payment providers, and logistics partners to automate end-to-end treasury processes.

Our task-specific AI agents execute time-consuming operations including data management and reconciliation, banking queries and instructions, and complex trade finance processes, helping finance teams manage revenue, liquidity, and trade finance operations efficiently. Our solutions suite can be accessed through our Contour Network Hub or by integrating with third-party ERP, TMS, and other backend systems.

Xalts is trusted by leading Fortune 500 companies and backed by Accel, Citi Ventures, Bangkok Bank, and CTBC Capital.

name: Xebialabs
description: We are now Digital.ai. Follow us at linkedin.com/company/digitaldotai.

name: Xendit
description:
Xendit is a Southeast Asian fintech company that provides payment infrastructure across Indonesia and the Philippines. Xendit processes payments, runs marketplaces, disburses payroll and loans, detects fraud, and helps other businesses grow exponentially. They serve these companies by providing a suite of world-class APIs and a dashboard UI that simplifies processes.

Xendit was founded by Moses Lo, Tessa Wijaya, Bo Chen, and Juan Gonzalez.

name: Xero
description: Xero is an online accounting software suite for small businesses, accountants, and bookkeepers. It enables its users to track and manage cash flow processes, invoicing, payments, reporting, and pay runs. Users can use Xero through any of its three monthly subscription packages: Starter, Standard, and Premium.

name: XFactor.io
description: XFactor is a corporate decision platform developer that uses Artificial Intelligence to assist with planning and strategy. The corporate platform syncs trillions of data points by combining historical and real-time key indicators from both internal and external sources in relevant marketplaces, allowing organizations to analyze sales success in real time continuously.

name: YapStone
description: Yapstone is a payment processing platform for the vacation rental industry, providing an integrated way of accepting payments.

name: Zebrium
description:
Zebrium uses unsupervised machine learning to automatically catch software incidents and show you root cause. Our technology works by finding hotspots of abnormally correlated anomalous patterns across logs and metrics. You can get started for free by visiting www.zebrium.com.

It was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.

name: Zed
description: Zed offers a credit-led neobank service tailored to young professionals in Southeast Asia. It provides a Titanium Mastercard credit card with no interest, no annual fees, and no foreign transaction fees. Through the Zed mobile app, users can create unlimited virtual cards, monitor transactions in real time, and quickly lock or delete cards to prevent fraud. Zed’s underwriting does not rely solely on traditional credit scores; instead, it assesses current and future earnings to assign credit limits. The service emphasizes transparency, control over spending, and a streamlined application and payment process.

name: Zenaton
description: Zenaton provides a SaaS technology to orchestrate your background tasks and create world-class business processes.

name: Zenoti
description:
Zenoti provides an all-in-one, cloud-based software solution for the spa, salon, and med spa industries. The system supports large spa, salon, med-spa, and fitness chains with the tools to expand the network while increasing unit-level performance. In addition to being a true enterprise solution for this industry, it also supports small and medium-sized businesses. The all-in-one system helps clients grow and manage operations.

The company enables users to manage every aspect of a business in a comprehensive mobile solution with online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built-in marketing programs, and more. It helps clients streamline systems and decrease costs while enhancing customer retention and spending.

It was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Bellevue, Washington.

name: Zetwerk
description:
Zetwerk is an end-to-end manufacturing supply chain solutions provider.

The online marketplace connects large manufacturing companies with vendors and suppliers for customized products that are used as components of industrial machines and equipment. The company sells items like crane parts, doors, machine chassis, and ladders, as well as services businesses in fabrication, machining, casting, and forging.

Zetwerk provides both buyers and suppliers collaboration tools to streamline their interactions, and execution tools to fulfill the orders effortlessly. The company plans to host a 3rd party apps and services marketplace to fulfill other customer needs. The company's marketplace offers access to the capacity of a nationwide network of manufacturing facilities to get products manufactured for any budget or timelines, enabling businesses to procure custom products and machine parts and suppliers to obtain more orders and grow their revenues.

Zetwerk was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

name: Zinier
description: Zinier’s low-code field service automation platform empowers field service organizations with the combined power of humans and technology to keep our world up and running. Powered by AI, Zinier transforms how teams coordinate and execute work, so they can solve problems faster, fix things before they break, and maintain an agile infrastructure that evolves with their needs. Enterprises around the world use Zinier to reach their full potential, delivering always-on service now, while future-proofing for the unexpected. We are a global team headquartered in Silicon Valley with leading investors including Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.

name: Zoca
description: Zoca operates as an AI-powered marketing team. Zoca uses AI to convert leads and turn them into loyal customers.

name: Zolve
description:
Zolve is a neo-banking platform that provides financial products to consumers. Its services include deposit accounts, prepaid cards, money transfers, bill payments, and cross-border transactions. It also provides tools for monitoring transactions and expense and budget management.

It was launched in 2020 and is based in Bangalore, India.

name: Zomentum
description: Zomentum is a team of thinkers, makers, explorers, and believers who’re passionate about what they do. They value everyone’s ideas and ship world-class products. They work hard and play even harder.

name: zumen.in
description:
Zumen is a pioneer in Direct Materials Management - Sourcing, Cost Management, Purchasing & Supplier Collaboration. Zumen has been recognized as a global top 100 pioneer in procurement technology two years in a row by Procuretech along with Kearney.

Zumen enables product manufacturing companies to digitalize their direct sourcing and procurement, and manage every detail of the process in a transparent, collaborative platform. With Zumen’s part life cycle management, BOM interface, supplier base visibility, part quality management, commodity and product cost management, companies can build an agile, resilient supply chain and get their products to market faster. 

Companies require solution various aspects of the direct material life cycle and have realized that trying to choose one solution at a time leads to profileration of tools and eventually they do not talk to each other and the well intended objective of achieving productivity, visibility and trraceability are not achieved. They have now realized a single platform that covers all the connected processes related to the direct material, data and analytics, work flow, collaboration and decisoin making is the right solution.

name: Zumutor Biologics
description: Zumutor is a biotechnology company focused on developing immuno-oncology therapies that harness the body's innate immune system to treat cancer. The company specializes in the discovery and development of therapeutic antibodies designed to activate natural killer (NK) cells and modulate the tumor microenvironment. Its proprietary INABLR® antibody discovery platform supports the identification and optimization of novel antibody candidates for oncology applications. Zumutor is advancing a pipeline of monoclonal antibody therapies, including ZM008, which targets immune checkpoint pathways involved in tumor immune evasion and is being evaluated for the treatment of solid tumors. In addition to its internal drug development programs, the company provides antibody discovery and development capabilities that support the creation of next-generation biologic therapies.

name: ZyG
description: ZyG is a technology platform that provides an AI-driven operating system designed to help direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands scale their products into full businesses. The company’s system uses data, predictive modeling, and interconnected AI agents to evaluate product potential, manage growth activities, and coordinate different aspects of the customer lifecycle. It integrates functions such as branding, store development, marketing, user acquisition, conversion optimization, and logistics into a unified platform, replacing the need for multiple tools and agencies. The platform also incorporates a financing component and a partnership model where ZyG supports execution and scaling while product owners retain control over their products. By combining infrastructure, analytics, and operational execution, ZyG enables product-focused companies to manage growth and scaling through a single system.
